	if saved.root.Parent then
		saved.root.Anchored = saved.anchored
		saved.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		saved.root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
	end
	attribute(record.player, "HSHiding", false)
	attribute(record.player, "HSLockerName", "")
	if saved.character.Parent then attribute(saved.character, "HSHiding", false) end
	if record.character == saved.character and alive(record) then
		if moveOutside then self:_teleport(record, saved.locker.exit.CFrame) end
		pcall(function() if saved.owner then saved.root:SetNetworkOwner(saved.owner) else saved.root:SetNetworkOwnershipAuto() end end)
		self:_movement(record)
	end
end

function Service:_concealLocker(record, added)
	local saved = record.locker
	if not saved or saved.character ~= record.character then return end
	local objects = added and { added } or record.character:GetDescendants()
	for _, object in ipairs(objects) do
		local property, value
		if object:IsA("BasePart") or object:IsA("Decal") then property, value = "Transparency", 1
		elseif object:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or object:IsA("Trail") or object:IsA("Beam") or object:IsA("Highlight") then property, value = "Enabled", false end
		if property then
			if not saved.visuals[object] then saved.visuals[object] = { property = property, value = object[property] } end
			object[property] = value
		end
		if object:IsA("BasePart") then
			if saved.parts[object] == nil then saved.parts[object] = object.CanCollide end
			object.CanCollide = false
		end
	end
end

function Service:_enterLocker(record, locker)
	if locker.occupant or record.locker or not alive(record) or record.role ~= "Hider" then return false end
	local saved = { locker = locker, character = record.character, root = record.root, anchored = record.root.Anchored, parts = {}, visuals = {} }
	pcall(function() saved.owner = record.root:GetNetworkOwner() record.root:SetNetworkOwner(nil) end)
	record.locker, locker.occupant = saved, record
	record.sprintHeld, record.batSwing = false, nil
	self:_concealLabels(record)
	self:_concealLocker(record)
	self:_teleport(record, locker.hide.CFrame)
	record.root.Anchored = true
	attribute(record.player, "HSHiding", true)
	attribute(record.player, "HSLockerName", locker.model.Name)
	attribute(record.character, "HSHiding", true)
	self:_movement(record)
	return true
end

function Service:_exitClear(record, locker)
	local direction = locker.exit.Position - locker.hide.Position
	return direction.Magnitude <= 10 and not workspace:Raycast(locker.hide.Position, direction, self:_rayParameters(locker.model))
end

function Service:UseLocker(player, locker)
	local record = self.records[player]
	local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	if not self.active or (self.phase ~= "Hiding" and self.phase ~= "Seeking") or player.Parent ~= Players
		or not record or not record.participating or not alive(record) or record.frozen or record.ragdoll
		or not locker or self.lockers[locker.model] ~= locker or not locker.door.Parent or not self:_inBounds(record)
		or now - (record.lastLockerAt or -math.huge) < 0.4 then return false end
	record.lastLockerAt = now
	if record.locker then
		if record.locker.locker ~= locker or not self:_exitClear(record, locker) then return false end
		self:_restoreLocker(record, true)
		return true
	end
	local offset = locker.door.Position - record.root.Position
	if offset.Magnitude > 6 or not self:_exitClear(record, locker)
		or workspace:Raycast(record.root.Position, offset, self:_rayParameters(locker.model)) then return false end
	if record.role == "Hider" then return self:_enterLocker(record, locker) end
	if record.role ~= "Seeker" or self.phase ~= "Seeking" or now < (record.batSwingReadyAt or 0) then return false end
	record.batSwingReadyAt = now + 0.75
	attribute(player, "PCBatSwingAt", now)
	attribute(player, "PCBatSwingSerial", (player:GetAttribute("PCBatSwingSerial") or 0) + 1)
	local target = locker.occupant
	if not target then return true end
	if self.records[target.player] ~= target or not alive(target) or not target.participating or target.role ~= "Hider"
		or not target.locker or target.locker.locker ~= locker
		or (target.root.Position - locker.hide.Position).Magnitude > 2 then return false end
	self:_restoreLocker(target, true)
	return self:_convert(target, record, now)
end

function Service:ExitLocker(player)
	local record = self.records[player]
	if not record or not record.locker then return false end
	return self:UseLocker(player, record.locker.locker)
end

function Service:_bindLockers()
	for _, model in ipairs(self.gameplay:WaitForChild("LockerSpots"):GetChildren()) do
		local door, hide, exit = model:FindFirstChild("Door"), model:FindFirstChild("HidePoint"), model:FindFirstChild("ExitPoint")
		local prompt = door and door:FindFirstChild("LockerPrompt")
		if model:IsA("Model") and door and door:IsA("BasePart") and hide and hide:IsA("BasePart")
			and exit and exit:IsA("BasePart") and prompt and prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt")
			and (hide.Position - door.Position).Magnitude <= 6 and (exit.Position - door.Position).Magnitude <= 8 then
			local locker = { model = model, door = door, hide = hide, exit = exit, prompt = prompt }
			self.lockers[model] = locker
			prompt.KeyboardKeyCode, prompt.GamepadKeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.F, Enum.KeyCode.ButtonX
			prompt.ActionText, prompt.ObjectText = "Hide / Search / Exit", model:GetAttribute("HSHidingSpotName") or "Locker"
			prompt.MaxActivationDistance, prompt.RequiresLineOfSight, prompt.Enabled = 6, false, false
			table.insert(self.connections, prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player) self:UseLocker(player, locker) end))
		end
	end
	assert(next(self.lockers), "Hide and Seek needs usable lockers")
end

function Service:_restoreRagdoll(record, standUp)
	local saved = record.ragdoll
	if not saved then return end
	record.ragdoll = nil
	disconnect(saved.connections)
	for part, original in pairs(saved.parts) do
		if part.Parent then
			part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
			part.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
			part.CanCollide = original.CanCollide
		end
	end
	for _, instance in ipairs(saved.created) do
		if instance.Parent then instance:Destroy() end
	end
	for socket, enabled in pairs(saved.sockets) do
		if socket.Parent then socket.Enabled = enabled end
	end
	for _, original in ipairs(saved.motors) do
		if original.motor.Parent and original.motor.Enabled ~= original.Enabled then original.motor.Enabled = original.Enabled end
	end
	local humanoid = saved.humanoid
	if standUp and humanoid.Parent and humanoid.Health > 0 and saved.character.Parent and saved.root.Parent then
		if saved.wasPush then
			local parameters = RaycastParams.new()
			parameters.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
			local ignored = { saved.character }
			for _, other in pairs(self.records) do
				if other.character then table.insert(ignored, other.character) end
			end
			parameters.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignored
			parameters.RespectCanCollide = true
			local position = saved.root.Position
			local floor = workspace:Raycast(position + Vector3.new(0, 6, 0), Vector3.new(0, -24, 0), parameters)
			local leg = saved.character:FindFirstChild("Left Leg") or saved.character:FindFirstChild("Right Leg")
			local legHeight = humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 and leg and leg:IsA("BasePart") and leg.Size.Y or 0
			if floor then position = Vector3.new(position.X, floor.Position.Y + humanoid.HipHeight + legHeight + saved.root.Size.Y * 0.5 + 0.1, position.Z) end
			saved.standCFrame = CFrame.new(position) * saved.standCFrame.Rotation
		end
		saved.character:PivotTo(saved.standCFrame * saved.root.CFrame:Inverse() * saved.character:GetPivot())
	end
	if humanoid.Parent then
		humanoid.RequiresNeck = saved.RequiresNeck
		humanoid.AutoRotate = saved.AutoRotate
		humanoid.PlatformStand = saved.PlatformStand
		humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp, saved.GettingUpEnabled)
		if standUp and humanoid.Health > 0 and not saved.PlatformStand then
			humanoid:ChangeState(saved.GettingUpEnabled and Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp or Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
		end
	end
	attribute(saved.character, "HSRagdolled", false)
	attribute(record.player, "HSRagdolled", false)
	attribute(saved.character, "PCPushed", false)
	attribute(record.player, "PCPushed", false)
	if record.character == saved.character and record.participating then self:_movement(record) end
	if saved.root.Parent and not record.frozen then
		pcall(function()
			if record.isBot then saved.root:SetNetworkOwner(nil) else saved.root:SetNetworkOwnershipAuto() end
		end)
	end
end

function Service:_ragdoll(record, attacker, now, duration, kind)
	if not alive(record) then return false end
	kind = kind or "Bat"
	duration = duration or BAT_RAGDOLL_SECONDS
	local existing = record.ragdoll
	if existing and existing.character == record.character and existing.token == self.currentRound then
		if kind == "Push" then return false end
		existing.kind = "Bat"
		existing.endsAt = math.max(existing.endsAt, now + duration)

		attribute(record.character, "PCPushed", false)
		attribute(record.player, "PCPushed", false)
		return true
	end
	self:_restoreRagdoll(record, true)
	self:_releaseSeat(record)
	local character, humanoid, root = record.character, record.humanoid, record.root
	local look = Vector3.new(root.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, root.CFrame.LookVector.Z)
	if look.Magnitude < 0.01 then look = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end
	local saved = {
		character = character, humanoid = humanoid, root = root,
		endsAt = now + duration, token = self.currentRound, kind = kind, wasPush = kind == "Push",
		standCFrame = CFrame.lookAt(root.Position, root.Position + look.Unit),
		RequiresNeck = humanoid.RequiresNeck, PlatformStand = humanoid.PlatformStand,
		AutoRotate = humanoid.AutoRotate, GettingUpEnabled = humanoid:GetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp),
		motors = {}, sockets = {}, parts = {}, created = {}, connections = {},
	}
	record.batSwing = nil
	record.ragdoll = saved
	self:_movement(record)
	record.lockedCFrame = nil
	local ok, failure = xpcall(function()
		local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name = "HSRagdollConstraints"
		folder.Parent = character
		table.insert(saved.created, folder)
		humanoid.RequiresNeck = false
		humanoid.PlatformStand = true
		humanoid.AutoRotate = false
		humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp, false)
		local authoredSockets = {}
		for _, object in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
			if object:IsA("BallSocketConstraint") and object.Attachment0 and object.Attachment1 then
				table.insert(authoredSockets, object)
			end
		end
		for _, motor in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
			local first, second
			if motor:IsA("Motor6D") then
				first, second = motor.Part0, motor.Part1
			elseif motor:IsA("AnimationConstraint") and motor.Attachment0 and motor.Attachment1 then
				first = motor.Attachment0:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BasePart")
				second = motor.Attachment1:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BasePart")
			end
			if first and second and first.Parent == character and second.Parent == character then
				for _, part in ipairs({ first, second }) do
					if not saved.parts[part] then saved.parts[part] = { CanCollide = part.CanCollide } end
				end
				table.insert(saved.motors, { motor = motor, Enabled = motor.Enabled })
				if motor.Enabled and first ~= root and second ~= root then
					local authoredSocket
					if motor:IsA("AnimationConstraint") then
						for _, socket in ipairs(authoredSockets) do
							local part0 = socket.Attachment0:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BasePart")
							local part1 = socket.Attachment1:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BasePart")
							if (part0 == first and part1 == second) or (part0 == second and part1 == first) then
								authoredSocket = socket
								break
							end
						end
					end
					if authoredSocket then
						saved.sockets[authoredSocket] = authoredSocket.Enabled
						authoredSocket.Enabled = true
					else
						local firstAttachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
						firstAttachment.Name = "HSRagdollA0"
						firstAttachment.CFrame = motor:IsA("Motor6D") and motor.C0 * motor.Transform or first.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(motor.Attachment0.WorldCFrame)
						firstAttachment.Parent = first
						table.insert(saved.created, firstAttachment)
						local secondAttachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
						secondAttachment.Name = "HSRagdollA1"
						secondAttachment.CFrame = motor:IsA("Motor6D") and motor.C1 or second.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(motor.Attachment1.WorldCFrame)
						secondAttachment.Parent = second
						table.insert(saved.created, secondAttachment)
						local socket = Instance.new("BallSocketConstraint")
						socket.Name = motor.Name .. "Socket"
						socket.Attachment0 = firstAttachment
						socket.Attachment1 = secondAttachment
						socket.LimitsEnabled = true
						socket.TwistLimitsEnabled = true
						local name = motor.Name:lower()
						local restrained = name:find("neck") or name:find("waist") or name:find("wrist") or name:find("ankle")
						socket.UpperAngle = restrained and 25 or 65
						socket.TwistLowerAngle = restrained and -20 or -45
						socket.TwistUpperAngle = restrained and 20 or 45
						socket.MaxFrictionTorque = 4
						socket.Restitution = 0
						socket.Parent = folder
					end
					local noCollision = Instance.new("NoCollisionConstraint")
					noCollision.Name = motor.Name .. "NoCollision"
					noCollision.Part0 = first
					noCollision.Part1 = second
					noCollision.Parent = folder
					motor.Enabled = false
				end
			end
		end
		for part in pairs(saved.parts) do
			part.CanCollide = part ~= root
			pcall(function() part:SetNetworkOwner(nil) end)
		end
		humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics)
		local direction = attacker and attacker.root and root.Position - attacker.root.Position or -look
		direction = Vector3.new(direction.X, 0, direction.Z)
		if direction.Magnitude < 0.01 then direction = -look end
		direction = direction.Unit
		root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = direction * 8 + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
		root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(direction.Z * 3, 0, -direction.X * 3)
		attribute(record.player, "HSRagdolled", true)
		attribute(character, "HSRagdolled", true)
		attribute(character, "PCPushed", kind == "Push")
		attribute(record.player, "PCPushed", kind == "Push")
		table.insert(saved.connections, humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
			if record.ragdoll == saved then self:_restoreRagdoll(record, false) end
		end))
		table.insert(saved.connections, character.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
			if not parent and record.ragdoll == saved then self:_restoreRagdoll(record, false) end
		end))
	end, debug.traceback)
	if not ok then
		self:_restoreRagdoll(record, true)
		warn("Hide and Seek ragdoll could not start: " .. tostring(failure))
	end
	return ok
end



function Service:TryBatSwing(player)
	local record, now = self.records[player], workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	if player.Parent ~= Players or not self.active or self.phase ~= "Seeking" or now >= self.endsAt
		or not record or not record.participating or record.role ~= "Seeker" or not alive(record)
		or record.frozen or record.ragdoll or record.locker or not self:_inBounds(record)
		or now < (record.batSwingReadyAt or 0) then return false, "Cannot swing right now" end
	record.batSwingReadyAt = now + 0.75
	record.batSwing = { hitAt = now + 0.10, endsAt = now + 0.38, hit = false, character = record.character, token = self.currentRound }
	sampleBatSwing(record.batSwing, record, self:_batTargets(), now)
	attribute(player, "PCBatSwingAt", now)
	attribute(player, "PCBatSwingSerial", (player:GetAttribute("PCBatSwingSerial") or 0) + 1)
	return true
end

function Service:CancelBatSwing(player)
	local record = self.records[player]
	if not record then return false end
	record.batSwing = nil
	return true
end

function Service:_convert(target, seeker, now)
	if not self.active or self.phase ~= "Seeking" or not target.participating or target.role ~= "Hider" then return false end
	self:_restoreLocker(target, true)
	target.sprintHeld, target.batSwing, target.stamina = false, nil, MAX_STAMINA
	target.batSwingReadyAt = now + BAT_RAGDOLL_SECONDS + 0.25
	attribute(target.player, "HSFoundAt", now)
	self:_role(target, "Seeker")
	if alive(target) then self:_ragdoll(target, seeker, now) end
	if seeker then
		seeker.tagsMade = (seeker.tagsMade or 0) + 1
		attribute(seeker.player, "PCBatHitSerial", (seeker.player:GetAttribute("PCBatHitSerial") or 0) + 1)
	end
	self:_publish()
	return true
end

function Service:SetSprint(player, enabled)
	local record, now = self.records[player], workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	if typeof(enabled) ~= "boolean" or player.Parent ~= Players or not record then return false end
	if enabled and (not self.active or not record.participating or not alive(record) or record.frozen or record.ragdoll or record.locker
		or (self.phase ~= "Hiding" and self.phase ~= "Seeking") or now - (record.lastSprintAt or -math.huge) < 0.04) then return false end
	record.lastSprintAt, record.sprintHeld = now, enabled
	self:_movement(record)
	return true
end

function Service:_restoreCharacter(record)
	self:_clearAbilityEffects(record)
	self:_restoreLocker(record, false)
	self:_restoreRagdoll(record, true)
	self:_restorePropMorph(record)
	self:_restoreLabels(record)
	local saved = record.original
	if saved and record.humanoid and record.humanoid.Parent then
		record.humanoid.WalkSpeed, record.humanoid.JumpPower, record.humanoid.JumpHeight = saved.WalkSpeed, saved.JumpPower, saved.JumpHeight
		record.humanoid.AutoRotate, record.humanoid.PlatformStand = saved.AutoRotate, saved.PlatformStand
	end
	if saved and record.root and record.root.Parent then record.root.Anchored = saved.Anchored end
	record.sprintHeld, record.batSwing = false, nil
	attribute(record.player, "HSSprinting", false)
	attribute(record.player, "HSRagdolled", false)
end

function Service:_bindCharacter(record, character)
	self:_restoreCharacter(record)
	disconnect(record.characterConnections)
	record.character, record.ready = character, false
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
	if record.character ~= character or not character.Parent or self.records[record.player] ~= record
		or not humanoid or not root or not humanoid:IsA("Humanoid") or not root:IsA("BasePart") then return end
	record.humanoid, record.root, record.ready = humanoid, root, true
	record.original = { WalkSpeed = humanoid.WalkSpeed, JumpPower = humanoid.JumpPower, JumpHeight = humanoid.JumpHeight,
		AutoRotate = humanoid.AutoRotate, PlatformStand = humanoid.PlatformStand, Anchored = root.Anchored }
	attribute(character, "HSRole", record.role or "")
	attribute(character, "HSHiding", false)
	attribute(character, "HSRagdolled", false)
	table.insert(record.characterConnections, character.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
		if record.participating and (object:IsA("BillboardGui") or object:IsA("Highlight")) then self:_concealLabels(record) end
		if record.propMorph then self:_concealPropAvatar(record, object) end
		if record.locker then self:_concealLocker(record, object) end
	end))
	table.insert(record.characterConnections, humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
		self:_clearAbilityEffects(record)
		self:_restoreLocker(record, false)
		self:_restoreRagdoll(record, false)
		record.batSwing, record.sprintHeld = nil, false
		if record.participating and record.role == "Hider" then
			if self.phase == "Seeking" then self:_convert(record, nil, workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
			else self:_role(record, "Seeker") self:_publish() end
		end
	end))
	if record.participating and self.active then
		record.frozen = self.phase == "Countdown" or self.phase == "Results" or (self.phase == "Hiding" and record.role == "Seeker")
		record.stamina = MAX_STAMINA
		self:_teleport(record, self:_spawn(record.spawnIndex or 1, record.role == "Seeker"))
		self:_concealLabels(record)
		if record.role == "Hider" and not self:_applyPropMorph(record) then self:_finish(false, true) end
		self:_movement(record)
	end
end

function Service:_addPlayer(player)
	if self.records[player] then return end
	local record = { player = player, connections = {}, characterConnections = {}, ready = false, participating = false,
		role = "", stamina = MAX_STAMINA, sprintHeld = false }
	self.records[player] = record
	self:_resetAbilities(record)
	attribute(player, "HSLockerName", "")
	for name, value in pairs({ HSParticipating = false, HSRole = "", HSHiding = false, HSRagdolled = false,
		HSPropMorphed = false, HSPropId = "", HSPropName = "", HSSprinting = false, HSStamina = MAX_STAMINA, HSMaxStamina = MAX_STAMINA, HSResult = "" }) do attribute(player, name, value) end
	table.insert(record.connections, player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character) task.spawn(function() self:_bindCharacter(record, character) end) end))
	table.insert(record.connections, player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(character)
		if record.character ~= character then return end
		self:_restoreCharacter(record)
		record.ready = false
		if record.participating and record.role == "Hider" then self:_role(record, "Seeker") self:_publish() end
	end))
	if player.Character then task.spawn(function() self:_bindCharacter(record, player.Character) end) end
end

function Service:_removePlayer(player)
	local record = self.records[player]
	if not record then return end
	self:_restoreCharacter(record)
	disconnect(record.connections)
	disconnect(record.characterConnections)
	self.records[player] = nil
	self:_publish()
end

function Service:_readyPlayers(selectedPlayers)
	local result, seen = {}, {}
	for _, player in ipairs(selectedPlayers or Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local record = self.records[player]
		if not seen[player] and player.Parent == Players and alive(record) and not record.participating
			and player:GetAttribute("PCDataReady") == true and not player:GetAttribute("PCAFK") and not player:GetAttribute("PCAFKRequested")
			and not player:GetAttribute("BBParticipating") and not player:GetAttribute("TGParticipating") and not player:GetAttribute("MDParticipating")
			and not player:GetAttribute("DGParticipating") and not player:GetAttribute("DGEliminated") then
			seen[player] = true
			table.insert(result, player)
		end
	end
	for index = #result, 2, -1 do
		local other = self.random:NextInteger(1, index)
		result[index], result[other] = result[other], result[index]
	end
	while #result > math.floor(self:_setting("MaxPlayers", 16, 2, 16)) do table.remove(result) end
	return result
end

function Service:_finish(seekersWon, cancelled)
	if not self.active or self.phase == "Results" then return end
	local winners, winnerIds, participantIds = {}, {}, {}
	for player, record in pairs(self.records) do
		if record.participating and player.Parent == Players then
			self:_restoreLocker(record, true)
			self:_restoreRagdoll(record, true)
			self:_restorePropMorph(record)
			self:_resetAbilities(record)
			record.frozen, record.sprintHeld, record.batSwing = true, false, nil
			local won = not cancelled and ((seekersWon and record.role == "Seeker") or (not seekersWon and record.role == "Hider"))
			attribute(player, "HSResult", cancelled and "Cancelled" or (won and "Won" or "Lost"))
			table.insert(participantIds, player.UserId)
			if won then table.insert(winnerIds, player.UserId) table.insert(winners, player.DisplayName) end
			self:_movement(record)
		end
	end
	table.sort(winnerIds) table.sort(participantIds) table.sort(winners)
	attribute(self.state, "WinnersText", cancelled and "Round cancelled" or (seekersWon and "Everybody found! Seekers win" or "Time's up! Hiders win"))
	attribute(self.state, "WinnerNames", table.concat(winners, ", "))
	attribute(self.state, "WinningRole", cancelled and "" or (seekersWon and "Seeker" or "Hider"))
	attribute(self.state, "LastResultWinnerIds", table.concat(winnerIds, ","))
	attribute(self.state, "LastResultParticipantIds", table.concat(participantIds, ","))
	attribute(self.state, "LastResultPractice", cancelled == true)
	attribute(self.state, "LastResultRound", self.roundNumber)
	self.resultsEndsAt = workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + self:_setting("ResultsSeconds", 7, 0, 15)
	attribute(self.state, "EndsAt", self.resultsEndsAt)
	self:_phase("Results")
	local event = self.state:FindFirstChild("RoundFinished")
	if event and event:IsA("BindableEvent") then event:Fire({ game = "HideAndSeek", roundNumber = self.roundNumber,
		winnerUserIds = winnerIds, participantUserIds = participantIds, practice = cancelled == true }) end
end

function Service:_ensureSeeker()
	local hiders, seekers = self:_publish()
	if seekers > 0 or hiders == 0 then return end
	local options = {}
	for _, record in pairs(self.records) do if record.participating and record.role == "Hider" then table.insert(options, record) end end
	local record = options[self.random:NextInteger(1, #options)]
	self:_restoreLocker(record, true)
	self:_role(record, "Seeker")
	record.frozen = self.phase == "Hiding" or self.phase == "Countdown"
	if alive(record) then self:_teleport(record, self:_spawn(record.spawnIndex or 1, true)) self:_movement(record) end
	self:_publish()
end

function Service:_tick(dt)
	if not self.active then return end
	local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	if self.phase == "Results" then
		if now >= self.resultsEndsAt then self:_cleanup(self.currentRound) end
		return
	end
	self:_ensureSeeker()
	local hiders, seekers = self:_publish()
	if hiders + seekers < 2 then self:_finish(false, true) return end
	if hiders == 0 and self.phase ~= "Seeking" then self:_finish(false, true) return end
	if self.phase == "Countdown" and now >= self.countdownEndsAt then
		self.hidingEndsAt = now + self:_setting("HideSeconds", 30, 5, 60)
		attribute(self.state, "HidingEndsAt", self.hidingEndsAt)
		attribute(self.state, "EndsAt", self.hidingEndsAt)
		attribute(self.state, "CountdownValue", 0)
		self:_phase("Hiding")
		for _, record in pairs(self.records) do if record.participating then record.frozen = record.role == "Seeker" self:_movement(record) end end
	elseif self.phase == "Countdown" then attribute(self.state, "CountdownValue", math.max(0, math.ceil(self.countdownEndsAt - now))) end
	if self.phase == "Hiding" and now >= self.hidingEndsAt then
		self.endsAt = now + self:_setting("RoundDuration", 300, 30, 600)
		attribute(self.state, "EndsAt", self.endsAt)
		self:_ringSchoolBell()
		self:_phase("Seeking")
		for _, record in pairs(self.records) do if record.participating then record.frozen = false self:_movement(record) end end
	end
	if self.phase ~= "Hiding" and self.phase ~= "Seeking" then return end
	for _, record in pairs(self.records) do
		if record.participating and record.humanoid and record.humanoid.Health <= 0 then
			self:_clearAbilityEffects(record)
			self:_restoreLocker(record, false)
			self:_restoreRagdoll(record, false)
			record.batSwing, record.sprintHeld = nil, false
			if record.role == "Hider" then self:_role(record, "Seeker") end
		elseif record.participating and alive(record) then
			if record.role == "Hider" and (not record.propMorph or record.propMorph.model.Parent ~= record.character) then
				self:_restoreLocker(record, true)
				if not self:_applyPropMorph(record) then self:_finish(false, true) return end
			end
			if record.ragdoll and now >= record.ragdoll.endsAt then self:_restoreRagdoll(record, true) end
			if record.locker and (record.locker.character ~= record.character
				or (record.root.Position - record.locker.locker.hide.Position).Magnitude > 2) then self:_restoreLocker(record, true) end
			if not self:_inBounds(record) and not record.ragdoll then self:_restoreLocker(record, false) self:_teleport(record, self:_spawn(record.spawnIndex or 1, record.role == "Seeker")) end
			local draining = not record.frozen and not record.locker and not record.ragdoll and record.sprintHeld and record.stamina > 0
			record.stamina = math.clamp(record.stamina + (draining and -1 or 1.5) * dt, 0, MAX_STAMINA)
			self:_movement(record)
		end
	end
	if self.phase ~= "Seeking" then return end
	if hiders == 0 then self:_finish(true) return end
	if now >= self.endsAt then self:_finish(false) return end
	local rayParameters = self:_rayParameters()
	for _, seeker in pairs(self.records) do
		local swing = seeker.batSwing
		if swing then
			if swing.hit or swing.character ~= seeker.character or swing.token ~= self.currentRound or now > swing.endsAt + BAT_SAMPLE_MAX_AGE
				or not alive(seeker) or not seeker.participating or seeker.role ~= "Seeker" or seeker.frozen or seeker.ragdoll or not self:_inBounds(seeker) then seeker.batSwing = nil
			else
				local nearest, best
				for _, target in pairs(self.records) do
					if target.participating and target.role == "Hider" and alive(target) and not target.locker and not target.ragdoll and self:_inBounds(target) then
						local hit, distance = batContact(swing, seeker, target, now, self:_setting("TagDistance", 10, 1, 10), rayParameters)
						if hit and (not best or distance < best) then nearest, best = target, distance end
					end
				end
				local nearestDecoy
				for _, decoy in pairs(self.decoys) do
					local owner = decoy.owner
					if decoy.character.Parent and decoy.root.Parent and decoy.token == self.currentRound
						and self.records[owner.player] == owner and owner.participating and owner.role == "Hider" and alive(owner) then
						local hit, distance = batContact(swing, seeker, decoy, now, self:_setting("TagDistance", 10, 1, 10), rayParameters)
						if hit and (not best or distance < best) then nearest, nearestDecoy, best = nil, decoy, distance end
					end
				end
				if nearestDecoy then swing.hit = self:_hitDecoy(nearestDecoy, seeker, now)
				elseif nearest then swing.hit = true self:_convert(nearest, seeker, now) end
				sampleBatSwing(swing, seeker, self:_batTargets(), now)
			end
		end
	end
	if self:_publish() == 0 then self:_finish(true) end
end

function Service:_begin(participants)
	self.active, self.mode, self.currentRound = true, "Round", {}
	self.roundNumber += 1
	self.endsAt, self.hidingEndsAt = 0, 0
	attribute(self.state, "Mode", "Round")
	attribute(self.state, "RoundNumber", self.roundNumber)
	attribute(self.state, "WinnersText", "")
	attribute(self.state, "WinningRole", "")
	attribute(self.state, "HidingEndsAt", 0)
	attribute(self.state, "RoundDuration", self:_setting("RoundDuration", 300, 30, 600))
	local firstSeeker = participants[self.random:NextInteger(1, #participants)]
	self.countdownEndsAt = workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + self:_setting("CountdownSeconds", 3, 1, 10)
	attribute(self.state, "EndsAt", self.countdownEndsAt)
	self:_phase("Countdown")
	for index, player in ipairs(participants) do
		local record = self.records[player]
		self:_resetAbilities(record)
		record.participating, record.spawnIndex, record.frozen = true, index, true
		record.stamina, record.sprintHeld, record.tagsMade = MAX_STAMINA, false, 0
		record.batSwingReadyAt, record.lastLockerAt, record.lastSprintAt = 0, -math.huge, -math.huge
		attribute(player, "HSResult", "")
		self:_role(record, player == firstSeeker and "Seeker" or "Hider")
		self:_teleport(record, self:_spawn(index, player == firstSeeker))
		if record.role == "Hider" then assert(self:_applyPropMorph(record), "No usable school prop morphs are available") end
	end
	self:_publish()
	return true
end

function Service:StartRound(selectedPlayers)
	if not self.running then return false, "Service is not running" end
	if self.active then return false, "A round is already running" end
	local participants = self:_readyPlayers(selectedPlayers)
	if #participants < self:_setting("MinimumPlayers", 2, 2, 16) then return false, "Not enough ready players" end
	local ok, result = xpcall(function() return self:_begin(participants) end, debug.traceback)
	if not ok then self:_cleanup() warn("Hide and Seek could not start: " .. tostring(result)) return false, "The school could not prepare the round" end
	return result
end

function Service:_cleanup(token)
	if token and token ~= self.currentRound then return end
	if self.schoolBell and self.schoolBell.Parent then self.schoolBell:Stop() end
	for _, record in pairs(self.records) do
		if record.participating then
			self:_resetAbilities(record)
			self:_restoreCharacter(record)
			record.participating, record.frozen, record.role = false, false, ""
			attribute(record.player, "HSParticipating", false)
			attribute(record.player, "HSRole", "")
			if record.character then attribute(record.character, "HSRole", "") end
			if self.lobbySpawn and self.lobbySpawn.Parent and alive(record) then self:_teleport(record, self.lobbySpawn.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, self.lobbySpawn.Size.Y * 0.5 + 3, 0)) end
		end
	end
	for _, decoy in pairs(self.decoys) do self:_removeDecoy(decoy) end
	if self.decoyFolder then self.decoyFolder:Destroy() self.decoyFolder = nil end
	for _, locker in pairs(self.lockers) do locker.occupant = nil end
	self.active, self.currentRound, self.mode, self.endsAt, self.hidingEndsAt = false, nil, "Waiting", 0, 0
	attribute(self.state, "Mode", "Waiting")
	attribute(self.state, "EndsAt", 0)
	attribute(self.state, "HidingEndsAt", 0)
	attribute(self.state, "CountdownValue", 0)
	self:_phase("Waiting")
	self:_publish()
end

function Service:StopRound()
	if not self.active then return false, "No round is running" end
	self:_cleanup()
	attribute(self.state, "WinnersText", "Round stopped by admin")
	return true
end

function Service:Start()
	if self.running then return self end
	self.running, runningService = true, self
	self:_bindLockers()
	for name, value in pairs({ Phase = "Waiting", Mode = "Waiting", EndsAt = 0, HidingEndsAt = 0, CountdownValue = 0,
		RoundNumber = 0, RoundDuration = self:_setting("RoundDuration", 300, 30, 600), HideSeconds = self:_setting("HideSeconds", 30, 5, 60),
		ParticipantCount = 0, SeekerCount = 0, HiderCount = 0, SeekerUserIds = "", WinnersText = "", WinningRole = "",
		LastResultWinnerIds = "", LastResultParticipantIds = "", LastResultPractice = true, LastResultRound = 0,
		MinimumPlayers = self:_setting("MinimumPlayers", 2, 2, 16), MaxPlayers = self:_setting("MaxPlayers", 16, 2, 16) }) do attribute(self.state, name, value) end
	table.insert(self.connections, Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player) self:_addPlayer(player) end))
	table.insert(self.connections, Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player) self:_removePlayer(player) end))
	table.insert(self.connections, RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		self.tickAccumulator += dt
		if self.tickAccumulator < 0.05 then return end
		local elapsed = math.min(self.tickAccumulator, 0.15)
		self.tickAccumulator = 0
		local ok, failure = xpcall(function() self:_tick(elapsed) end, debug.traceback)
		if not ok then warn("Hide and Seek round failed: " .. tostring(failure)) self:_cleanup() end
	end))
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do self:_addPlayer(player) end
	local remote = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("HideAndSeekSprintRequest")
	assert(remote and remote:IsA("RemoteEvent"), "Hide and Seek sprint remote is missing")
	table.insert(self.connections, remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, enabled) self:SetSprint(player, enabled) end))
	local lockerRemote = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("HideAndSeekActionRequest")
	assert(lockerRemote and lockerRemote:IsA("RemoteEvent"), "Hide and Seek locker remote is missing")
	table.insert(self.connections, lockerRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, action)
		self:HandleAction(player, action)
	end))
	return self
end

function Service:Stop()
	self.running = false
	self:_cleanup()
	disconnect(self.connections)
	for _, record in pairs(self.records) do disconnect(record.connections) disconnect(record.characterConnections) end
	table.clear(self.records)
	table.clear(self.lockers)
	if runningService == self then runningService = nil end
end

function Service.GetRunningService() return runningService end
return Service

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Admin = {}
Admin.__index = Admin
local controls = {
	BBStart = { game = "BritishBulldog" }, BBRunner = { game = "BritishBulldog", role = "Runner" }, BBBulldog = { game = "BritishBulldog", role = "Bulldog" },
	TagStart = { game = "TagYoureIt" }, TagRunner = { game = "TagYoureIt", role = "Runner" }, TagTagger = { game = "TagYoureIt", role = "Tagger" },
	MudStart = { game = "StuckInTheMud" }, MudShooter = { game = "StuckInTheMud", role = "Shooter" }, MudMedic = { game = "StuckInTheMud", role = "Medic" },
}
controls.HSStart = { game = "HideAndSeek" }
controls.DGStart = { game = "DuckDuckGoose" }
controls.SKStart = { game = "SkippingRope" }
controls.SKSolo = { game = "SkippingRope", role = "Jumper" }
local aliases = { StartRound = "BBStart", PracticeRunner = "BBRunner", PracticeBulldog = "BBBulldog" }
local grants = { GrantItem = true, GrantCoins = true, AddLevels = true, GrantVIP = true, GrantBetaTester = true }

function Admin.new(coordinator, config, isStudio, playerSource)
	return setmetatable({ coordinator = coordinator, config = config, isStudio = isStudio, players = playerSource or Players, lastRequest = {}, lastStatus = {}, busy = false, connections = {} }, Admin)
end

function Admin:IsAuthorized(player)
	local userId = player and player.UserId
	if typeof(userId) ~= "number" or userId <= 0 or userId % 1 ~= 0 or userId >= 9007199254740991 then return false end
	if userId == self.config:GetAttribute("AdminUserId") then return true end
	local extraIds = self.config:GetAttribute("ExtraAdminUserIds")
	if typeof(extraIds) ~= "string" then return false end
	for token in extraIds:gmatch("[^,]+") do
		local digits = token:match("^%s*(%d+)%s*$")
		if digits and tonumber(digits) == userId then return true end
	end
	return false
end

function Admin:_target(player, payload)
	if payload ~= nil and typeof(payload) ~= "table" then return nil, "Choose a player in this server." end
	local id = player.UserId
	if payload and payload.targetUserId ~= nil then id = payload.targetUserId end
	if typeof(id) ~= "number" or id ~= id or id % 1 ~= 0 or id == 0 or math.abs(id) > 1000000000000 or (id < 0 and not self.isStudio) then
		return nil, "Choose a player in this server."
	end
	local target = self.players:GetPlayerByUserId(id)
	if not target then return nil, "That player is no longer in this server." end
	return target
end

function Admin:Status(player, ok, message, target)
	local active = self.coordinator:ActiveGame()
	local service = active and self.coordinator.services[active]
	local reply = { ok = ok, message = message or "", game = active or "", phase = service and service.phase or "Waiting", mode = service and service.state:GetAttribute("Mode") or "Waiting", role = active == "SkippingRope" and player:GetAttribute("SKRole") or active == "DuckDuckGoose" and player:GetAttribute("DGRole") or active == "HideAndSeek" and player:GetAttribute("HSRole") or active == "StuckInTheMud" and (player:GetAttribute("MDEliminated") and "Out" or player:GetAttribute("MDTeamColorName") or "Ready") or active == "TagYoureIt" and player:GetAttribute("TGRole") or player:GetAttribute("BBRole"), automatic = self.coordinator.autoEnabled }
	reply.players = {}
	for _, online in ipairs(self.players:GetPlayers()) do
		table.insert(reply.players, { userId = online.UserId, name = online.Name, displayName = online.DisplayName, ready = online:GetAttribute("PCDataReady") == true })
	end
	table.sort(reply.players, function(a, b)
		if a.name == b.name then return a.userId < b.userId end
		return a.name:lower() < b.name:lower()
	end)
	local economy = self.coordinator.economy
	if economy then
		reply.limits = table.clone(economy.AdminLimits)
		if target == false then target = nil
		else target = target or self.players:GetPlayerByUserId(player.UserId) end
		if target then
			reply.targetUserId = target.UserId
			reply.target = economy:Status(target, true)
			reply.target.userId = target.UserId
			reply.target.name = target.Name
			reply.target.displayName = target.DisplayName
		end
	end
	return reply
end

function Admin:Handle(player, action, payload)
	if not self:IsAuthorized(player) then return { ok = false, message = "Admin access required." } end
	if typeof(action) ~= "string" then return self:Status(player, false, "Unknown control.") end
	action = aliases[action] or action
	if not controls[action] and not grants[action] and action ~= "StopRound" and action ~= "GetStatus" and action ~= "ToggleAutomatic" then return self:Status(player, false, "Unknown control.") end
	local target, targetError
	if grants[action] or action == "GetStatus" then
		if grants[action] and (typeof(payload) ~= "table" or payload.targetUserId == nil) then return self:Status(player, false, "Choose a target player for this action.") end
		target, targetError = self:_target(player, payload)
		if not target then return self:Status(player, false, targetError, false) end
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	local timestamps = action == "GetStatus" and self.lastStatus or self.lastRequest
	if now - (timestamps[player] or -math.huge) < (action == "GetStatus" and 0.1 or 0.5) then return self:Status(player, false, "Please wait a moment.", target) end
	timestamps[player] = now
	if action == "GetStatus" then return self:Status(player, true, "Ready to play.", target) end
	if self.busy then return self:Status(player, false, "Another control is finishing.", target) end
	self.busy = true
	local ok, success, message = xpcall(function()
		if grants[action] then
			local economy = self.coordinator.economy
			if not economy then return false, "The player economy is not ready." end
			if typeof(payload) ~= "table" then return false, "Choose an item or grant amount." end
			if action == "GrantItem" then
				return economy:AdminGrantItem(target, payload.itemId, payload.equip)
			end
			if action == "GrantCoins" then return economy:AdminGrantCoins(target, payload.amount) end
			if action == "AddLevels" then return economy:AdminAddLevels(target, payload.amount) end
			if action == "GrantVIP" then return economy:AdminGrantEntitlement(target, "VIP") end
			if action == "GrantBetaTester" then return economy:AdminGrantEntitlement(target, "BetaTester") end
		end
		if action == "StopRound" then return self.coordinator:StopGame() end
		if action == "ToggleAutomatic" then
			self.coordinator:SetAutoEnabled(not self.coordinator.autoEnabled)
			return true, self.coordinator.autoEnabled and "Automatic voting rounds are on." or "Automatic rounds paused."
		end
		local control = controls[action]
		local started, reason = self.coordinator:StartGame(control.game, player, control.role, false)
		if not started and reason == "Not enough ready players" then reason = "Use a solo button to test alone. Normal rounds need two players." end
		return started, started and "Starting your game." or reason
	end, debug.traceback)
	self.busy = false
	if not ok then
		local detail = string.sub(tostring(success), 1, 4096)
		self.config:SetAttribute("LastCommandFailureAction", action)
		self.config:SetAttribute("LastCommandFailure", detail)
		self.config:SetAttribute("LastCommandFailureAt", os.time())
		warn(string.format("Playground admin %s failed (place version %d): %s", action, game.PlaceVersion, detail))
		local reply = self:Status(player, false, "Could not finish " .. action .. ". See the error details.", target)
		reply.errorDetail = string.format("%s · Place version %d\n%s", action, game.PlaceVersion, detail)
		return reply
	end
	if success and grants[action] then print("Playground admin " .. player.UserId .. " used " .. action .. " for " .. target.UserId) end
	return self:Status(player, success == true, message, target)
end

function Admin.Start(coordinator)
	local config = ServerStorage:WaitForChild("PlaygroundAdminConfig")
	local remote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PlaygroundAdminRequest")
	local self = Admin.new(coordinator, config, RunService:IsStudio())
	self.remote = remote
	remote.OnServerInvoke = function(player, action, payload) return self:Handle(player, action, payload) end
	local function bind(player) player:SetAttribute("PlaygroundAdmin", self:IsAuthorized(player)) end
	table.insert(self.connections, Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(bind))
	table.insert(self.connections, Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player) self.lastRequest[player] = nil self.lastStatus[player] = nil end))
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do bind(player) end
	table.insert(self.connections, config.AttributeChanged:Connect(function() for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do bind(player) end end))
	return self
end

function Admin:Destroy()
	for _, connection in ipairs(self.connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
	if self.remote then self.remote.OnServerInvoke = nil end
end

return Admin

local function validId(value)
	return typeof(value) == "number" and value > 0 and value % 1 == 0 and value < 9007199254740991
end

function Commerce:_tag(player)
	local character = player.Character
	local head = character and character:FindFirstChild("Head")
	if not head then return end
	local vip = player:GetAttribute("PCVIP") == true
	local beta = player:GetAttribute("PCBetaTester") == true
	local current = head:FindFirstChild("PlaygroundVIPTag")
	if not vip and not beta then if current then current:Destroy() end return end
	local gui = current or Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	gui.Name, gui.Adornee, gui.Size = "PlaygroundVIPTag", head, UDim2.fromOffset(vip and beta and 210 or 170, 30)
	gui.StudsOffsetWorldSpace, gui.MaxDistance, gui.AlwaysOnTop = Vector3.new(0, 3.4, 0), 90, false
	local label = gui:FindFirstChild("Title") or Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Name, label.Text, label.Size = "Title", vip and beta and "VIP • BETA TESTER" or vip and "VIP" or "BETA TESTER", UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	label.BackgroundTransparency, label.Font, label.TextSize = 1, Enum.Font.FredokaOne, 24
	label.TextColor3 = vip and Color3.fromRGB(255, 212, 70) or Color3.fromRGB(126, 226, 255)
	local stroke = label:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke") or Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color, stroke.Thickness = Color3.fromRGB(24, 35, 62), 2
	stroke.Parent, label.Parent, gui.Parent = label, gui, head
end

function Commerce:_passes(player)
	local state = self.players[player]
	if not self.running or not state then return end
	if state.loading then state.refreshPending = true return end
	state.loading = true
	local failed = false
	for _, key in { "VIP", "DoubleCoins", "DoubleXP" } do
		local entry = self.config:FindFirstChild(key)
		if entry and validId(entry.Value) then
			local ok, owned = pcall(function() return MarketplaceService:UserOwnsGamePassAsync(player.UserId, entry.Value) end)
			if ok then state[key] = owned == true else failed = true end
		else
			state[key] = false
		end
	end
	state.loading = false
	if not self.running or self.players[player] ~= state or player.Parent ~= Players then return end
	self.economy:SetPassBenefits(player, state.VIP == true, state.DoubleCoins == true, state.DoubleXP == true)
	self:_tag(player)
	local purchased = state.purchaseKey
	if purchased and state[purchased] then
		state.purchaseKey = nil
		pcall(function() self.result:FireClient(player, "Your " .. (purchased == "VIP" and "VIP" or purchased == "DoubleXP" and "2x XP" or "2x coins") .. " pass is active!") end)
	end
	if state.refreshPending then
		state.refreshPending = nil
		task.defer(function() if self.players[player] == state then self:_passes(player) end end)
	elseif failed and (state.retries or 0) < 3 then
		state.retries = (state.retries or 0) + 1
		task.delay(5 * state.retries, function() if self.players[player] == state then self:_passes(player) end end)
	elseif not failed then
		state.retries = 0
	end
end

function Commerce:_player(player)
	if self.players[player] then return end
	local state = {}
	self.players[player] = state
	local function bindCharacter(character)
		task.spawn(function()
			local head = character:WaitForChild("Head", 10)
			if head and self.players[player] == state and player.Character == character then self:_tag(player) end
		end)
	end
	state.character = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(bindCharacter)
	state.vip = player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("PCVIP"):Connect(function() self:_tag(player) end)
	state.beta = player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("PCBetaTester"):Connect(function() self:_tag(player) end)
	if player.Character then bindCharacter(player.Character) end
	task.spawn(function() self:_passes(player) end)
end

function Commerce:_remove(player)
	local state = self.players[player]
	if state then
		for _, name in { "character", "vip", "beta" } do if state[name] then state[name]:Disconnect() end end
	end
	self.players[player] = nil
end

function Commerce:_receipt(receipt)
	local retry = Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	local granted = Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
	if not self.running or not validId(receipt.ProductId) or not validId(receipt.PlayerId) then return retry end
	if typeof(receipt.PurchaseId) ~= "string" or receipt.PurchaseId == "" or #receipt.PurchaseId > 50 then return retry end
	local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(receipt.PlayerId)
	if not player then return retry end
	for _, entry in self.config:GetChildren() do
		if entry:IsA("IntValue") and entry:GetAttribute("Kind") == "Product" and entry.Value == receipt.ProductId then
			local coins = entry:GetAttribute("Coins")
			if not validId(coins) or coins > 100000 then return retry end
			local ok, saved = pcall(function() return self.economy:GrantCoinPurchase(player, receipt, coins) end)
			if not ok or saved ~= true then return retry end
			pcall(function() self.result:FireClient(player, "Purchase confirmed! +" .. coins .. " coins.") end)
			return granted
		end
	end
	for _, entry in self.donations:GetChildren() do
		if not entry:IsA("IntValue") or entry.Value ~= receipt.ProductId then continue end
		local ok, saved = pcall(function()
			return self.receipts:UpdateAsync(receipt.PurchaseId, function(previous)
				if previous then return previous end
				return { playerId = receipt.PlayerId, productId = receipt.ProductId, robux = receipt.CurrencySpent, at = os.time() }
			end)
		end)
		if not ok or typeof(saved) ~= "table" or saved.playerId ~= receipt.PlayerId or saved.productId ~= receipt.ProductId then return retry end
		pcall(function() self.donationResult:FireClient(player, "Thank you for supporting Playground Classics!") end)
		return granted
	end
	return retry
end

function Commerce:Start()
	if self.running then return self end
	self.config = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PlaygroundCommerce")
	self.result = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PlaygroundCommerceResult")
	self.donations = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PlaygroundDonationProducts")
	self.donationResult = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PlaygroundDonationResult")
	self.receipts = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlaygroundDonationReceipts_v1")
	self.config:SetAttribute("Ready", false)
	self.running = true
	MarketplaceService.ProcessReceipt = function(receipt) return self:_receipt(receipt) end
	table.insert(self.connections, Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player) self:_player(player) end))
	table.insert(self.connections, Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player) self:_remove(player) end))
	table.insert(self.connections, MarketplaceService.PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished:Connect(function(player, passId, purchased)
		if not purchased then return end
		for _, key in { "VIP", "DoubleCoins", "DoubleXP" } do
			local entry = self.config:FindFirstChild(key)
			if entry and validId(entry.Value) and entry.Value == passId then
				task.spawn(function()
					local state = self.players[player]
					if state then state.purchaseKey, state.retries = key, 0 self:_passes(player) end
				end)
				break
			end
		end
	end))
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do self:_player(player) end
	self.config:SetAttribute("Ready", true)
	return self
end

function Commerce:Stop()
	self.running = false
	if self.config then self.config:SetAttribute("Ready", false) end
	for _, connection in self.connections do connection:Disconnect() end
	table.clear(self.connections)
	for player in self.players do self:_remove(player) end
end

return Commerce

function Coordinator.new(services, lobby, economy)
	local self = setmetatable({}, Coordinator)
	self.services = services
	self.lobby = lobby
	self.economy = economy
	self.zone = lobby.Gameplay.VoteZone
	self.state = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PlaygroundState")
	self.votes = {}
	self.lastVote = {}
	self.lastSessionRequest = {}
	self.sessionConnections = {}
	self.spectators = {}
	self.lastSpectateStamp = {}
	self.lastSpectateRequest = {}
	self.connections = {}
	self.running = false
	self.autoEnabled = true
	self.votingEndsAt = 0
	self.startRetryAt = 0
	self.random = Random.new()
	self.lastGame = nil
	return self
end

function Coordinator:ActiveGame()
	for _, id in ipairs(games) do if self.services[id] and self.services[id].active then return id end end
	return nil
end

function Coordinator:_participating(player)
	return player:GetAttribute("BBParticipating") == true or player:GetAttribute("TGParticipating") == true or player:GetAttribute("MDParticipating") == true or player:GetAttribute("HSParticipating") == true or player:GetAttribute("DGParticipating") == true or player:GetAttribute("SKParticipating") == true or player:GetAttribute("SKEliminated") == true
end

function Coordinator:_afkRequested(player)
	return player:GetAttribute("PCAFK") == true or player:GetAttribute("PCAFKRequested") == true
end

function Coordinator:_syncAFK(player)
	local requested = player:GetAttribute("PCAFKRequested") == true
	local participating = self:_participating(player)
	player:SetAttribute("PCAFK", requested and not participating)
	player:SetAttribute("PCAFKQueued", requested and participating)
	if participating and not (self:ActiveGame() == "StuckInTheMud" and player:GetAttribute("MDEliminated") == true) then self:_clearSpectate(player) end
end

function Coordinator:_clearSpectate(player)
	local entry = self.spectators[player]
	if not entry then return end
	self.spectators[player] = nil
	pcall(player.RemoveReplicationFocus, player, entry.root)
end

function Coordinator:_spectateTarget(player, userId)
	if player.Parent ~= Players then return nil end
	local active = self:ActiveGame()
	local eliminated = active == "StuckInTheMud" and player:GetAttribute("MDParticipating") == true and player:GetAttribute("MDEliminated") == true
	if self:_participating(player) and not eliminated then return nil end
	local service = active and self.services[active]
	local phase = service and service.state:GetAttribute("Phase")
	if not service or phase == "Waiting" or phase == "Results" or phase == "Intermission" then return nil end
	local target = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
	local attribute = ({ BritishBulldog = "BBParticipating", TagYoureIt = "TGParticipating", StuckInTheMud = "MDParticipating", HideAndSeek = "HSParticipating", DuckDuckGoose = "DGParticipating", SkippingRope = "SKParticipating" })[active]
	local character = target and target.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if target == player or not target or not target:GetAttribute(attribute) or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not root then return nil end
	if active == "SkippingRope" and target:GetAttribute("SKEliminated") == true then return nil end
	if active == "StuckInTheMud" and target:GetAttribute("MDEliminated") == true then return nil end
	return target, root
end

function Coordinator:SetSpectate(player, userId, stamp)
	local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	if player.Parent ~= Players or typeof(stamp) ~= "number" or stamp ~= stamp or math.abs(stamp - now) > 30
		or stamp <= (self.lastSpectateStamp[player] or -math.huge) then return { ok = false, message = "Expired spectate request." } end
	self.lastSpectateStamp[player] = stamp
	if userId == 0 then self:_clearSpectate(player) return { ok = true } end
	if typeof(userId) ~= "number" or userId ~= userId or userId % 1 ~= 0 then return { ok = false, message = "Invalid player." } end
	if now - (self.lastSpectateRequest[player] or -math.huge) < 0.2 then return { ok = false, message = "Please wait a moment." } end
	self.lastSpectateRequest[player] = now
	local target, root = self:_spectateTarget(player, userId)
	if not target then self:_clearSpectate(player) return { ok = false, message = "That player is no longer in the round." } end
	local entry = self.spectators[player]
	if not entry or entry.root ~= root then
		self:_clearSpectate(player)
		local ok = pcall(player.AddReplicationFocus, player, root)
		if not ok then return { ok = false, message = "Could not load that arena. Try again." } end
		entry = { userId = userId, root = root }
		self.spectators[player] = entry
	end
	entry.expiresAt = now + 12
	return { ok = true, position = root.Position }
end

function Coordinator:_updateSpectators()
	local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	for player, entry in pairs(self.spectators) do
		local target, root = self:_spectateTarget(player, entry.userId)
		local ownHumanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not target or root ~= entry.root or now >= entry.expiresAt or not ownHumanoid or ownHumanoid.Health <= 0 then self:_clearSpectate(player) end
	end
end

function Coordinator:SetAFK(player, enabled)
	if player.Parent ~= Players or typeof(enabled) ~= "boolean" then
		return { ok = false, message = "Invalid AFK request." }
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - (self.lastSessionRequest[player] or -math.huge) < 0.4 then
		return { ok = false, message = "Please wait a moment." }
	end
	self.lastSessionRequest[player] = now
	player:SetAttribute("PCAFKRequested", enabled)
	self:_syncAFK(player)
	if enabled then
		self.votes[player] = nil
		if self.padChoices then self.padChoices[player] = nil end
		player:SetAttribute("PCVote", "")
		self:_counts()
	end
	return {
		ok = true,
		afk = player:GetAttribute("PCAFK") == true,
		queued = player:GetAttribute("PCAFKQueued") == true,
		requested = enabled,
		message = enabled and (self:_participating(player) and "AFK after this round." or "AFK on. You will stay in the lobby.") or "AFK off. You can join the next round.",
	}
end

function Coordinator:_watchSessionPlayer(player)
	if self.sessionConnections[player] then return end
	player:SetAttribute("PCAFKRequested", false)
	player:SetAttribute("PCAFK", false)
	player:SetAttribute("PCAFKQueued", false)
	local connections = {}
	self.sessionConnections[player] = connections
	for _, name in ipairs({ "BBParticipating", "TGParticipating", "MDParticipating", "MDEliminated", "HSParticipating", "DGParticipating", "SKParticipating", "SKEliminated" }) do
		table.insert(connections, player:GetAttributeChangedSignal(name):Connect(function()
			self:_syncAFK(player)
		end))
	end
end

function Coordinator:_readyPlayers()
	local list = {}
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and not self:_afkRequested(player) and not self:_participating(player) and player:GetAttribute("PCDataReady") == true then
			table.insert(list, player)
		end
	end
	return list
end

function Coordinator:MinimumPlayers(id)
	local service=self.services[id]
	local minimum=service and service.arena and service.arena:GetAttribute("MinimumPlayers")
	if typeof(minimum)~="number" or minimum~=minimum or math.abs(minimum)==math.huge then minimum=2 end
	return math.max(2,math.floor(minimum))
end

function Coordinator:GameAvailable(id, readyCount)
	local service=self.services[id]
	if not service or service.running == false then return false end
	if id=="StuckInTheMud" and service.state:GetAttribute("GunAccessReady")==false then return false end
	return (readyCount or #self:_readyPlayers())>=self:MinimumPlayers(id)
end

function Coordinator:_availability(readyCount)
	self.state:SetAttribute("ReadyPlayerCount",readyCount)
	for _,id in ipairs(games) do
	 self.state:SetAttribute("Available"..id,self:GameAvailable(id,readyCount))
	 if self.services[id] then self.state:SetAttribute("Minimum"..id,self:MinimumPlayers(id)) end
	end
end

function Coordinator:_insideZone(player)
	local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then return false end
	local point = self.zone.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(root.Position)
	local half = self.zone.Size / 2
	return math.abs(point.X) <= half.X and math.abs(point.Y) <= half.Y and math.abs(point.Z) <= half.Z
end

function Coordinator:_counts()
	local counts = { BritishBulldog = 0, TagYoureIt = 0, StuckInTheMud = 0, HideAndSeek = 0, DuckDuckGoose = 0, SkippingRope = 0 }
	for player, id in pairs(self.votes) do
		if player.Parent == Players and not self:_afkRequested(player) and counts[id] then counts[id] += 1 end
	end
	for id, count in pairs(counts) do self.state:SetAttribute("Votes" .. id, count) end
	return counts
end

function Coordinator:_clearVotes()
	for player in pairs(self.votes) do if player.Parent == Players then player:SetAttribute("PCVote", "") end end
	table.clear(self.votes)
	self:_counts()
end

function Coordinator:SetAutoEnabled(enabled)
	self.autoEnabled = enabled == true
	self.votingEndsAt = 0
	self.startRetryAt = 0
	self.state:SetAttribute("LastRoundStartError", "")
	self.state:SetAttribute("IntermissionStatus", self.autoEnabled and "Waiting for ready players" or "Automatic rounds paused by an admin")
	self.state:SetAttribute("AutomaticRounds", self.autoEnabled)
	self.state:SetAttribute("VotingEndsAt", 0)
	if not self:ActiveGame() then
		self.state:SetAttribute("Phase", self.autoEnabled and "Waiting" or "Paused")
		self:_clearVotes()
	end
end

function Coordinator:Vote(player, id)
	if typeof(id) ~= "string" or not self.services[id] then return { ok = false, message = "Choose an available game." } end
	if self.state:GetAttribute("Phase") ~= "Voting" or self:ActiveGame() or not self.autoEnabled then return { ok = false, message = "Voting opens between rounds." } end
	if self:_afkRequested(player) then return { ok = false, message = "Turn AFK off before voting." } end
	if player:GetAttribute("PCDataReady") ~= true then return { ok = false, message = "Your player data is loading." } end
	if not self:GameAvailable(id) then return {ok=false,message="This game is not ready for the next round."} end
	if self:_participating(player) or not self:_insideZone(player) then return { ok = false, message = "Walk into the voting area first." } end
	local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return { ok = false, message = "Your character is loading." } end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - (self.lastVote[player] or -math.huge) < 0.35 then return { ok = false, message = "Please wait a moment." } end
	self.lastVote[player] = now
	self.votes[player] = id
	player:SetAttribute("PCVote", id)
	self:_counts()
	return { ok = true, message = "Vote saved." }
end

function Coordinator:StartGame(id, player, role, automatic)
	local service = self.services[id]
	if not service then return false, "This game is not available yet." end
	if self:ActiveGame() then return false, "A game is running. Stop it first." end
	if role and (not player or self:_afkRequested(player)) then return false, "Turn AFK off before starting practice." end
	local started, reason
	if role and not service.StartPractice then return false, "This game requires a normal round." end
	if role then started, reason = service:StartPractice(player, role)
	else started, reason = service:StartRound(self:_readyPlayers()) end
	if started then
		self.votingEndsAt = 0
		self.startRetryAt = 0
		self.state:SetAttribute("VotingEndsAt", 0)
		self.state:SetAttribute("LastRoundStartError", "")
		self.state:SetAttribute("IntermissionStatus", "")
		self:_clearVotes()
		self.lastGame = id
		self.state:SetAttribute("ActiveGame", id)
		self.state:SetAttribute("GameTitle", titles[id])
		self.state:SetAttribute("Phase", "Playing")
	end
	return started, reason
end

function Coordinator:StopGame()
	local stopped = false
	for _, id in ipairs(games) do
		if self.services[id] and self.services[id].active then self.services[id]:StopRound() stopped = true end
	end
	self:SetAutoEnabled(false)
	self.state:SetAttribute("ActiveGame", "")
	self.state:SetAttribute("GameTitle", "")
	return true, stopped and "Back in the lobby." or "Ready in the lobby."
end

function Coordinator:_chooseGame()
	local counts = self:_counts()
	local readyCount=#self:_readyPlayers()
	local maximum = 0
	for _, id in ipairs(games) do if self:GameAvailable(id,readyCount) then maximum = math.max(maximum, counts[id]) end end
	local tied = {}
	for _, id in ipairs(games) do if self:GameAvailable(id,readyCount) and counts[id] == maximum then table.insert(tied, id) end end
	if maximum == 0 and self.lastGame and #tied > 1 then
		local previous = table.find(tied, self.lastGame)
		if previous then table.remove(tied, previous) end
	end
	return #tied>0 and tied[self.random:NextInteger(1, #tied)] or nil
end

function Coordinator:_padVoting()
 self.padChoices=self.padChoices or {}
 if self.state:GetAttribute("Phase")~="Voting" then table.clear(self.padChoices) return end
 local choices=self.lobby.Gameplay:FindFirstChild("VoteChoices")
 if not choices then return end
 for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
  local root=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  local choice
  if root and not self:_afkRequested(player) and self:_insideZone(player) then
   for _,pad in ipairs(choices:GetChildren()) do
    if pad:IsA("BasePart") and pad:GetAttribute("Available")~=false then
     local point=pad.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(root.Position)
     local half=pad.Size/2
     if math.abs(point.X)<=half.X and math.abs(point.Y)<=half.Y and math.abs(point.Z)<=half.Z then choice=pad:GetAttribute("GameId") break end
    end
   end
  end
  if choice and not self:GameAvailable(choice) then choice=nil end
  if choice~=self.padChoices[player] then
   self.padChoices[player]=choice
   if choice then self:Vote(player,choice) end
  end
 end
end

function Coordinator:_step(now)
	self:_updateSpectators()
	local active = self:ActiveGame()
	local readyCount = #self:_readyPlayers()
	self:_availability(readyCount)
	local minimum, available = math.huge, false
	for _, id in ipairs(games) do
		local service = self.services[id]
		if service and service.running ~= false and not (id == "StuckInTheMud" and service.state:GetAttribute("GunAccessReady") == false) then
			minimum = math.min(minimum, self:MinimumPlayers(id))
			available = available or self:GameAvailable(id, readyCount)
		end
	end
	if minimum == math.huge then minimum = 2 end
	self.state:SetAttribute("MinimumReadyPlayers", minimum)
	if active then
		self.votingEndsAt, self.startRetryAt = 0, 0
		self.state:SetAttribute("Phase", "Playing")
		self.state:SetAttribute("ActiveGame", active)
		self.state:SetAttribute("GameTitle", titles[active])
		self.state:SetAttribute("VotingEndsAt", 0)
		self.state:SetAttribute("IntermissionStatus", "")
	elseif not self.autoEnabled then
		self.state:SetAttribute("Phase", "Paused")
		self.state:SetAttribute("ActiveGame", "")
		self.state:SetAttribute("GameTitle", "")
		self.state:SetAttribute("IntermissionStatus", "Automatic rounds paused by an admin")
	elseif not available then
		self.votingEndsAt, self.startRetryAt = 0, 0
		self.state:SetAttribute("Phase", "Waiting")
		self.state:SetAttribute("ActiveGame", "")
		self.state:SetAttribute("GameTitle", "")
		self.state:SetAttribute("VotingEndsAt", 0)
		self.state:SetAttribute("IntermissionStatus", readyCount < minimum
			and string.format("Waiting for ready players (%d/%d)", readyCount, minimum)
			or "Waiting for an available game")
		self:_clearVotes()
	elseif self.votingEndsAt == 0 then
		self:_clearVotes()
		self.votingEndsAt = now + INTERMISSION_SECONDS
		self.state:SetAttribute("Phase", "Voting")
		self.state:SetAttribute("ActiveGame", "")
		self.state:SetAttribute("GameTitle", "")
		self.state:SetAttribute("VotingEndsAt", self.votingEndsAt)
		self.state:SetAttribute("IntermissionStatus", "Next round starts in")
		self.state:SetAttribute("LastRoundStartError", "")
	elseif now >= self.votingEndsAt and now >= self.startRetryAt then
		local selected = self:_chooseGame()
		local ok, started, reason = pcall(self.StartGame, self, selected, nil, nil, true)
		if not ok or not started then
			local failure = tostring(ok and reason or started)
			self.startRetryAt = now + START_RETRY_SECONDS
			self.state:SetAttribute("IntermissionStatus", "Preparing the next round - retrying")
			self.state:SetAttribute("LastRoundStartError", failure)
			warn("Automatic round could not start: " .. failure)
		end
	end
	self:_padVoting()
end

function Coordinator:_loop()
	while self.running do
		self:_step(workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
		task.wait(0.25)
	end
end

function Coordinator:Start()
	if self.running then return end
	self.running = true
	self.state:SetAttribute("AutomaticRounds", self.autoEnabled)
	self.state:SetAttribute("IntermissionSeconds", INTERMISSION_SECONDS)
	self.state:SetAttribute("MinimumReadyPlayers", 2)
	self.state:SetAttribute("IntermissionStatus", "Waiting for ready players")
	self.state:SetAttribute("LastRoundStartError", "")
	self.state:SetAttribute("Phase", "Waiting")
	self.state:SetAttribute("ActiveGame", "")
	self.state:SetAttribute("VotingEndsAt", 0)
	self:_counts()
	local remote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PlaygroundVoteRequest")
	remote.OnServerInvoke = function(player, id) return self:Vote(player, id) end
	self.remote = remote
	local sessionRemote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PlaygroundSessionRequest")
	sessionRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(player, action, value, stamp)
		if action == "SetSpectate" then return self:SetSpectate(player, value, stamp) end
		if action ~= "SetAFK" then return { ok = false, message = "Invalid session request." } end
		return self:SetAFK(player, value)
	end
	self.sessionRemote = sessionRemote
	table.insert(self.connections, Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player) self:_watchSessionPlayer(player) end))
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do self:_watchSessionPlayer(player) end
	table.insert(self.connections, Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		self.votes[player] = nil
		self.lastVote[player] = nil
		self.lastSessionRequest[player] = nil
		self:_clearSpectate(player)
		self.lastSpectateStamp[player] = nil
		self.lastSpectateRequest[player] = nil
		for _, connection in ipairs(self.sessionConnections[player] or {}) do connection:Disconnect() end
		self.sessionConnections[player] = nil
		self:_counts()
	end))
	table.insert(self.connections, self.services.BritishBulldog.state:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Phase"):Connect(function() self:_rewardBulldog() end))
	table.insert(self.connections, self.services.TagYoureIt.state:GetAttributeChangedSignal("LastResultRound"):Connect(function() self:_rewardTag() end))
	if self.services.StuckInTheMud then table.insert(self.connections,self.services.StuckInTheMud.state:GetAttributeChangedSignal("LastResultRound"):Connect(function() self:_rewardMud() end)) end
	if self.services.HideAndSeek then table.insert(self.connections, self.services.HideAndSeek.state:GetAttributeChangedSignal("LastResultRound"):Connect(function() self:_rewardHideAndSeek() end)) end
	if self.services.DuckDuckGoose then table.insert(self.connections, self.services.DuckDuckGoose.state:GetAttributeChangedSignal("LastResultRound"):Connect(function() self:_rewardDuckDuckGoose() end)) end
	if self.services.SkippingRope then table.insert(self.connections, self.services.SkippingRope.state:GetAttributeChangedSignal("LastResultRound"):Connect(function() self:_rewardSkippingRope() end)) end
	task.spawn(function() self:_loop() end)
end

function Coordinator:Stop()
	self.running = false
	self:StopGame()
	for _, connection in ipairs(self.connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
	if self.remote then self.remote.OnServerInvoke = nil end
	if self.sessionRemote then self.sessionRemote.OnServerInvoke = nil end
	for player in pairs(self.spectators) do self:_clearSpectate(player) end
	table.clear(self.lastSpectateStamp)
	table.clear(self.lastSpectateRequest)
	for player, connections in pairs(self.sessionConnections) do
		for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
		if player.Parent == Players then
			player:SetAttribute("PCAFKRequested", false)
			player:SetAttribute("PCAFK", false)
			player:SetAttribute("PCAFKQueued", false)
		end
	end
	table.clear(self.sessionConnections)
	table.clear(self.lastSessionRequest)
end

return Coordinator

local function boundedInteger(value, minimum, maximum)
	return typeof(value) == "number" and value == value and value % 1 == 0 and value >= minimum and value <= maximum
end

local function integer(value, fallback)
	if typeof(value) ~= "number" or value ~= value or math.abs(value) == math.huge then return fallback end
	return math.clamp(math.floor(value), 0, 1000000000)
end

local function timestamp(value)
	if typeof(value) ~= "number" or value ~= value or math.abs(value) == math.huge then return 0 end
	return math.clamp(math.floor(value), 0, 1000000000000)
end
