function Equipment:_cancelBatHit(record)
	if not record.batGame then return end
	local service = self:_batService(record.batGame)
	if service and service.CancelBatSwing then service:CancelBatSwing(record.player) end
end

function Equipment:_activateBat(record)
	local tool = record.bat
	local gameId = self:_weaponGame(record.player)
	if not tool or not tool.Enabled or tool.Parent ~= record.character or record.player.Character ~= record.character
		or not gameId or record.batGame ~= gameId or record.player:GetAttribute("PCDataReady") ~= true
		or record.player:GetAttribute("BBRagdolled") == true or record.player:GetAttribute("TGRagdolled") == true or record.player:GetAttribute("HSRagdolled") == true or record.player:GetAttribute("DGRagdolled") == true then return false end
	local service = self:_batService(gameId)
	if not service or not service.TryBatSwing then return false end
	local accepted = service:TryBatSwing(record.player)
	if accepted then
		tool:SetAttribute("BatSwingAt", workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
		task.delay(0.5, function() if not record.closed then self:_queue(record) end end)
	end
	return accepted == true
end

function Equipment:_clearBat(record)
	if record.character then
		record.character:SetAttribute("PCBatHeld", false)
		record.character:SetAttribute("PCBatGame", nil)
	end
	self:_cancelBatHit(record)
	if record.batConnections then disconnect(record.batConnections) end
	local model = record.bat
	record.bat = nil
	record.batId = nil
	record.batGame = nil
	if model then model:Destroy() end
end

function Equipment:_reconcileToys(record, keep)
	local containers = { record.character, record.player.Character, record.player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack"), record.player:FindFirstChild("StarterGear") }
	local seen = {}
	for _, container in pairs(containers) do
		if container and not seen[container] then
			seen[container] = true
			for _, child in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
				if child:IsA("Tool") and child ~= keep then
					local item = Catalog.ById[child:GetAttribute("CatalogId")]
					local toy = child:GetAttribute("PCToy") == true
						or child:GetAttribute("PCCosmeticEquipment") == true and item and item.slot == "Gear"
					if toy then child:Destroy() end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function Equipment:_toyAllowed(record)
	return not record.roundPreparing and not participating(record.player) and self.toys and self.toys:CanHold(record.player) == true
end

function Equipment:_clearGear(record)
	if self.toys then self.toys:CancelAction(record.player) end
	if record.character then record.character:SetAttribute("PCToyHeld", nil) end
	disconnect(record.gearConnections)
	local tool = record.gear
	record.gear = nil
	record.gearId = nil
	if tool then tool:Destroy() end
	self:_reconcileToys(record, nil)
end

function Equipment:_queue(record)
	if not self.running or record.closed or record.queued then return end
	record.queued = true
	task.defer(function()
		record.queued = false
		if self.running and not record.closed then self:_refresh(record) end
	end)
end

function Equipment:_makeBat(record, item, hand, original, gameId)
	local visual = original:Clone()
	local low, high = visibleBounds(visual)
	if not low then visual:Destroy() return end
	local size = high - low
	local grip = Vector3.new((low.X + high.X) * 0.5, low.Y + math.min(size.Y * 0.14, 0.42), (low.Z + high.Z) * 0.5)
	local carrier = Instance.new("Tool")
	carrier.Name = item.name
	carrier.ToolTip = "Click / tap to swing"
	carrier.RequiresHandle = true
	carrier.CanBeDropped = false
	carrier.ManualActivationOnly = false
	carrier.Grip = CFrame.identity
	carrier:SetAttribute("PCCosmeticEquipment", true)
	carrier:SetAttribute("PCBatWeapon", true)
	carrier:SetAttribute("WeaponGame", gameId)
	carrier:SetAttribute("BatSwingAt", 0)
	carrier:SetAttribute("CatalogId", item.id)
	local anchor = anchorPart("Handle")
	anchor.Parent = carrier
	local palm = Instance.new("Attachment")
	palm.Name = "RightGripAttachment"
	palm.CFrame = carrier.Grip
	palm.Parent = anchor
	visual.Name = "Visual"
	visual:PivotTo(CFrame.new(-grip) * visual:GetPivot())
	visual.Parent = carrier
	weldModel(visual, anchor)
	self:_attachBatEffects(carrier, anchor, item, size, math.min(size.Y * 0.14, 0.42))
	record.bat = carrier
	record.batId = item.id
	record.batGame = gameId
	record.batConnections = record.batConnections or {}
	local function mirrorHeld(held)
		if record.bat ~= carrier or not record.character then return end
		record.character:SetAttribute("PCBatHeld", held)
		record.character:SetAttribute("PCBatGame", held and gameId or nil)
	end
	table.insert(record.batConnections, carrier.Equipped:Connect(function() mirrorHeld(true) end))
	table.insert(record.batConnections, carrier.Activated:Connect(function() self:_activateBat(record) end))
	table.insert(record.batConnections, carrier.Unequipped:Connect(function()
		mirrorHeld(false)
		self:_cancelBatHit(record)
		self:_queue(record)
	end))
	table.insert(record.batConnections, carrier.Destroying:Connect(function() mirrorHeld(false) self:_cancelBatHit(record) end))
	local humanoid = record.character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	carrier.Parent = record.player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") or record.character
	if humanoid then humanoid:EquipTool(carrier) end
	mirrorHeld(carrier.Parent == record.character)
end

function Equipment:_makeGear(record, item, backpack, original)
	local visual = original:Clone()
	local low, high = visibleBounds(visual)
	if not low then visual:Destroy() return end
	local center = (low + high) * 0.5
	local size = high - low
	local grip = Vector3.new(center.X, low.Y + math.min(size.Y * 0.25, 0.45), center.Z + size.Z * 0.2)
	visual:PivotTo(CFrame.new(-grip) * visual:GetPivot())
	local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
	tool.Name = item.name
	tool.ToolTip = item.name .. " · lobby toy"
	tool.RequiresHandle = true
	tool.CanBeDropped = false
	tool.Enabled = true
	tool.ManualActivationOnly = true
	tool.Grip = CFrame.new(0, -0.15, 0)
	tool:SetAttribute("PCCosmeticEquipment", true)
	tool:SetAttribute("CatalogId", item.id)
	tool:SetAttribute("PCToy", true)
	local handle = anchorPart("Handle")
	handle.Parent = tool
	visual.Name = "Visual"
	visual.Parent = tool
	weldModel(visual, handle)
	record.gear = tool
	record.gearId = item.id
	local function mirrorHeld(held)
		if record.gear ~= tool or not record.character then return end
		record.character:SetAttribute("PCToyHeld", held and item.id or nil)
		if self.toys then
			if held then self.toys:Hold(record.player) else self.toys:CancelAction(record.player) end
		end
	end
	table.insert(record.gearConnections, tool.Equipped:Connect(function()
		if not self:_toyAllowed(record) then self:_clearGear(record) self:_queue(record) else mirrorHeld(true) end
	end))
	table.insert(record.gearConnections, tool.Unequipped:Connect(function() mirrorHeld(false) end))
	if item.id == "M14" then
		local flame = anchorPart("TorchFlame")
		flame.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, size.Y - math.min(size.Y * 0.25, 0.45), -size.Z * 0.2)
		flame.Parent = tool
		local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
		weld.Part0, weld.Part1, weld.Parent = handle, flame, flame
		local fire = Instance.new("Fire")
		fire.Name, fire.Size, fire.Heat, fire.Parent = "CampFlame", 2.4, 3, flame
		local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
		light.Color, light.Brightness, light.Range, light.Parent = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 70), 0.6, 9, flame
	end
	table.insert(record.gearConnections, tool.AncestryChanged:Connect(function() self:_queue(record) end))
	tool.Parent = backpack
	local humanoid = record.character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if humanoid then humanoid:EquipTool(tool) end
	mirrorHeld(tool.Parent == record.character)
end

function Equipment:_refresh(record)
	if participating(record.player) then
		record.roundPreparing = false
		record.player:SetAttribute("PCToyRoundPreparing", false)
	end
	self:_reconcileToys(record, record.gear)
	local player = record.player
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local ready = player:GetAttribute("PCDataReady") == true
	if character ~= record.character or not ready or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		if self.toys then self.toys:ClearPlayer(player) end
		self:_clearBat(record)
		self:_clearGear(record)
		return
	end
	local assets = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("PlaygroundCosmeticAssets")
	local batId = player:GetAttribute("PCBat")
	local bat = (typeof(batId) == "string" and Catalog.ById[batId]) or Catalog.ById.B01
	local gameId = self:_weaponGame(player)
	local ragdolled = player:GetAttribute("BBRagdolled") == true or player:GetAttribute("TGRagdolled") == true or player:GetAttribute("HSRagdolled") == true or player:GetAttribute("DGRagdolled") == true
	local hand = character:FindFirstChild("RightHand") or character:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")
	local batAsset = bat and assets and assets:FindFirstChild(bat.id)
	if not gameId or ragdolled or not bat or bat.slot ~= "Bat" or bat.available == false or not hand or not hand:IsA("BasePart") or not batAsset or not batAsset:IsA("Model") then
		local at = record.bat and record.bat:GetAttribute("BatSwingAt")
		local tagState = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("TagState")
		local finishing = record.batGame == "TagYoureIt" and player:GetAttribute("TGParticipating") == true and player:GetAttribute("TGRole") == "Runner"
			and not ragdolled and tagState and tagState:GetAttribute("Phase") == "Playing" and typeof(at) == "number" and workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - at < 0.48
		if finishing then record.bat.Enabled = false self:_cancelBatHit(record) else self:_clearBat(record) end
	elseif record.batId ~= bat.id or record.batGame ~= gameId or not record.bat or record.bat.Parent ~= character then
		self:_clearBat(record)
		self:_makeBat(record, bat, hand, batAsset, gameId)
	else
		record.bat.Enabled = true
		character:SetAttribute("PCBatHeld", true)
		character:SetAttribute("PCBatGame", gameId)
	end
	local toyAllowed = self:_toyAllowed(record)
	if not toyAllowed and self.toys then self.toys:ClearPlayer(player) end
	local gearId = player:GetAttribute("PCGear")
	local gear = typeof(gearId) == "string" and Catalog.ById[gearId]
	local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	local gearAsset = gear and assets and assets:FindFirstChild(gear.id)
	if not toyAllowed or not gear or gear.slot ~= "Gear" or gear.available == false or not backpack or not gearAsset or not gearAsset:IsA("Model") then
		self:_clearGear(record)
	elseif record.gearId ~= gear.id or not record.gear or (record.gear.Parent ~= backpack and record.gear.Parent ~= character) then
		self:_clearGear(record)
		self:_makeGear(record, gear, backpack, gearAsset)
	elseif record.gear.Parent ~= character then
		humanoid:EquipTool(record.gear)
		character:SetAttribute("PCToyHeld", gear.id)
		if self.toys then self.toys:Hold(player) end
	end
end

function Equipment:_bindCharacter(record, character)
	disconnect(record.characterConnections)
	if self.toys then self.toys:ClearPlayer(record.player) end
	self:_clearBat(record)
	self:_clearGear(record)
	record.character = character
	character:SetAttribute("PCBatHeld", false)
	character:SetAttribute("PCBatGame", nil)
	record.humanoid = nil
	local function bindHumanoid()
		local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid and record.humanoid ~= humanoid then
			record.humanoid = humanoid
			table.insert(record.characterConnections, humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
				if self.toys then self.toys:ClearPlayer(record.player) end
				self:_clearBat(record)
				self:_clearGear(record)
			end))
		end
	end
	bindHumanoid()
	table.insert(record.characterConnections, character.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
		if child:IsA("Tool") and child:GetAttribute("PCToy") == true and not self:_toyAllowed(record) then self:_clearGear(record) end
		bindHumanoid()
		self:_queue(record)
	end))
	table.insert(record.characterConnections, character.ChildRemoved:Connect(function()
		self:_queue(record)
	end))
	self:_queue(record)
end

function Equipment:_bindBackpack(record, backpack)
	disconnect(record.backpackConnections)
	record.backpack = backpack
	if not backpack then return end
	table.insert(record.backpackConnections, backpack.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
		if child:IsA("Tool") and child:GetAttribute("PCToy") == true and not self:_toyAllowed(record) then self:_clearGear(record) end
		self:_queue(record)
	end))
	table.insert(record.backpackConnections, backpack.ChildRemoved:Connect(function() self:_queue(record) end))
	self:_reconcileToys(record, record.gear)
	self:_queue(record)
end

function Equipment:_addPlayer(player)
	if self.records[player] then return end
	local record = { player = player, connections = {}, characterConnections = {}, gearConnections = {}, batConnections = {}, backpackConnections = {}, closed = false }
	self.records[player] = record
	table.insert(record.connections, player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("PCBatHitSerial"):Connect(function() self:_batHitEffect(record) end))
	for _, attribute in ipairs({ "PCBat", "PCGear", "PCDataReady", "BBRole", "BBParticipating", "TGRole", "TGParticipating", "MDParticipating", "BBRagdolled", "TGRagdolled", "HSParticipating", "DGParticipating", "DGEliminated", "SKParticipating", "SKEliminated", "HSRole", "HSRagdolled", "DGRole", "DGRagdolled" }) do
		table.insert(record.connections, player:GetAttributeChangedSignal(attribute):Connect(function()
			if participating(player) then
				record.roundPreparing = false
				player:SetAttribute("PCToyRoundPreparing", false)
				if self.toys then self.toys:ClearPlayer(player) end
				self:_clearGear(record)
			end
			self:_queue(record)
		end))
	end
	table.insert(record.connections, player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character) self:_bindCharacter(record, character) end))
	table.insert(record.connections, player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(character)
		if character == record.character then
			if self.toys then self.toys:ClearPlayer(record.player) end
			disconnect(record.characterConnections)
			self:_clearBat(record)
			self:_clearGear(record)
			record.character = nil
		end
	end))
	table.insert(record.connections, player.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
		if child:IsA("Backpack") then self:_bindBackpack(record, child) end
	end))
	self:_bindBackpack(record, player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack"))
	if player.Character then self:_bindCharacter(record, player.Character) end
end

function Equipment:_removePlayer(player)
	local record = self.records[player]
	if not record then return end
	record.closed = true
	if self.toys then self.toys:ClearPlayer(player) end
	disconnect(record.connections)
	disconnect(record.characterConnections)
	disconnect(record.backpackConnections)
	player:SetAttribute("PCToyRoundPreparing", false)
	self:_clearBat(record)
	self:_clearGear(record)
	self.records[player] = nil
end

function Equipment:UseToy(player, aim)
	local record = self.records[player]
	if not self.running or not record or record.closed or not self.toys then return { ok = false, message = "Toys are loading." } end
	if not self:_toyAllowed(record) then
		self.toys:ClearPlayer(player)
		self:_clearGear(record)
		return { ok = false, message = "Toys are for the lobby." }
	end
	return self.toys:Use(player, record.gear, aim)
end

function Equipment:PrepareRound(selected)
	local players = typeof(selected) == "Instance" and { selected } or selected or Players:GetPlayers()
	for _, player in ipairs(players) do
		if player.Parent == Players then
			local record = self.records[player]
			if record then
				record.roundPreparing = true
				record.prepareSerial = (record.prepareSerial or 0) + 1
				local serial = record.prepareSerial
				player:SetAttribute("PCToyRoundPreparing", true)
				self:_clearGear(record)
				task.delay(3, function()
					if self.running and not record.closed and record.prepareSerial == serial and not participating(player) then
						record.roundPreparing = false
						player:SetAttribute("PCToyRoundPreparing", false)
						self:_queue(record)
					end
				end)
			end
			if self.toys then self.toys:ClearPlayer(player) end
		end
	end
end

function Equipment:Start()
	if self.running then return self end
	self.running = true
	for _, name in ipairs({ "BritishBulldogState", "TagState", "HideAndSeekState", "DuckDuckGooseState" }) do
		local state = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild(name)
		if state then
			for _, attribute in { "Phase", "TurnPhase" } do
				table.insert(self.connections, state:GetAttributeChangedSignal(attribute):Connect(function()
					for _, record in pairs(self.records) do self:_queue(record) end
				end))
			end
		end
	end
	table.insert(self.connections, Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player) self:_addPlayer(player) end))
	table.insert(self.connections, Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player) self:_removePlayer(player) end))
	local assets = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("PlaygroundCosmeticAssets")
	if assets then
		table.insert(self.connections, assets.ChildAdded:Connect(function()
			for _, record in pairs(self.records) do self:_queue(record) end
		end))
	end
	local elapsed = 0
	table.insert(self.connections, game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		elapsed += dt
		if elapsed < 0.25 then return end
		elapsed = 0
		for _, record in pairs(self.records) do
			local allowed = self:_toyAllowed(record) == true
			if record.toyAllowed ~= allowed then
				record.toyAllowed = allowed
				if not allowed then
					if self.toys then self.toys:ClearPlayer(record.player) end
					self:_clearGear(record)
				end
				self:_queue(record)
			end
		end
	end))
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do self:_addPlayer(player) end
	return self
end

function Equipment:Stop()
	self.running = false
	disconnect(self.connections)
	local players = {}
	for player in pairs(self.records) do table.insert(players, player) end
	for _, player in ipairs(players) do self:_removePlayer(player) end
end

return Equipment

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Fishing = {}
Fishing.__index = Fishing

local function characterOf(player)
	if player.Parent ~= Players or player:GetAttribute("PCDataReady") ~= true
		or player:GetAttribute("BBParticipating") == true or player:GetAttribute("TGParticipating") == true
		or ( player:GetAttribute("MDParticipating") == true or player:GetAttribute("HSParticipating") == true or player:GetAttribute("DGParticipating") == true or player:GetAttribute("DGEliminated") == true or player:GetAttribute("SKParticipating") == true or player:GetAttribute("SKEliminated") == true ) then return nil end
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not root then return nil end
	return character, root
end

function Fishing.new(scene, economy)
	local self = setmetatable({ scene = scene, economy = economy, stations = {}, runs = {}, requests = {}, connections = {}, running = false }, Fishing)
	for index = 1, 4 do
		local model = assert(scene:FindFirstChild("Rod" .. index), "Fishing rod is missing")
		local interaction = assert(model:FindFirstChild("Interaction"), "Fishing interaction is missing")
		local prompt = assert(interaction:FindFirstChild("Fish"), "Fishing prompt is missing")
		local bobber = assert(model:FindFirstChild("Bobber"), "Fishing bobber is missing")
		table.insert(self.stations, { model = model, interaction = interaction, prompt = prompt, bobber = bobber, rest = bobber.CFrame })
	end
	return self
end

function Fishing:_tell(player, message)
	if player.Parent ~= Players then return end
	player:SetAttribute("PCRewardText", message)
	player:SetAttribute("PCRewardAt", workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
end

function Fishing:_valid(player, station, character)
	local current, root = characterOf(player)
	return current ~= nil and (character == nil or current == character)
		and station.model:IsDescendantOf(self.scene) and station.interaction.Parent ~= nil
		and (root.Position - station.interaction.Position).Magnitude <= 10
end

function Fishing:_finish(player, run, message)
	if self.runs[player] ~= run then return end
	self.runs[player] = nil
	local station = run.station
	if station.run == run then
		station.run = nil
		if station.bobber.Parent then station.bobber.CFrame = station.rest end
		if station.prompt.Parent then station.prompt.Enabled = self.running end
		if station.model.Parent then station.model:SetAttribute("FishingUserId", nil) end
	end
	if player.Parent == Players then
		player:SetAttribute("PCFishingCasting", false)
		player:SetAttribute("PCFishingCastEnds", 0)
		if message then self:_tell(player, message) end
	end
end

function Fishing:_begin(player, station)
	if not self.running or station.run or self.runs[player] or not self:_valid(player, station) then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - (self.requests[player] or -math.huge) < 0.75 then return end
	self.requests[player] = now
	local ok, reason = self.economy:CanFish(player)
	if not ok then self:_tell(player, reason or "Fishing isn't available right now.") return end
	if station.run or self.runs[player] or not self.running or not self:_valid(player, station) then return end
	local run = { station = station, character = player.Character, started = os.clock(), claiming = false }
	self.runs[player], station.run = run, run
	station.prompt.Enabled = false
	station.model:SetAttribute("FishingUserId", player.UserId)
	player:SetAttribute("PCFishingCasting", true)
	player:SetAttribute("PCFishingCastEnds", workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + 6)
	self:_tell(player, "Fishing... stay by the rod until you get a bite!")
end

function Fishing:_claim(player, run)
	if run.claiming or self.runs[player] ~= run or not self.running then return end
	if not self:_valid(player, run.station, run.character) then self:_finish(player, run, "Fishing cancelled. Your catch wasn't used.") return end
	run.claiming = true
	local called, ok, message = pcall(function() return self.economy:ClaimFishingReward(player) end)
	if not called then
		warn("Fishing reward could not finish: " .. tostring(ok))
		message = "Your catch couldn't be confirmed. Please try the rod again."
	elseif typeof(message) ~= "string" then
		message = ok and "Caught a five-minute boost!" or "Your catch couldn't be confirmed. Try again."
	end
	self:_finish(player, run, message)
end

function Fishing:_step(now)
	for player, run in self.runs do
		if run.claiming then continue end
		if not self:_valid(player, run.station, run.character) then
			self:_finish(player, run, "Fishing cancelled. Your catch wasn't used.")
		else
			local elapsed = now - run.started
			local dip = elapsed > 4.8 and -0.22 or 0
			run.station.bobber.CFrame = run.station.rest * CFrame.new(0, math.sin(elapsed * 5) * 0.055 + dip, 0)
			if elapsed >= 6 then
				run.claiming = true
				task.spawn(function()
					run.claiming = false
					self:_claim(player, run)
				end)
			end
		end
	end
end

function Fishing:Start()
	if self.running then return self end
	self.running = true
	for _, station in self.stations do
		station.prompt.Enabled = true
		station.model:SetAttribute("FishingUserId", nil)
		table.insert(self.connections, station.prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player) self:_begin(player, station) end))
	end
	table.insert(self.connections, Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		local run = self.runs[player]
		if run then self:_finish(player, run) end
		self.requests[player] = nil
	end))
	local elapsed = 0
	table.insert(self.connections, RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		elapsed += dt
		if elapsed >= 0.08 then elapsed = 0 self:_step(os.clock()) end
	end))
	return self
end

function Fishing:Stop()
	self.running = false
	for _, connection in self.connections do connection:Disconnect() end
	table.clear(self.connections)
	for player, run in self.runs do self:_finish(player, run) end
	table.clear(self.requests)
	for _, station in self.stations do
		if station.prompt.Parent then station.prompt.Enabled = false end
		if station.bobber.Parent then station.bobber.CFrame = station.rest end
	end
end

return Fishing

}
local regionNames = { Europe = "Europe", NorthAmerica = "North America", SouthAmerica = "South America", Africa = "Africa", Asia = "Asia", Oceania = "Oceania" }

local function integer(value, fallback)
	if typeof(value) ~= "number" or value ~= value or math.abs(value) == math.huge then return fallback end
	return math.clamp(math.floor(value), 0, 1000000000)
end

local function validUserId(value)
	return typeof(value) == "number" and value == value and value > 0 and value < 1000000000000 and value % 1 == 0
end

local function ranked(a, b)
	return a.value > b.value or (a.value == b.value and a.userId < b.userId)
end

local function child(parent, name, className)
	local object = assert(parent:FindFirstChild(name), parent:GetFullName() .. "." .. name .. " is missing")
	assert(object:IsA(className), object:GetFullName() .. " must be a " .. className)
	return object
end

function Service.new(lobby, dependencies)
	local root = child(lobby, "Leaderboards", "Model")
	dependencies = dependencies or {}
	local self = setmetatable({ lobby = lobby, root = root, boards = {}, queue = {}, published = {}, identities = {}, identityBusy = {}, running = false, isStudio = RunService:IsStudio(), writeBusy = false, generation = 0, nextWriteAt = 0, nextReadAt = 0, flushDeadline = 0, regions = {}, regionLookups = {}, saved = {}, connections = {}, resolveRegion = dependencies.resolveRegion, resolveEmote = dependencies.resolveEmote }, Service)
	for _, definition in ipairs(definitions) do
		local model = child(root, definition.name, "Model")
		local gui = child(child(model, "Face", "BasePart"), "Display", "SurfaceGui")
		local body = child(gui, "Body", "Frame")
		child(gui, "Empty", "TextLabel")
		child(gui, "Status", "TextLabel")
		local board = { definition = definition, gui = gui, rows = {}, entries = {}, state = "loading", status = "GLOBAL · CONNECTING", emptyText = "Scores are loading", refreshAt = 0 }
		for index = 1, 10 do
			local row = child(body, string.format("Row%02d", index), "Frame")
			for _, name in ipairs({ "Rank", "PlayerName", "Value" }) do child(row, name, "TextLabel") end
			child(child(row, "Avatar", "ImageLabel"), "Placeholder", "TextLabel")
			board.rows[index] = row
		end
		table.insert(self.boards, board)
	end
	self.global = { id = "global", label = "GLOBAL", boards = self.boards, queue = self.queue, published = self.published }
	return self
end

function Service:_level(xp)
	xp = integer(xp, 0)
	local base = math.max(1, integer(self.lobby:GetAttribute("BaseLevelXP"), 200))
	local step = integer(self.lobby:GetAttribute("LevelXPStep"), 50)
	local completed = 0
	local function cost(count) return count * base + step * count * (count - 1) / 2 end
	if step == 0 then
		completed = math.floor(xp / base)
	elseif xp > 0 then
		local linear = base - step / 2
		local root = math.sqrt(linear * linear + 2 * step * xp)
		completed = math.floor(linear >= 0 and 2 * xp / (root + linear) or (root - linear) / step)
		if cost(completed) > xp then completed = math.max(0, completed - 1) end
		if cost(completed + 1) <= xp then completed += 1 end
	end
	return completed + 1
end

function Service:_identity(userId)
	local cached = self.identities[userId]
	if cached and cached.expires > os.clock() then return cached end
	local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
	local name = player and player.Name or (cached and cached.name) or "Player " .. userId
	if self.identityBusy[userId] then return cached or { name = name, image = "" } end
	self.identityBusy[userId] = true
	local nameOk = player ~= nil
	if not nameOk then
		local ok, value = pcall(function() return Players:GetNameFromUserIdAsync(userId) end)
		if ok and typeof(value) == "string" then name, nameOk = value, true end
	end
	local image = cached and cached.image or ""
	local ok, value, ready = pcall(function() return Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(userId, Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot, Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size100x100) end)
	if ok and ready and typeof(value) == "string" then image = value end
	cached = { name = name, image = image, expires = os.clock() + (nameOk and ok and ready and 600 or 30) }
	self.identities[userId] = cached
	self.identityBusy[userId] = nil
	return cached
end

function Service:_render(board, entries, status, state, emptyText)
	board.entries = entries
	board.status = status
	board.state = state or "ready"
	board.emptyText = emptyText or (self.isStudio and "No players yet" or "Your next win could put you here!")
	if not board.gui then return end
	for index, row in ipairs(board.rows) do
		local entry = entries[index]
		row.Visible = entry ~= nil
		if entry then
			row:SetAttribute("UserId", entry.userId)
			row.Rank.Text = tostring(index)
			row.PlayerName.Text = entry.name or ("Player " .. entry.userId)
			row.Avatar.Image = entry.image or ""
			row.Avatar.Placeholder.Visible = row.Avatar.Image == ""
			row.Value.Text = board.definition.stat == "XP" and ("LV " .. self:_level(entry.value)) or tostring(entry.value)
		end
	end
	board.gui.Empty.Visible = #entries == 0
	board.gui.Empty.Text = board.emptyText
	board.gui.Status.Text = status
end

function Service:_scopes()
	local result = { self.global }
	for _, region in pairs(self.regions) do table.insert(result, region) end
	return result
end

function Service:_connectStores()
	if self.isStudio then return end
	for _, scope in ipairs(self:_scopes()) do
		for _, board in ipairs(scope.boards) do
			if not board.store and os.clock() >= (board.connectAt or 0) then
				board.connectAt = os.clock() + 30
				local ok, store = pcall(function() return DataStoreService:GetOrderedDataStore(board.definition.store) end)
				if ok then board.store = store end
			end
		end
	end
end

function Service:_serverEntries(stat, regionId)
	local entries = {}
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local region = self.regionLookups[player.UserId]
		if validUserId(player.UserId) and player:GetAttribute("PCDataReady") == true
			and (not regionId or (region and region.id == regionId)) then
			local cached = self.identities[player.UserId]
			table.insert(entries, { userId = player.UserId, value = integer(player:GetAttribute("PC" .. stat), 0), name = player.Name, image = cached and cached.image or "" })
		end
	end
	table.sort(entries, ranked)
	while #entries > 10 do table.remove(entries) end
	return entries
end

function Service:_refresh(board, generation, scope)
	scope = scope or self.global
	local entries = {}
	if self.isStudio then
		entries = self:_serverEntries(board.definition.stat, scope.id ~= "global" and scope.id or nil)
	else
		local ok, page = pcall(function()
			assert(board.store, "Leaderboard store unavailable")
			return board.store:GetSortedAsync(false, 10, 1):GetCurrentPage()
		end)
		if not self.running or self.generation ~= generation then return end
		if not ok then
			self:_render(board, board.entries, scope.label .. (#board.entries > 0 and " · RECONNECTING" or " · UNAVAILABLE RIGHT NOW"), #board.entries > 0 and "stale" or "unavailable", "Scores will appear when connected")
			return
		end
		for _, entry in ipairs(page) do
			local userId, value = tonumber(entry.key), integer(entry.value, nil)
			if validUserId(userId) and value then table.insert(entries, { userId = userId, value = value }) end
		end
	end
	table.sort(entries, ranked)
	while #entries > 10 do table.remove(entries) end
	for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
		local identity = self:_identity(entry.userId)
		if not self.running or self.generation ~= generation then return end
		entry.name, entry.image = identity.name, identity.image
	end
	if not self.running or self.generation ~= generation then return end
	self:_render(board, entries, self.isStudio and (scope.id == "global" and "THIS SERVER · STUDIO PREVIEW" or scope.label .. " · STUDIO PREVIEW") or scope.label .. " · UPDATES EVERY MINUTE", "ready", self.isStudio and "No players yet" or scope.id ~= "global" and "Regional scores appear as players play and save" or nil)
end

function Service:_queueScores(scope, userId, scores)
	local xp, wins = scores.XP, scores.Wins
	local published = scope.published[userId] or { XP = 0, Wins = 0 }
	if xp <= published.XP and wins <= published.Wins then return true end
	local pending = scope.queue[userId]
	if pending then
		pending.XP, pending.Wins = math.max(pending.XP, xp), math.max(pending.Wins, wins)
	else
		scope.queue[userId] = { XP = xp, Wins = wins, due = os.clock(), attempts = 0 }
	end
	return true
end

function Service:_region(id)
	local region = self.regions[id]
	if region then return region end
	region = { id = id, label = "REGION · " .. string.upper(regionNames[id]), boards = {}, queue = {}, published = {} }
	for _, definition in ipairs(definitions) do
		table.insert(region.boards, {
			definition = { name = definition.name, stat = definition.stat, store = definition.store .. "_Region_" .. id },
			rows = {}, entries = {}, refreshAt = 0, state = "loading", status = region.label .. " · CONNECTING", emptyText = "Regional scores are loading",
		})
	end
	self.regions[id] = region
	return region
end

function Service:_resolvePlayer(player, generation)
	local userId = player.UserId
	if not validUserId(userId) then return end
	local lookup = self.regionLookups[userId]
	if not lookup then
		lookup = { state = "loading", attempts = 0, retryAt = 0 }
		self.regionLookups[userId] = lookup
	end
	if lookup.id or lookup.busy or lookup.state == "unavailable" or os.clock() < lookup.retryAt then return end
	if typeof(self.resolveRegion) ~= "function" then lookup.state = "unavailable" return end
	lookup.busy = true
	lookup.attempts += 1
	task.spawn(function()
		local ok, region = pcall(self.resolveRegion, player)
		lookup.busy = false
		if not self.running or self.generation ~= generation then return end
		if ok and typeof(region) == "table" and regionNames[region.id] then
			lookup.id, lookup.state = region.id, "ready"
			local scope = self:_region(region.id)
			if not self.isStudio and self.saved[userId] then self:_queueScores(scope, userId, self.saved[userId]) end
		elseif ok or lookup.attempts >= 3 then
			lookup.state = "unavailable"
		else
			lookup.retryAt = os.clock() + 15 * lookup.attempts
		end
	end)
end

function Service:PublishSaved(userId, profile)
	if self.isStudio or not validUserId(userId) or typeof(profile) ~= "table" then return false end
	local xp, wins = integer(profile.XP, nil), integer(profile.Wins, nil)
	if xp == nil or wins == nil then return false end
	local saved = self.saved[userId]
	self.saved[userId] = { XP = math.max(saved and saved.XP or 0, xp), Wins = math.max(saved and saved.Wins or 0, wins) }
	self:_queueScores(self.global, userId, self.saved[userId])
	local lookup = self.regionLookups[userId]
	if lookup and lookup.id then
		self:_queueScores(self:_region(lookup.id), userId, self.saved[userId])
	elseif self.running then
		local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
		if player then self:_resolvePlayer(player, self.generation) end
	end
	return true
end

function Service:_writeOne(generation, deadline)
	if self.writeBusy or self.isStudio or self.generation ~= generation or os.clock() < self.nextWriteAt then return end
	local userId, pending, scope
	for _, bucket in ipairs(self:_scopes()) do
		for id, candidate in pairs(bucket.queue) do
			if candidate.due <= os.clock() and (not pending or candidate.due < pending.due) then userId, pending, scope = id, candidate, bucket end
		end
	end
	if not pending then return end
	self.writeBusy = true
	self.nextWriteAt = os.clock() + 3
	local published = scope.published[userId] or { XP = 0, Wins = 0 }
	scope.published[userId] = published
	local success = true
	local interrupted = false
	for _, board in ipairs(scope.boards) do
		if self.generation ~= generation or (deadline and os.clock() >= deadline) then interrupted = true break end
		local stat = board.definition.stat
		local snapshot = pending[stat]
		if snapshot > published[stat] then
			local ok = pcall(function()
				assert(board.store, "Leaderboard store unavailable")
				board.store:UpdateAsync(tostring(userId), function(old) return math.max(integer(old, 0), snapshot) end)
			end)
			if self.generation ~= generation then interrupted = true break end
			if ok then published[stat] = snapshot else success = false end
		end
	end
	if success and not interrupted and published.XP >= pending.XP and published.Wins >= pending.Wins then
		scope.queue[userId] = nil
	elseif success and not interrupted then
		pending.due = os.clock()
	elseif not interrupted then
		pending.attempts += 1
		pending.due = os.clock() + math.min(120, 5 * 2 ^ math.min(pending.attempts, 5))
	end
	self.writeBusy = false
end

function Service:_activeRegions()
	local result = {}
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local lookup = self.regionLookups[player.UserId]
		if lookup and lookup.id then result[lookup.id] = true end
	end
	return result
end

function Service:_refreshNext(generation)
	if os.clock() < self.nextReadAt then return end
	local active = self:_activeRegions()
	local chosen, chosenScope
	for _, scope in ipairs(self:_scopes()) do
		if scope.id == "global" or active[scope.id] then
			for _, board in ipairs(scope.boards) do
				if board.refreshAt <= os.clock() and (not chosen or board.refreshAt < chosen.refreshAt) then chosen, chosenScope = board, scope end
			end
		end
	end
	if not chosen then return end
	self.nextReadAt = os.clock() + (self.isStudio and 0.5 or 2)
	chosen.refreshAt = os.clock() + (self.isStudio and 5 or 60)
	local ok = pcall(function() self:_refresh(chosen, generation, chosenScope) end)
	if not ok and self.running and self.generation == generation then
		self:_render(chosen, chosen.entries, chosenScope.label .. " · UNAVAILABLE RIGHT NOW", #chosen.entries > 0 and "stale" or "unavailable", "Scores will appear when connected")
	end
end

function Service:_displayEntries(entries, stat)
	local result = {}
	for index, entry in ipairs(entries) do
		local cached = self.identities[entry.userId]
		local display = { userId = entry.userId, name = entry.name or (cached and cached.name) or "Player " .. entry.userId, image = cached and cached.image or entry.image or "", value = stat == "XP" and "LV " .. self:_level(entry.value) or tostring(entry.value) }
		if index <= 3 and typeof(self.resolveEmote) == "function" then
			local ok, emote = pcall(self.resolveEmote, entry.userId)
			if ok and typeof(emote) == "table" then
				display.emoteId, display.emoteAnimationId, display.emoteRigType = emote.emoteId, emote.emoteAnimationId, emote.emoteRigType
			end
		end
		table.insert(result, display)
	end
	return result
end

function Service:GetSnapshot(player, requested)
	local scope = requested == "server" and "server" or requested == "region" and "region" or "global"
	local lookup = player and self.regionLookups[player.UserId]
	local regionId = lookup and lookup.id
	local response = { scope = scope, region = regionId and regionNames[regionId] or nil, regionId = regionId, boards = {}, state = "ready", retryAfter = 30 }
	if scope == "server" then
		response.status = self.isStudio and "THIS SERVER · STUDIO PREVIEW" or "THIS SERVER · CURRENT PLAYERS"
		for _, definition in ipairs(definitions) do
			response.boards[definition.name] = { entries = self:_displayEntries(self:_serverEntries(definition.stat), definition.stat), state = "ready", status = response.status, emptyText = "No players with loaded scores yet" }
		end
		return response
	end
	if scope == "region" and not regionId then
		response.state = lookup and lookup.state or (self.running and "loading" or "unavailable")
		response.status = response.state == "loading" and "REGION · FINDING YOUR REGION" or "REGION · LOCATION UNAVAILABLE"
		response.retryAfter = response.state == "loading" and 5 or 60
		for _, definition in ipairs(definitions) do
			response.boards[definition.name] = { entries = {}, state = response.state, status = response.status, emptyText = response.state == "loading" and "Finding your broad region" or "Your region could not be determined" }
		end
		return response
	end
	local bucket = scope == "global" and self.global or self.regions[regionId]
	for _, board in ipairs(bucket.boards) do
		response.boards[board.definition.name] = { entries = self:_displayEntries(board.entries, board.definition.stat), state = board.state, status = board.status, emptyText = board.emptyText }
		if states[board.state] > states[response.state] then response.state = board.state end
	end
	local suffix = response.state == "loading" and "CONNECTING" or response.state == "stale" and "RECONNECTING · SHOWING SAVED SCORES" or response.state == "unavailable" and "UNAVAILABLE RIGHT NOW" or "UPDATES EVERY MINUTE"
	response.status = self.isStudio and (scope == "global" and "THIS SERVER · STUDIO PREVIEW" or bucket.label .. " · STUDIO PREVIEW") or bucket.label .. " · " .. suffix
	response.retryAfter = response.state == "loading" and 5 or 30
	return response
end

function Service:Start()
	if self.running then return self end
	for _, board in ipairs(self.boards) do self:_render(board, board.entries, self.isStudio and "THIS SERVER · STUDIO PREVIEW" or "GLOBAL · CONNECTING", #board.entries > 0 and "stale" or "loading", "Scores are loading") end
	self.generation += 1
	local generation = self.generation
	self.running = true
	local function added(player)
		self:_resolvePlayer(player, generation)
		if validUserId(player.UserId) then task.spawn(function() if self.running and self.generation == generation then self:_identity(player.UserId) end end) end
	end
	table.insert(self.connections, Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(added))
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do added(player) end
	task.spawn(function()
		while self.running and self.generation == generation do
			self:_connectStores()
			for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do self:_resolvePlayer(player, generation) end
			self:_refreshNext(generation)
			task.wait(1)
		end
	end)
	task.spawn(function()
		while self.running and self.generation == generation do
			self:_writeOne(generation)
			task.wait(3)
		end
	end)
	return self
end

function Service:_pending()
	if self.writeBusy then return true end
	for _, scope in ipairs(self:_scopes()) do if next(scope.queue) then return true end end
	for userId, lookup in pairs(self.regionLookups) do
		if self.saved[userId] and lookup.state == "loading" then return true end
	end
	return false
end

function Service:Flush(seconds)
	if self.isStudio then return true end
	if typeof(seconds) ~= "number" or seconds ~= seconds or math.abs(seconds) == math.huge then seconds = 3 end
	local deadline = os.clock() + math.clamp(seconds, 0, 5)
	local generation = self.generation
	self.flushDeadline = math.max(self.flushDeadline, deadline)
	if self.flushWorkerGeneration ~= generation then
		self.flushWorkerGeneration = generation
		task.spawn(function()
			while self.generation == generation and os.clock() < self.flushDeadline and self:_pending() do
				self:_writeOne(generation, self.flushDeadline)
				task.wait(0.05)
			end
			if self.flushWorkerGeneration == generation then self.flushWorkerGeneration = nil end
		end)
	end
	while self.generation == generation and os.clock() < deadline and self:_pending() do task.wait(math.max(0, math.min(0.05, deadline - os.clock()))) end
	return not self:_pending()
end

function Service:Stop()
	self.running = false
	self.generation += 1
	self.flushDeadline = 0
	for _, connection in ipairs(self.connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
	table.clear(self.connections)
end

return Service

local Benches = {}
local active
local roundAttributes = { "BBParticipating", "TGParticipating", "MDParticipating", "HSParticipating", "DGParticipating", "DGEliminated", "SKParticipating", "SKEliminated" }

local function inRound(player)
	for _, attribute in ipairs(roundAttributes) do
		if player:GetAttribute(attribute) == true then return true end
	end
	return false
end

local function disconnect(connections)
	for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
	table.clear(connections)
end

local function release(entry)
	local humanoid = entry.seat.Occupant
	local weld = entry.seat:FindFirstChild("SeatWeld")
	if weld then weld:Destroy() end
	if humanoid and humanoid.Parent then humanoid.Sit = false end
end

function Benches.Start()
	if active then return active end
	local lobby = workspace:FindFirstChild("Playground Lobby")
	if not lobby then return nil end
	local self = { connections = {}, entries = {}, running = true }
	active = self
	for _, seat in ipairs(lobby:GetDescendants()) do
		if not seat:IsA("Seat") or seat:GetAttribute("PCBenchSeat") ~= true then continue end
		local prompt = seat:FindFirstChild("SitPrompt", true)
		if not prompt then continue end
		local entry = { seat = seat, prompt = prompt, occupantConnections = {}, lastRequest = {} }
		table.insert(self.entries, entry)
		local function occupantChanged()
			disconnect(entry.occupantConnections)
			local humanoid = seat.Occupant
			local player = humanoid and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(humanoid.Parent)
			entry.player = player
			prompt.Enabled = humanoid == nil and self.running
			if humanoid and (not player or inRound(player) or humanoid.Health <= 0) then release(entry) return end
			if not humanoid then return end
			for _, attribute in ipairs(roundAttributes) do
				table.insert(entry.occupantConnections, player:GetAttributeChangedSignal(attribute):Connect(function()
					if inRound(player) then release(entry) end
				end))
			end
			table.insert(entry.occupantConnections, humanoid.Died:Connect(function() release(entry) end))
		end
		table.insert(self.connections, seat:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Occupant"):Connect(occupantChanged))
		table.insert(self.connections, prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
			if not self.running or player.Parent ~= Players or seat.Occupant or inRound(player) then return end
			local character = player.Character
			local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not humanoid or not root or humanoid.Health <= 0 or humanoid.SeatPart or root.Anchored then return end
			if (root.Position - seat.Position).Magnitude > prompt.MaxActivationDistance + 1 then return end
			local now = os.clock()
			if now - (entry.lastRequest[player] or -math.huge) < 0.75 then return end
			entry.lastRequest[player] = now
			humanoid:UnequipTools()
			seat:Sit(humanoid)
		end))
		occupantChanged()
	end
	table.insert(self.connections, Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		for _, entry in ipairs(self.entries) do
			entry.lastRequest[player] = nil
			if entry.player == player then release(entry) end
		end
	end))
	function self:Stop() Benches.Stop() end
	return self
end

function Benches.Stop()
	local self = active
	if not self then return end
	active, self.running = nil, false
	disconnect(self.connections)
	for _, entry in ipairs(self.entries) do
		disconnect(entry.occupantConnections)
		entry.prompt.Enabled = false
		release(entry)
	end
end

return Benches

			entry.player = player
			entry.root = humanoid and humanoid.Parent:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if previousPlayer ~= player and previousRoot and previousRoot.Parent then
				pcall(previousRoot.SetNetworkOwnershipAuto, previousRoot)
			end
			if humanoid and (not player or inRound(player) or humanoid.Health <= 0) then release(entry) return end
			if not humanoid then return end
			entry.phase = 0
			entry.ramp = 0
			pcall(seat.SetNetworkOwner, seat, nil)
			for _, attribute in ipairs(roundAttributes) do
				table.insert(entry.occupantConnections, player:GetAttributeChangedSignal(attribute):Connect(function()
					if inRound(player) then release(entry) end
				end))
			end
			table.insert(entry.occupantConnections, humanoid.Died:Connect(function() release(entry) end))
		end
		table.insert(self.connections, seat:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Occupant"):Connect(occupantChanged))
		table.insert(self.connections, prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
			if not self.running or player.Parent ~= Players or seat.Occupant or inRound(player) then return end
			local character = player.Character
			local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not humanoid or not root or humanoid.Health <= 0 or humanoid.SeatPart or root.Anchored then return end
			if (root.Position - seat.Position).Magnitude > prompt.MaxActivationDistance + 2 then return end
			local now = os.clock()
			if now - (entry.lastRequest[player] or -math.huge) < 1 then return end
			entry.lastRequest[player] = now
			humanoid:UnequipTools()
			seat:Sit(humanoid)
		end))
		pcall(seat.SetNetworkOwner, seat, nil)
		occupantChanged()
	end
	local accumulator = 0
	table.insert(self.connections, RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		accumulator += dt
		if accumulator < 1 / 30 then return end
		local elapsed = math.min(accumulator, 0.1)
		accumulator = 0
		if not model.Parent then Swing.Stop() return end
		for _, entry in ipairs(self.entries) do
			local occupied = entry.seat.Occupant ~= nil and entry.player and not inRound(entry.player)
			local amplitude = math.clamp(model:GetAttribute("SwingAngle") or 26, 8, 30)
			local period = math.clamp(model:GetAttribute("SwingPeriod") or 4.5, 3.5, 8)
			entry.ramp += ((occupied and 1 or 0) - entry.ramp) * math.min(elapsed * 1.6, 1)
			entry.phase += elapsed * math.pi * 2 / period
			entry.hinge.TargetAngle = math.sin(entry.phase) * amplitude * entry.ramp
			if not occupied and entry.ramp < 0.003 then entry.hinge.TargetAngle = 0 end
		end
	end))
	table.insert(self.connections, Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		for _, entry in ipairs(self.entries) do
			entry.lastRequest[player] = nil
			if entry.player == player then release(entry) end
		end
	end))
	function self:Stop() Swing.Stop() end
	return self
end

function Swing.Stop()
	local self = active
	if not self then return end
	self.running = false
	active = nil
	disconnect(self.connections)
	for _, entry in ipairs(self.entries) do
		disconnect(entry.occupantConnections)
		entry.prompt.Enabled = false
		entry.hinge.TargetAngle = 0
		release(entry)
		if entry.root and entry.root.Parent then pcall(entry.root.SetNetworkOwnershipAuto, entry.root) end
	end
end

return Swing

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Push = {}
Push.__index = Push

local function alive(record)
	return record and record.character and record.character.Parent and record.root and record.root.Parent
		and record.humanoid and record.humanoid.Health > 0
end

function Push.new(bulldog, tag)
	return setmetatable({ bulldog = bulldog, tag = tag, connections = {}, requests = {}, cooldowns = {}, pending = {}, running = false }, Push)
end

function Push:_setting(name, fallback, minimum, maximum)
	local value = script:GetAttribute(name)
	if typeof(value) ~= "number" or value ~= value or math.abs(value) == math.huge then return fallback end
	return math.clamp(value, minimum, maximum)
end

function Push:_eligible(service, record, now)
	if not service or not service.running or not service.active or not record or not record.participating
		or not alive(record) or record.frozen or record.ragdoll or record.pendingBulldog then return false end
	if not record.isBot and (record.player.Parent ~= Players or record.player.Character ~= record.character) then return false end
	if record.player:GetAttribute("MDParticipating") == true or record.player:GetAttribute("HSParticipating") == true or record.player:GetAttribute("DGParticipating") == true or record.player:GetAttribute("DGEliminated") == true or record.player:GetAttribute("SKParticipating") == true or record.player:GetAttribute("SKEliminated") == true then return false end
	if service == self.bulldog then
		if record.player:GetAttribute("TGParticipating") == true then return false end
		return service.phase == "Crossing" and now < service.endsAt
			and (record.role == "Runner" or record.role == "Bulldog") and not record.arrived
			and service:_inField(record.root.Position)
			and not service:_inside(service.safeZones.North, record.root.Position)
			and not service:_inside(service.safeZones.South, record.root.Position)
			and (record.role ~= "Runner" or record.departed)
	end
	if record.player:GetAttribute("BBParticipating") == true then return false end
	return service.phase == "Playing" and now < service.endsAt
		and (record.role == "Runner" or record.role == "Tagger") and now >= (record.protectedEndsAt or 0)
		and service:_batInField(record)
end

function Push:_service(player, now)
	for _, service in ipairs({ self.bulldog, self.tag }) do
		local record = service and service.records[player]
		if self:_eligible(service, record, now) then return service, record end
	end
end

function Push:_rayParameters(service)
	local ignored = { service.bounds }
	if service.safeZones then
		table.insert(ignored, service.safeZones.North)
		table.insert(ignored, service.safeZones.South)
	end
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if player.Character then table.insert(ignored, player.Character) end
	end
	for _, record in pairs(service.records) do
		if record.character then table.insert(ignored, record.character) end
	end
	local parameters = RaycastParams.new()
	parameters.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	parameters.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignored
	parameters.RespectCanCollide = true
	return parameters
end

function Push:_resolve(player, request)
	if not self.running or self.pending[player] ~= request then return false end
	self.pending[player] = nil
	local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	local service, attacker = request.service, request.attacker
	if service.currentRound ~= request.round or service.crossingNumber ~= request.crossing
		or service.records[player] ~= attacker or attacker.character ~= request.character
		or not self:_eligible(service, attacker, now) then return false end
	local reach = self:_setting("Reach", 6, 2, 8)
	local forward = attacker.root.CFrame.LookVector
	forward = Vector3.new(forward.X, 0, forward.Z)
	if forward.Magnitude < 0.01 then return false end
	local parameters = self:_rayParameters(service)
	local nearest, nearestDistance
	for _, target in pairs(service.records) do
		if target ~= attacker and self:_eligible(service, target, now) then
			local offset = target.root.Position - attacker.root.Position
			local horizontal = Vector3.new(offset.X, 0, offset.Z)
			local distance = offset.Magnitude
			if distance <= reach and (not nearestDistance or distance < nearestDistance)
				and (horizontal.Magnitude < 0.01 or forward.Unit:Dot(horizontal.Unit) >= 0.35)
				and not workspace:Raycast(attacker.root.Position, offset, parameters) then
				nearest, nearestDistance = target, distance
			end
		end
	end
	if not nearest then return false end
	return service:_ragdoll(nearest, attacker, now, self:_setting("RagdollSeconds", 3, 1, 5), "Push")
end

function Push:Request(player, ...)
	if not self.running or select("#", ...) ~= 0 or typeof(player) ~= "Instance" or player.Parent ~= Players then return false end
	local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	if now - (self.requests[player] or -math.huge) < 0.15 then return false end
	self.requests[player] = now
	if now < (self.cooldowns[player] or 0) then return false end
	local service, attacker = self:_service(player, now)
	if not service or attacker.batSwing then return false end
	local readyAt = now + self:_setting("CooldownSeconds", 6, 3, 30)
	local request = { service = service, attacker = attacker, character = attacker.character,
		round = service.currentRound, crossing = service.crossingNumber }
	self.cooldowns[player] = readyAt
	self.pending[player] = request
	attacker.batSwingReadyAt = math.max(attacker.batSwingReadyAt or 0, now + 0.6)
	player:SetAttribute("PCPushReadyAt", readyAt)
	attacker.character:SetAttribute("PCPushAt", now)
	task.delay(0.18, function() self:_resolve(player, request) end)
	return true
end

function Push:Start()
	if self.running then return self end
	self.running = true
	local remote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PlaygroundPushRequest")
	assert(remote:IsA("RemoteEvent"), "PlaygroundPushRequest must be a RemoteEvent")
	table.insert(self.connections, remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, ...) self:Request(player, ...) end))
	table.insert(self.connections, Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		self.requests[player], self.cooldowns[player], self.pending[player] = nil, nil, nil
	end))
	return self
end

function Push:Stop()
	self.running = false
	for _, connection in ipairs(self.connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
	table.clear(self.connections)
	table.clear(self.requests)
	table.clear(self.cooldowns)
	table.clear(self.pending)
end

return Push

local byCountry: { [string]: Region } = {}
for id, codes in countries do
	for code in string.gmatch(codes, "%u%u") do
		byCountry[code] = regions[id]
	end
end
-- AN remains a documented Roblox return code; TW belongs to geographic Asia.
-- AQ has no requested region; XX is Roblox's unknown-country response.
table.freeze(byCountry)

local PlaygroundRegions = {}

function PlaygroundRegions.Resolve(countryCode: unknown): Region?
	if type(countryCode) ~= "string" or #countryCode ~= 2 then
		return nil
	end
	if not string.match(countryCode, "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z]$") then
		return nil
	end
	return byCountry[string.upper(countryCode)]
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Obby = {}
Obby.__index = Obby

local function participating(player)
	return player:GetAttribute("BBParticipating") == true or player:GetAttribute("TGParticipating") == true or ( player:GetAttribute("MDParticipating") == true or player:GetAttribute("HSParticipating") == true or player:GetAttribute("DGParticipating") == true or player:GetAttribute("DGEliminated") == true or player:GetAttribute("SKParticipating") == true or player:GetAttribute("SKEliminated") == true )
end

local function characterOf(player)
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if player.Parent ~= Players or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not root or participating(player) then return nil end
	return character, root, humanoid
end

local function near(player, part, distance)
	local character, root = characterOf(player)
	return character and (root.Position - part.Position).Magnitude <= distance
end

local function footRayLength(character, root)
	local lowest
	for _, name in {"LeftFoot", "RightFoot", "Left Leg", "Right Leg"} do
		local foot = character:FindFirstChild(name)
		if foot and foot:IsA("BasePart") then
			local frame, size = foot.CFrame, foot.Size
			local extent = (math.abs(frame.RightVector.Y) * size.X + math.abs(frame.UpVector.Y) * size.Y + math.abs(frame.LookVector.Y) * size.Z) * 0.5
			lowest = math.min(lowest or math.huge, foot.Position.Y - extent)
		end
	end
	return math.max(0.5, root.Position.Y - (lowest or (root.Position.Y - root.Size.Y * 1.5))) + 0.6
end

function Obby.new(scene, entry, economy)
	local self = setmetatable({}, Obby)
	self.scene, self.entry, self.economy = scene, entry, economy
	self.runs, self.connections, self.promptTimes = {}, {}, {}
	self.tiles, self.path = {}, {}
	self.tileParts = {}
	self.boundsFrame, self.boundsSize = scene:GetBoundingBox()
	self.floorY = math.huge
	self.random = Random.new()
	self.floorQuery = RaycastParams.new()
	self.floorQuery.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
	self.floorQuery.FilterDescendantsInstances = {scene.Tiles}
	self.running = false
	self.lastOccupied = os.clock()
	for _, model in scene.Tiles:GetChildren() do
		local row, column = model:GetAttribute("Row"), model:GetAttribute("Column")
		local tile = { model = model, top = model.Top, row = row, column = column, pieces = {} }
		self.floorY = math.min(self.floorY, tile.top.Position.Y + tile.top.Size.Y * 0.5)
		for _, p in model:GetDescendants() do if p:IsA("BasePart") then
			self.tileParts[p] = tile
			table.insert(tile.pieces, {part=p, transparency=p.Transparency, collide=p.CanCollide, query=p.CanQuery, color=p.Color})
		end end
		self.tiles[row] = self.tiles[row] or {}
		self.tiles[row][column] = tile
	end
	self:_newPath()
	return self
end

function Obby:_restoreTile(tile)
	tile.failedAt = nil
	for _, record in tile.pieces do
		record.part.Transparency, record.part.CanCollide, record.part.CanQuery = record.transparency, record.collide, record.query
		record.part.Color = record.color
	end
end

function Obby:_newPath()
	local column = self.random:NextInteger(1, 3)
	for row = 1, 8 do
		column = math.clamp(column + self.random:NextInteger(-1, 1), 1, 3)
		self.path[row] = column
		for _, tile in self.tiles[row] do self:_restoreTile(tile) end
	end
	self.lastOccupied = os.clock()
end

function Obby:_tell(player, text)
	player:SetAttribute("PCRewardText", text)
	player:SetAttribute("PCRewardAt", workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
end

function Obby:_move(player, frame)
	local character, root, humanoid = characterOf(player)
	if not character then return false end
	local seat = humanoid.SeatPart
	local weld = seat and seat:FindFirstChild("SeatWeld")
	humanoid.Sit = false
	if weld and ((weld.Part0 and weld.Part0:IsDescendantOf(character)) or (weld.Part1 and weld.Part1:IsDescendantOf(character))) then weld:Destroy() end
	root.AssemblyLinearVelocity, root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
	character:PivotTo(frame)
	return true
end

function Obby:_reset(player, message)
	local run = self.runs[player]
	if not run then return end
	if self:_move(player, self.scene.StartPoint.CFrame) then
		run.row, run.started, run.lastStep, run.lastPosition = 0, os.clock(), -math.huge, self.scene.StartPoint.Position
		player:SetAttribute("PCSecretObbyRow", 0)
		if message and os.clock() - (run.lastNotice or -math.huge) >= 4 then self:_tell(player, message); run.lastNotice = os.clock() end
	else self.runs[player] = nil end
end

function Obby:_enter(player)
	local opening = self.entry.Opening
	if not near(player, opening, 12) then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - (self.promptTimes[player] or -math.huge) < 1 then return end
	self.promptTimes[player] = now
	if player:GetAttribute("PCDataReady") ~= true then
		self:_tell(player, "Your data is still loading. Try the cave again in a moment.")
		return
	end
	if self:_move(player, self.scene.StartPoint.CFrame) then
		self.runs[player] = { character=player.Character, row=0, started=now, lastStep=-math.huge, lastPosition=self.scene.StartPoint.Position }
		player:SetAttribute("PCSecretObbyRow", 0)
		self:_tell(player, "Secret Steps: find all 8 safe tiles. Daily prize: 1,000 coins!")
	end
end

function Obby:_exit(player)
	if not near(player, self.scene.ReturnPortal.Opening, 12) and not near(player, self.scene.FinishReturnPortal.Opening, 12) then return end
	self.runs[player] = nil
	player:SetAttribute("PCSecretObbyRow", 0)
	self:_move(player, CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(-132, 7.6, 54), Vector3.new(-120, 7.6, 54)))
end

function Obby:_claim(player)
	local run = self.runs[player]
	if not run or run.claiming or run.character ~= player.Character or run.row ~= 8
		or os.clock() - run.started < 1.2 or not near(player, self.scene.TreasureChest.Latch, 12) then return end
	run.claiming = true
	local ok, message = self.economy:ClaimSecretObbyReward(player)
	run.claiming = false
	self:_tell(player, message)
end

function Obby:_visit(player, run, tile, now)
	if tile.failedAt then return end
	if self.path[tile.row] ~= tile.column then
		tile.failedAt = now
		for _, record in tile.pieces do
			record.part.Transparency = 1
			record.part.CanCollide = false
			record.part.CanQuery = false
		end
		return
	end
	if tile.row <= run.row then return end
	if tile.row ~= run.row + 1 or now - run.lastStep < 0.09 then
		self:_reset(player, "Follow each row of the secret path.")
		return
	end
	run.row, run.lastStep = tile.row, now
	tile.top.Color = Color3.fromRGB(96, 219, 152)
	player:SetAttribute("PCSecretObbyRow", run.row)
end

function Obby:_tick(dt)
	local now = os.clock()
	for _, row in self.tiles do for _, tile in row do
		if tile.failedAt then
			local age = now - tile.failedAt
			if age >= 3.5 then self:_restoreTile(tile) end
		end
	end end
	local occupied = false
	for player, run in self.runs do
		local character, root, humanoid = characterOf(player)
		if not character or character ~= run.character then
			self.runs[player] = nil
			if player.Parent == Players then player:SetAttribute("PCSecretObbyRow", 0) end
		else
			occupied = true
			local p = root.Position
			local localPosition = self.boundsFrame:PointToObjectSpace(p)
			if p.Y < self.floorY - 6 or p.Y > self.floorY + 65
				or math.abs(localPosition.X) > self.boundsSize.X * 0.5 + 2
				or math.abs(localPosition.Z) > self.boundsSize.Z * 0.5 + 2 then
				self:_reset(player, "Wrong turn! Try the next tile.")
			elseif run.lastPosition and (p - run.lastPosition).Magnitude > math.max(18, humanoid.WalkSpeed * dt * 4 + 8) then
				self:_reset(player, "Follow each row of the secret path.")
			else
				local floor = workspace:Raycast(p, Vector3.new(0, -footRayLength(character, root), 0), self.floorQuery)
				local tile = floor and self.tileParts[floor.Instance]
				if tile and floor.Normal.Y > 0.5 then self:_visit(player, run, tile, now) end
			end
			run.lastPosition = root.Position
		end
	end
	if occupied then self.lastOccupied = now elseif now - self.lastOccupied > 120 then self:_newPath() end
end

function Obby:Start()
	if self.running then return self end
	self.running = true
	table.insert(self.connections, self.entry.Opening.Travel.Triggered:Connect(function(player) self:_enter(player) end))
	table.insert(self.connections, self.scene.ReturnPortal.Opening.Travel.Triggered:Connect(function(player) self:_exit(player) end))
	table.insert(self.connections, self.scene.FinishReturnPortal.Opening.Travel.Triggered:Connect(function(player) self:_exit(player) end))
	table.insert(self.connections, self.scene.TreasureChest.Latch.ClaimReward.Triggered:Connect(function(player) self:_claim(player) end))
	table.insert(self.connections, Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player) self.runs[player]=nil;self.promptTimes[player]=nil end))
	table.insert(self.connections, RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt) self:_tick(dt) end))
	return self
end

function Obby:Stop()
	self.running = false
	for _, connection in self.connections do connection:Disconnect() end
	table.clear(self.connections)
	for player in self.runs do if player.Parent == Players then self:_move(player, CFrame.new(-132, 7.6, 54));player:SetAttribute("PCSecretObbyRow", 0) end end
	table.clear(self.runs)
	for _, row in self.tiles do for _, tile in row do self:_restoreTile(tile) end end
end

return Obby
