	M24 = { pose = "Throw", contact = 0.3, duration = 0.78, cooldown = 3, cosmetic = true },
	M25 = { pose = "Shake", contact = 0.65, duration = 1.05, cooldown = 3, cosmetic = true },
}
local palette = { Color3.fromRGB(255, 93, 131), Color3.fromRGB(70, 201, 255), Color3.fromRGB(255, 212, 72), Color3.fromRGB(117, 228, 137), Color3.fromRGB(195, 122, 255) }

local function now() return workspace:GetServerTimeNow() end
local function participating(player)
	return player:GetAttribute("BBParticipating") == true or player:GetAttribute("TGParticipating") == true or ( player:GetAttribute("MDParticipating") == true or player:GetAttribute("HSParticipating") == true or player:GetAttribute("DGParticipating") == true or player:GetAttribute("DGEliminated") == true or player:GetAttribute("SKParticipating") == true or player:GetAttribute("SKEliminated") == true )
end
local function finiteVector(value)
	return typeof(value) == "Vector3" and value.X == value.X and value.Y == value.Y and value.Z == value.Z
		and math.abs(value.X) < 1000000 and math.abs(value.Y) < 1000000 and math.abs(value.Z) < 1000000
end
local function setAttribute(object, key, value)
	if object:GetAttribute(key) ~= value then object:SetAttribute(key, value) end
end
local function part(name, size, color, parent)
	local object = Instance.new("Part")
	object.Name, object.Size, object.Color = name, size, color
	object.Anchored, object.CanCollide, object.CanTouch, object.CanQuery = true, false, false, false
	object.Material, object.TopSurface, object.BottomSurface = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Enum.SurfaceType.Studs, Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	object.Parent = parent
	return object
end

function Toys.new(options)
	options = options or {}
	return setmetatable({ records = {}, objects = {}, running = false, playBonk = options.playBonk, random = Random.new() }, Toys)
end

function Toys:_inside(position)
	local bounds = self.bounds
	if not bounds or not bounds.Parent or not finiteVector(position) then return false end
	local point, half = bounds.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(position), bounds.Size * 0.5
	return math.abs(point.X) <= half.X and math.abs(point.Z) <= half.Z and math.abs(point.Y) <= half.Y + 20
end

function Toys:_character(player)
	if not player or player.Parent ~= Players or player:GetAttribute("PCDataReady") ~= true or participating(player) or player:GetAttribute("PCToyRoundPreparing") == true then return nil end
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not self:_inside(root.Position) then return nil end
	return character, humanoid, root
end

function Toys:_record(player)
	local character, humanoid = self:_character(player)
	if not character then return nil end
	local record = self.records[player]
	if record and record.character ~= character then self:ClearPlayer(player) record = nil end
	if not record then
		record = { player = player, character = character, humanoid = humanoid, cooldowns = {}, serial = 0, speedUntil = 0, jumpUntil = 0, emberUntil = 0, freezeUntil = 0, burnUntil = 0, busyUntil = 0, nextFire = 0 }
		self.records[player] = record
	end
	return record
end

function Toys:CanHold(player)
	return self.running and self:_character(player) ~= nil
end

function Toys:Hold(player)
	return self:CanHold(player) and self:_record(player) ~= nil
end

function Toys:_restoreVisual(record)
	if not record.hidden then return end
	for object, transparency in pairs(record.hidden) do if object.Parent then object.Transparency = transparency end end
	record.hidden = nil
end

function Toys:_hideVisual(record, tool)
	self:_restoreVisual(record)
	local visual = tool:FindFirstChild("Visual")
	if not visual then return end
	record.hidden = {}
	for _, object in ipairs(visual:GetDescendants()) do
		if object:IsA("BasePart") then record.hidden[object] = object.Transparency object.Transparency = 1 end
	end
end

function Toys:_ray(origin, direction, owner, ignoreCharacters)
	local excludes = { self.folder }
	if owner and owner.Character then table.insert(excludes, owner.Character) end
	if ignoreCharacters then for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do if player.Character then table.insert(excludes, player.Character) end end end
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType, params.FilterDescendantsInstances = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude, excludes
	params.IgnoreWater = true
	return workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, params)
end

function Toys:_direction(root, aim)
	local direction = finiteVector(aim) and aim - root.Position or root.CFrame.LookVector
	if direction.Magnitude < 0.1 then direction = root.CFrame.LookVector end
	return direction.Unit
end

function Toys:_burst(position, color, kind, count, owner)
	local anchor = part("ToyBurst", Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1), color, self.folder)
	anchor.Transparency, anchor.Position = 1, position
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Texture = kind == "fire" and "rbxasset://textures/particles/fire_main.dds" or "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(color, kind == "fire" and Color3.fromRGB(255, 211, 80) or Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
	emitter.Lifetime, emitter.Speed, emitter.SpreadAngle = NumberRange.new(0.35, 0.8), NumberRange.new(3, 8), Vector2.new(180, 180)
	emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new(kind == "fire" and 0.65 or 0.22, 0)
	emitter.LightEmission, emitter.Parent = 0.3, anchor
	emitter:Emit(count or 16)
	if owner then self:_object(owner, anchor, 1) else Debris:AddItem(anchor, 1) end
end

function Toys:_confetti(position, owner)
	for i = 1, 16 do
		local confetti = part("Confetti", Vector3.new(0.12, 0.05, 0.23), palette[(i - 1) % #palette + 1], self.folder)
		confetti.Position = position
		self:_object(owner, confetti, 2, { position = position, velocity = Vector3.new(self.random:NextNumber(-8, 8), self.random:NextNumber(7, 14), self.random:NextNumber(-8, 8)), gravity = 18, spin = Vector3.new(5, 3, 2), cosmetic = true })
	end
end

function Toys:_object(owner, object, lifetime, data)
	data = data or {}
	data.owner, data.object, data.expiresAt = owner, object, now() + lifetime
	data.bornAt, data.originalPivot = now(), object:GetPivot()
	data.visualOffset = object:GetAttribute("ToyVisualOffset") or CFrame.identity
	table.insert(self.objects, data)
	return data
end

function Toys:_visual(id, position, length)
	local assets = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("PlaygroundCosmeticAssets")
	local source = assets and assets:FindFirstChild(id)
	if not source or not source:IsA("Model") then return nil end
	local clone = source:Clone()
	clone.Name = "Toy_" .. id
	for _, child in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
		if child:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then child:Destroy()
		elseif child:IsA("BasePart") then
			child.Anchored, child.CanCollide, child.CanTouch, child.CanQuery = true, false, false, false
		elseif child:IsA("Highlight") then child.Adornee = clone end
	end
	local box, size = clone:GetBoundingBox()
	clone:ScaleTo(clone:GetScale() * length / math.max(size.X, size.Y, size.Z, 0.1))
	box = clone:GetBoundingBox()
	local offset = box:Inverse() * clone:GetPivot()
	clone:SetAttribute("ToyVisualOffset", offset)
	clone:PivotTo(CFrame.new(position) * offset)
	clone.Parent = self.folder
	return clone
end

function Toys:_ground(root, distance)
	local horizontal = Vector3.new(root.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, root.CFrame.LookVector.Z)
	if horizontal.Magnitude < 0.1 then horizontal = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) else horizontal = horizontal.Unit end
	local origin = root.Position + horizontal * distance + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
	local hit = self:_ray(origin, Vector3.new(0, -12, 0), nil, true)
	if hit and hit.Normal.Y > 0.75 and self:_inside(hit.Position) then return hit.Position end
	return nil
end

function Toys:_padGround(root)
	local position = self:_ground(root, 5)
	if not position then return nil end
	for x = -1, 1, 2 do for z = -1, 1, 2 do
		local corner = position + Vector3.new(x * 2.7, 0, z * 2.7)
		if not self:_inside(corner) then return nil end
		local ground = self:_ray(corner + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), Vector3.new(0, -4, 0), nil, true)
		if not ground or ground.Normal.Y < 0.75 or math.abs(ground.Position.Y - position.Y) > 0.5 then return nil end
	end end
	return position
end

function Toys:_boundedRange(origin, direction, distance)
	local target = origin + direction * distance
	if self:_inside(target) then return distance end
	local low, high = 0, distance
	for _ = 1, 14 do
		local middle = (low + high) / 2
		if self:_inside(origin + direction * middle) then low = middle else high = middle end
	end
	return low
end

function Toys:_movement(record, time)
	local humanoid = record.humanoid
	local active = record.speedUntil > time or record.jumpUntil > time or record.freezeUntil > time
	if active and not record.base then
		record.base = { WalkSpeed = humanoid.WalkSpeed, JumpPower = humanoid.JumpPower, JumpHeight = humanoid.JumpHeight, AutoRotate = humanoid.AutoRotate }
		record.written = {}
	end
	if not record.base then return end
	local frozen = record.freezeUntil > time
	local values = {
		WalkSpeed = frozen and 0 or record.base.WalkSpeed * (record.speedUntil > time and 3 or 1),
		JumpPower = frozen and 0 or record.base.JumpPower * (record.jumpUntil > time and math.sqrt(5) or 1),
		JumpHeight = frozen and 0 or record.base.JumpHeight * (record.jumpUntil > time and 5 or 1),
		AutoRotate = not frozen and record.base.AutoRotate,
	}
	for key, value in pairs(values) do humanoid[key] = value record.written[key] = humanoid[key] end
	if frozen then humanoid.Jump = false end
	if not active then record.base, record.written = nil, nil end
end

function Toys:_burn(owner, target)
	if owner == target or not self:_character(owner) then return end
	local record = self:_record(target)
	if not record or now() < (record.burnImmuneUntil or 0) then return end
	record.burnUntil, record.nextBurn, record.burnImmuneUntil, record.burnOwner = now() + 10, now() + 1, now() + 12, owner
	setAttribute(target, "PCToyBurnUntil", record.burnUntil)
	local root = record.character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local fire = Instance.new("Fire")
	fire.Name, fire.Size, fire.Heat = "ToyCampfire", 3, 2
	fire.Color, fire.SecondaryColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 142, 45), Color3.fromRGB(255, 224, 102)
	fire.Parent, record.fire = root, fire
end

function Toys:_freeze(target, owner)
	local record = self:_record(target)
	if not record or now() < (record.freezeImmuneUntil or 0) then return end
	record.freezeUntil, record.freezeImmuneUntil, record.freezeOwner = now() + 2.5, now() + 6, owner
	self:CancelAction(target)
	setAttribute(target, "PCToyFrozenUntil", record.freezeUntil)
	local outline = Instance.new("Highlight")
	outline.Name, outline.Adornee = "ToyFrost", record.character
	outline.FillColor, outline.FillTransparency = Color3.fromRGB(142, 233, 255), 0.35
	outline.OutlineColor, outline.DepthMode = Color3.fromRGB(214, 252, 255), Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
	outline.Parent, record.frost = record.character, outline
	self:_movement(record, now())
end

function Toys:_target(hit)
	if not hit then return nil end
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local character = self:_character(player)
		if character and hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(character) then return player end
	end
	return nil
end

function Toys:_beam(origin, destination, color, owner)
	local delta = destination - origin
	if delta.Magnitude < 0.01 then return end
	local beam = part("ToyRay", Vector3.new(0.14, 0.14, delta.Magnitude), color, self.folder)
	beam.Material, beam.CFrame = Enum.Material.Neon, CFrame.lookAt((origin + destination) / 2, destination)
	if owner then self:_object(owner, beam, 0.16) else Debris:AddItem(beam, 0.16) end
end

function Toys:_splat(position, normal, owner, cake)
	local color = cake and Color3.fromRGB(255, 238, 209) or palette[self.random:NextInteger(1, #palette)]
	local frame = CFrame.lookAt(position + normal * 0.04, position + normal)
	for i = 0, 6 do
		local size = i == 0 and 1.55 or self.random:NextNumber(0.25, 0.7)
		local blob = part(cake and "Frosting" or "PaintSplat", Vector3.new(size, size, 0.045), color, self.folder)
		blob.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
		local angle = i * math.pi / 3
		blob.CFrame = frame * CFrame.new(i == 0 and 0 or math.cos(angle) * 0.9, i == 0 and 0 or math.sin(angle) * 0.9, 0)
		self:_object(owner, blob, cake and 5 or 10)
	end
end

function Toys:_launch(record, id, root, direction)
	local position = root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.3, 0) + direction * 2
	local length, velocity = 1.6, direction * 48 + Vector3.new(0, 15, 0)
	if id == "M02" then velocity = direction * 20 + Vector3.new(0, 48, 0) length = 1.8 end
	if id == "M04" then position = root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0) velocity = direction * 38 + Vector3.new(0, 18, 0) length = 2.7 end
	if id == "M01" then
		local ground = self:_ground(root, 3)
		if not ground then return end
		local forward = Vector3.new(root.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, root.CFrame.LookVector.Z)
		direction = forward.Magnitude > 0.1 and forward.Unit or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
		position, velocity = ground + Vector3.new(0, 0.9, 0), direction * 54 + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)
		if record.stagedBall then
			local staged = record.stagedBall
			record.stagedBall = nil
			staged.kind, staged.position, staged.velocity, staged.gravity, staged.spin, staged.bounces = id, position, velocity, 60, Vector3.new(2, 1, 0), 0
			staged.expiresAt = now() + 5
			return
		end
	end
	local object
	if id == "M11" then
		object = part("FlyingPaint", Vector3.new(0.7, 0.7, 0.7), palette[self.random:NextInteger(1, #palette)], self.folder)
		object.Shape, object.Position = Enum.PartType.Ball, position
	else object = self:_visual(id, position, length) end
	if not object then return end
	self:_object(record.player, object, 5, { kind = id, position = position, velocity = velocity, gravity = 60, spin = Vector3.new(2, 1, 0), bounces = 0 })
end

function Toys:_placePad(record, root)
	local position = self:_padGround(root)
	if not position then return false end
	local model = self:_visual("M15", position + Vector3.new(0, 0.45, 0), 6)
	if not model then return false end
	local surface = part("BounceSurface", Vector3.new(5.2, 0.45, 5.2), Color3.fromRGB(73, 196, 228), model)
	surface.Transparency, surface.CanCollide, surface.CanQuery = 1, true, true
	surface.Position = position + Vector3.new(0, 0.45, 0)
	local entry = self:_object(record.player, model, 15, { kind = "Pad", surface = surface, nextBounce = {} })
	entry.padPosition = position
	setAttribute(record.player, "PCToyPadUntil", entry.expiresAt)
	return true
end

function Toys:_cosmeticExpansion(record, id, root, direction)
	local origin = root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.2, 0) + direction * 2
	if not self:_inside(origin) then return end
	if id == "M16" then
		self:_burst(root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), Color3.fromRGB(208, 246, 255), "snow", 24, record.player)
	elseif id == "M17" then
		local snowball = part("ToySnowball", Vector3.new(0.7, 0.7, 0.7), Color3.fromRGB(238, 252, 255), self.folder)
		snowball.Shape, snowball.Position = Enum.PartType.Ball, origin
		self:_object(record.player, snowball, 3, {kind = "Snowball", position = origin, velocity = direction * 42 + Vector3.new(0, 7, 0), gravity = 32})
	elseif id == "M18" then
		for i = 1, 7 do
			local diameter = self.random:NextNumber(0.3, 0.7)
			local bubble = part("ToyBubble", Vector3.one * diameter, palette[(i % #palette) + 1], self.folder)
			bubble.Shape, bubble.Transparency, bubble.Position = Enum.PartType.Ball, 0.45, origin
			self:_object(record.player, bubble, 2.4, {position = origin, velocity = direction * self.random:NextNumber(4, 9) + Vector3.new(self.random:NextNumber(-2, 2), 2 + i * 0.2, self.random:NextNumber(-2, 2)), gravity = -0.3, cosmetic = true, fade = true})
		end
	elseif id == "M19" then
		local ground = self:_ground(root, 4)
		if ground then
			local banana = self:_visual(id, ground + Vector3.new(0, 0.6, 0), 2)
			if banana then self:_object(record.player, banana, 5) end
		end
	elseif id == "M20" then
		local hit = self:_ray(origin, direction * 4, record.player)
		local contact = hit and hit.Position or origin + direction * 2
		self:_burst(contact, Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 92), "stars", 12, record.player)
		if hit and self.playBonk then self.playBonk(contact) end
	elseif id == "M21" then
		local honey = self:_visual(id, origin, 1.4)
		if honey then self:_object(record.player, honey, 4, {kind = "Honey", position = origin, velocity = direction * 28 + Vector3.new(0, 12, 0), gravity = 40, spin = Vector3.new(1, 2, 0)}) end
	elseif id == "M22" then
		self:_burst(origin, Color3.fromRGB(255, 223, 203), "puff", 16, record.player)
	elseif id == "M23" then
		local range = self:_boundedRange(origin, direction, 7)
		local hit = self:_ray(origin, direction * range, record.player)
		local finish = hit and hit.Position or origin + direction * range
		self:_beam(origin, finish, Color3.fromRGB(111, 232, 255), record.player)
		self:_burst(finish, Color3.fromRGB(255, 109, 110), "stars", 9, record.player)
	elseif id == "M24" then
		local flyer = self:_visual(id, origin, 2)
		if flyer then self:_object(record.player, flyer, 2.4, {flyer = true, position = origin, flightOrigin = origin, flightDirection = direction}) end
	elseif id == "M25" then
		self:_confetti(origin, record.player)
	end
end

function Toys:_effect(record, id, aim, fireShot)
	local _, _, root = self:_character(record.player)
	if not root then return end
	local direction = self:_direction(root, aim)
	if actions[id] and actions[id].cosmetic then self:_cosmeticExpansion(record, id, root, direction) return end
	if id == "M05" then record.speedUntil = now() + 25 self:_movement(record, now()) setAttribute(record.player, "PCToySpeedUntil", record.speedUntil)
	elseif id == "M06" then record.jumpUntil = now() + 10 self:_movement(record, now()) setAttribute(record.player, "PCToyJumpUntil", record.jumpUntil)
	elseif id == "M07" and not fireShot then record.emberUntil = now() + 10 setAttribute(record.player, "PCToyEmberUntil", record.emberUntil)
	elseif id == "M07" or id == "M10" then
		local origin = root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.4, 0)
		local range = self:_boundedRange(origin, direction, id == "M10" and 55 or 32)
		local hit = self:_ray(origin, direction * range, record.player)
		local destination = hit and hit.Position or origin + direction * range
		self:_beam(origin, destination, id == "M10" and Color3.fromRGB(140, 233, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 55), record.player)
		self:_burst(destination, id == "M10" and Color3.fromRGB(140, 233, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 55), id == "M10" and "frost" or "fire", 12, record.player)
		local target = self:_target(hit)
		if target then if id == "M10" then self:_freeze(target, record.player) else self:_burn(record.player, target) end end
	elseif id == "M03" then
		local hit = self:_ray(root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.6, 0), direction * 6, record.player)
		if hit then self:_burst(hit.Position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 227, 96), "stars", 12, record.player) if self.playBonk then self.playBonk(hit.Position) end end
	elseif id == "M08" then
		self:_confetti(root.Position + root.CFrame.LookVector * 2 + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), record.player)
	elseif id == "M14" then self:_burst(root.Position + direction * 2, Color3.fromRGB(255, 174, 65), "fire", 6, record.player)
	elseif id == "M15" then
		if not self:_placePad(record, root) then
			record.cooldowns.M15 = 0
			setAttribute(record.player, "PCToyCooldown_M15", 0)
			self:_restoreVisual(record)
		end
	else self:_launch(record, id, root, direction) end
end

function Toys:Use(player, tool, aim)
	local record = self:_record(player)
	if not self.running or not record then return { ok = false, message = "Toys are for the lobby." } end
	local id = player:GetAttribute("PCGear")
	if not tool or tool.Parent ~= record.character or tool:GetAttribute("CatalogId") ~= id or record.character:GetAttribute("PCToyHeld") ~= id then return { ok = false, message = "Choose a toy first." } end
	local config = actions[id]
	if not config then return { ok = false, message = id == "M09" and "Plunger Popper is waiting for its plunger model." or "This toy action is not available." } end
	local time = now()
	if time < record.freezeUntil then return { ok = false, message = "Frozen for a moment!" } end
	if time < record.busyUntil then return { ok = false, message = "Finish this action first." } end
	local fireShot = id == "M07" and time < record.emberUntil
	local readyAt = fireShot and record.nextFire or (record.cooldowns[id] or 0)
	if time < readyAt then return { ok = false, message = "Recharging", cooldownEndsAt = readyAt } end
	if aim ~= nil and not finiteVector(aim) then return { ok = false, message = "Invalid aim." } end
	if id == "M15" then local _, _, root = self:_character(player) if not self:_padGround(root) then return { ok = false, message = "Place the pad on open ground." } end end
	local duration, contact, pose = config.duration, config.contact, config.pose
	if fireShot then
		duration, contact, pose = 0.8, 0.35, "Aim"
		record.nextFire = time + 0.8
		setAttribute(player, "PCToyEmberShotUntil", record.nextFire)
	else record.cooldowns[id] = time + config.cooldown end
	record.busyUntil, record.serial = time + duration, record.serial + 1
	local serial = record.serial
	player:SetAttribute("PCToyActionItem", id)
	player:SetAttribute("PCToyAction", pose)
	player:SetAttribute("PCToyActionAt", time)
	player:SetAttribute("PCToyCooldown_" .. id, record.cooldowns[id] or 0)
	local thrown = id == "M01" or id == "M02" or id == "M04" or id == "M12" or id == "M13" or id == "M15" or id == "M19" or id == "M21" or id == "M24"
	if id == "M01" then
		task.delay(0.24, function()
			if not self.running or self.records[player] ~= record or record.serial ~= serial or not self:_character(player) or tool.Parent ~= record.character then return end
			local _, _, root = self:_character(player)
			local ground = root and self:_ground(root, 3)
			if ground then
				self:_hideVisual(record, tool)
				local object = self:_visual(id, ground + Vector3.new(0, 0.9, 0), 1.6)
				if object then record.stagedBall = self:_object(player, object, 5.4) end
			end
		end)
	end
	task.delay(contact, function()
		if not self.running or self.records[player] ~= record or record.serial ~= serial or not self:_character(player)
			or tool.Parent ~= record.character or player:GetAttribute("PCGear") ~= id or record.character:GetAttribute("PCToyHeld") ~= id then return end
		if now() < record.freezeUntil then return end
		if fireShot and now() >= record.emberUntil then return end
		if thrown then self:_hideVisual(record, tool) end
		self:_effect(record, id, aim, fireShot)
	end)
	if thrown then
		task.delay(id == "M15" and config.cooldown or duration, function()
			if self.records[player] == record and record.serial == serial then self:_restoreVisual(record) end
		end)
	end
	return { ok = true, cooldownEndsAt = fireShot and record.nextFire or record.cooldowns[id], message = id == "M07" and not fireShot and "Drink, then tap to breathe fire!" or "" }
end

function Toys:CancelAction(player)
	local record = self.records[player]
	if record then
		record.serial += 1 record.busyUntil = 0
		self:_restoreVisual(record)
		if record.stagedBall then record.stagedBall.object:Destroy() record.stagedBall = nil end
	end
	for _, key in ipairs({ "PCToyAction", "PCToyActionAt", "PCToyActionItem" }) do player:SetAttribute(key, nil) end
end

function Toys:ClearPlayer(player)
	self:CancelAction(player)
	local record = self.records[player]
	if record then
		if record.base and record.humanoid and record.humanoid.Parent then
			for key, value in pairs(record.base) do if record.humanoid[key] == record.written[key] then record.humanoid[key] = value end end
		end
		if record.fire then record.fire:Destroy() end
		if record.frost then record.frost:Destroy() end
		self.records[player] = nil
	end
	for i = #self.objects, 1, -1 do local entry = self.objects[i] if entry.owner == player then entry.object:Destroy() table.remove(self.objects, i) end end
	for _, target in pairs(self.records) do
		if target.burnOwner == player then
			target.burnUntil, target.burnOwner = 0, nil
			if target.fire then target.fire:Destroy() target.fire = nil end
			setAttribute(target.player, "PCToyBurnUntil", 0)
		end
		if target.freezeOwner == player then
			target.freezeUntil, target.freezeOwner = 0, nil
			if target.frost then target.frost:Destroy() target.frost = nil end
			if participating(target.player) or target.player:GetAttribute("PCToyRoundPreparing") == true then
				self:ClearPlayer(target.player)
			else
				self:_movement(target, now())
			end
			setAttribute(target.player, "PCToyFrozenUntil", 0)
		end
	end
	for _, key in ipairs({ "PCToySpeedUntil", "PCToyJumpUntil", "PCToyEmberUntil", "PCToyEmberShotUntil", "PCToyFrozenUntil", "PCToyBurnUntil", "PCToyPadUntil" }) do setAttribute(player, key, 0) end
	for id in pairs(actions) do setAttribute(player, "PCToyCooldown_" .. id, 0) end
end

function Toys:_tickPlayer(record, time)
	local player = record.player
	local _, _, root = self:_character(player)
	if not root or player.Character ~= record.character then self:ClearPlayer(player) return end
	self:_movement(record, time)
	if time >= record.freezeUntil and record.frost then record.frost:Destroy() record.frost = nil end
	if record.burnOwner and not self:_character(record.burnOwner) then record.burnUntil = 0 end
	if record.burnUntil > 0 and time >= record.nextBurn and record.nextBurn <= record.burnUntil then
		record.nextBurn += 1
		record.humanoid:TakeDamage(1)
	end
	if time >= record.burnUntil and record.fire then record.fire:Destroy() record.fire = nil setAttribute(player, "PCToyBurnUntil", 0) end
	if record.character:GetAttribute("PCToyHeld") == "M14" and time >= (record.nextTorch or 0) then
		record.nextTorch = time + 0.3
		local hand = record.character:FindFirstChild("RightHand") or record.character:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")
		local origin = hand and hand.Position or root.Position
		for _, target in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			local _, _, targetRoot = self:_character(target)
			if target ~= player and targetRoot and (targetRoot.Position - origin).Magnitude <= 4 then
				local hit = self:_ray(origin, targetRoot.Position - origin, player)
				if hit and hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(target.Character) then self:_burn(player, target) end
			end
		end
	end
end

function Toys:_tickObject(entry, time, dt)
	local object = entry.object
	if not object.Parent or time >= entry.expiresAt or not self:_character(entry.owner) then
		if entry.kind == "Pad" and object.Parent then self:_burst(entry.padPosition, Color3.fromRGB(100, 217, 240), "stars", 18, entry.owner) end
		return false
	end
	if entry.kind == "Pad" then
		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			local _, humanoid, root = self:_character(player)
			if root then
				local delta = root.Position - entry.surface.Position
				local footHeight = humanoid.HipHeight + root.Size.Y * 0.5
				local leg = player.Character:FindFirstChild("Left Leg")
				if leg then footHeight += leg.Size.Y end
				if math.abs(delta.X) < 2.8 and math.abs(delta.Z) < 2.8 and math.abs(delta.Y - footHeight) < 1.3 and root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y <= 2 and time >= (entry.nextBounce[player] or 0) then
					entry.nextBounce[player] = time + 0.9
					local velocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
					root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(velocity.X, 75, velocity.Z)
					self:_burst(entry.surface.Position, Color3.fromRGB(105, 236, 242), "stars", 10, entry.owner)
				end
			end
		end
		return true
	end
	if entry.flyer then
		local progress = math.clamp((time - entry.bornAt) / 2.4, 0, 1)
		local travel = math.sin(progress * math.pi)
		local position = entry.flightOrigin + entry.flightDirection * (travel * 14) + Vector3.new(0, travel * 3, 0)
		if not self:_inside(position) then return false end
		local obstruction = self:_ray(entry.position, position - entry.position, entry.owner)
		if obstruction then self:_burst(obstruction.Position, Color3.fromRGB(104, 227, 255), "stars", 8, entry.owner) return false end
		entry.position = position
		object:PivotTo(CFrame.new(position) * CFrame.Angles(0, progress * math.pi * 12, 0) * entry.visualOffset)
		return progress < 1
	end
	if entry.fade and object:IsA("BasePart") then
		object.Transparency = math.clamp(0.45 + (time - entry.bornAt) / (entry.expiresAt - entry.bornAt) * 0.55, 0, 1)
	end
	if entry.shakeUntil then
		if time >= entry.shakeUntil then self:_confetti(entry.position, entry.owner) return false end
		object:PivotTo(CFrame.new(entry.position) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.sin(time * 38) * 0.13) * entry.visualOffset)
		return true
	end
	if not entry.velocity then return true end
	entry.velocity += Vector3.new(0, -(entry.gravity or 60) * dt, 0)
	local nextPosition = entry.position + entry.velocity * dt
	if not self:_inside(nextPosition) then return false end
	local hit = not entry.cosmetic and self:_ray(entry.position, nextPosition - entry.position, entry.owner)
	if hit then
		if entry.kind == "Snowball" then self:_burst(hit.Position, Color3.fromRGB(219, 247, 255), "snow", 16, entry.owner) return false end
		if entry.kind == "Honey" then
			self:_burst(hit.Position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 206, 75), "honey", 12, entry.owner)
			local splat = part("HoneySplat", Vector3.new(1.6, 1.6, 0.05), Color3.fromRGB(247, 185, 53), self.folder)
			splat.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
			splat.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(hit.Position + hit.Normal * 0.04, hit.Position + hit.Normal)
			self:_object(entry.owner, splat, 4)
			return false
		end
		if entry.kind == "M11" or entry.kind == "M13" then self:_splat(hit.Position, hit.Normal, entry.owner, entry.kind == "M13") return false
		elseif entry.kind == "M12" then
			entry.position = hit.Position + hit.Normal * 0.35
			entry.originalPivot = CFrame.new(entry.position) * entry.visualOffset
			entry.velocity, entry.shakeUntil = nil, time + 0.65
			object:PivotTo(entry.originalPivot)
			return true
		else
			entry.bounces = (entry.bounces or 0) + 1
			if entry.bounces > 8 or entry.velocity.Magnitude < 3 then entry.velocity = nil return true end
			entry.velocity = (entry.velocity - 2 * entry.velocity:Dot(hit.Normal) * hit.Normal) * 0.6
			nextPosition = hit.Position + hit.Normal * (entry.kind == "M04" and 1.1 or 0.75)
		end
	end
	entry.position = nextPosition
	local angle = entry.spin and entry.spin * (time - entry.bornAt) or Vector3.zero
	object:PivotTo(CFrame.new(nextPosition) * CFrame.Angles(angle.X, angle.Y, angle.Z) * entry.visualOffset)
	return true
end

function Toys:Start()
	if self.running then return self end
	local lobby = workspace:WaitForChild("Playground Lobby")
	self.bounds = lobby:WaitForChild("Gameplay"):WaitForChild("LobbyBounds")
	self.folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	self.folder.Name, self.folder.Parent = "PlaygroundToyEffects", workspace
	self.running = true
	self.heartbeat = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		local time = now()
		for _, record in pairs(self.records) do self:_tickPlayer(record, time) end
		for i = #self.objects, 1, -1 do local entry = self.objects[i] if not self:_tickObject(entry, time, math.min(dt, 0.1)) then entry.object:Destroy() table.remove(self.objects, i) end end
	end)
	self.leaving = Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player) self:ClearPlayer(player) end)
	return self
end

function Toys:Stop()
	self.running = false
	if self.heartbeat then self.heartbeat:Disconnect() end
	if self.leaving then self.leaving:Disconnect() end
	local players = {}
	for player in pairs(self.records) do table.insert(players, player) end
	for _, player in ipairs(players) do self:ClearPlayer(player) end
	if self.folder then self.folder:Destroy() end
	table.clear(self.objects)
end

return Toys

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local RopeMath = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SkippingRopeMath"))

local Service = {}
Service.__index = Service
local runningService

local function attribute(object, name, value)
	if object:GetAttribute(name) ~= value then object:SetAttribute(name, value) end
end

local function disconnect(connections)
	for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
	table.clear(connections)
end

local function alive(record)
	return record and record.ready and record.character and record.character.Parent and record.root and record.root.Parent
		and record.humanoid and record.humanoid.Parent and record.humanoid.Health > 0
end

local function parts(folder)
	local result = {}
	for _, object in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do if object:IsA("BasePart") then table.insert(result, object) end end
	table.sort(result, function(a, b) return a.Name < b.Name end)
	return result
end

function Service.new(arena, config)
	local self = setmetatable({}, Service)
	self.arena, self.config = arena, type(config) == "table" and config or {}
	self.gameplay = arena:WaitForChild("Gameplay")
	self.bounds = self.gameplay:WaitForChild("ArenaBounds")
	self.spectatorSpawns = parts(self.gameplay:WaitForChild("SpectatorSpawns"))
	self.entrySpawns = parts(self.gameplay:WaitForChild("EntrySpawns"))
	assert(#self.spectatorSpawns > 0 and #self.entrySpawns > 0, "Skipping Rope needs spectator and entry spawns")
	self.spectatorSeats = {}
	local grounds = arena:FindFirstChild("Grounds")
	local benches = grounds and grounds:FindFirstChild("SpectatorBenches")
	if benches then
		for _, seat in ipairs(benches:GetDescendants()) do
			if seat:IsA("Seat") then
				local index = seat:GetAttribute("SKSpectatorIndex")
				if typeof(index) == "number" and index % 1 == 0 and index >= 1 and index <= 24 then
					assert(not self.spectatorSeats[index], "Duplicate spectator seat")
					self.spectatorSeats[index] = seat
				end
			end
		end
	end
	self.lanes = {}
	for _, lane in ipairs(self.gameplay:WaitForChild("Lanes"):GetChildren()) do
		local index, origin, spots = lane:GetAttribute("LaneIndex"), lane:FindFirstChild("RopeOrigin"), lane:FindFirstChild("Spots")
		if typeof(index) == "number" and index % 1 == 0 and index >= 1 and index <= 3 and origin and origin:IsA("BasePart") and spots then
			assert(not self.lanes[index], "Duplicate rope lane")
			local positions = parts(spots)
			assert(#positions == 8, "Each rope lane needs eight spots")
			self.lanes[index] = { model = lane, origin = origin, spots = positions, settings = {
				halfSpan = lane:GetAttribute("RopeHalfSpan") or 26, flatHalfSpan = lane:GetAttribute("RopeFlatHalfSpan") or 16,
				radius = lane:GetAttribute("RopeRadius") or 8, pivotHeight = lane:GetAttribute("RopePivotHeight") or 8.8,
				period = 3.6, stepSeconds = 10, speedFactor = 1.05,
			} }
		end
	end
	for index = 1, 3 do assert(self.lanes[index], "Skipping Rope needs three lanes") end
	self.state = typeof(config) == "Instance" and config:IsA("Folder") and config or ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("SkippingRopeState")
	if not self.state then self.state = Instance.new("Folder") self.state.Name, self.state.Parent = "SkippingRopeState", ReplicatedStorage end
	self.records, self.connections = {}, {}
	self.random = Random.new()
	self.active, self.running, self.phase, self.mode = false, false, "Waiting", "Waiting"
	self.startedAt, self.endsAt, self.roundNumber = 0, 0, 0
	self.tickAccumulator = 0
	return self
end

function Service:_setting(name, fallback, minimum, maximum)
	local value = self.config[name]
	if value == nil then value = self.arena:GetAttribute(name) end
	if typeof(value) ~= "number" or value ~= value or math.abs(value) == math.huge then value = fallback end
	return math.clamp(value, minimum or 0, maximum or math.huge)
end

function Service:_publish()
	local total, living, lanes = 0, 0, {0, 0, 0}
	for player, record in pairs(self.records) do
		if record.inRound and player.Parent == Players then
			total += 1
			if record.participating then living += 1 lanes[record.laneIndex] += 1 end
		end
	end
	attribute(self.state, "ParticipantCount", total)
	attribute(self.state, "AliveCount", living)
	for index = 1, 3 do attribute(self.state, "Lane" .. index .. "AliveCount", lanes[index]) end
	return living, total
end

function Service:_phase(phase)
	self.phase = phase
	attribute(self.state, "Phase", phase)
	self:_publish()
end

function Service:_stand(record)
	if not record.humanoid then return end
	local seat = record.humanoid.SeatPart or record.spectatorSeat
	record.spectatorSeat = nil
	record.humanoid.Sit = false
	local weld = seat and seat:FindFirstChild("SeatWeld")
	if weld and weld:IsA("Weld") and weld.Part1 and record.character and weld.Part1:IsDescendantOf(record.character) then weld:Destroy() end
end

function Service:_teleport(record, target)
	if not alive(record) then return end
	self:_stand(record)
	record.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity, record.root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
	record.character:PivotTo(target * record.root.CFrame:Inverse() * record.character:GetPivot())
end

function Service:_sendSpectator(record)
	if not alive(record) then return end
	local index = (record.spawnIndex - 1) % #self.spectatorSpawns + 1
	self:_teleport(record, self.spectatorSpawns[index].CFrame)
	local seat = self.spectatorSeats[index]
	if seat and seat.Parent and not seat.Disabled and not seat.Occupant then
		seat:Sit(record.humanoid)
		record.humanoid.Sit = true
		record.spectatorSeat = seat
	end
end

function Service:_movement(record)
	if not alive(record) or not record.inRound then return end
	local locked = self.phase ~= "Playing"
	record.humanoid.WalkSpeed = record.participating and 0 or locked and 0 or record.original.WalkSpeed
	record.humanoid.AutoRotate = not record.participating and record.original.AutoRotate
	record.humanoid.JumpPower = locked and 0 or record.participating and self:_setting("JumpPower", 50, 35, 60) or record.original.JumpPower
	record.humanoid.JumpHeight = locked and 0 or record.participating and self:_setting("JumpHeight", 7.2, 5, 10) or record.original.JumpHeight
	if locked then record.humanoid.Jump = false end
	record.root.Anchored = false
end

function Service:_role(record, role)
	record.role = role
	attribute(record.player, "SKRole", role)
	attribute(record.player, "SKParticipating", record.participating == true)
	if record.character then attribute(record.character, "SKRole", role) end
	self:_movement(record)
end

function Service:_restoreCharacter(record)
	self:_stand(record)
	local original = record.original
	if original and record.humanoid and record.humanoid.Parent then
		local humanoid = record.humanoid
		humanoid.WalkSpeed, humanoid.JumpPower, humanoid.JumpHeight = original.WalkSpeed, original.JumpPower, original.JumpHeight
		humanoid.AutoRotate = original.AutoRotate
		humanoid.HealthDisplayType = original.HealthDisplayType
		if humanoid.Health > 0 then humanoid.Health = math.min(humanoid.MaxHealth, record.roundHealth or original.Health) end
	end
	if original and record.root and record.root.Parent then record.root.Anchored = original.Anchored end
	record.previousPosition, record.previousAt, record.roundHealth = nil, nil, nil
end

function Service:_retire(record, reason)
	if not record.participating then return false end
	record.participating, record.hits = false, 2
	attribute(record.player, "SKHits", 2)
	attribute(record.player, "SKHealthPercent", 0)
	attribute(record.player, "SKEliminated", true)
	attribute(record.player, "SKResult", "Out")
	attribute(record.player, "SKOutReason", reason or "Rope")
	self:_role(record, "Spectator")
	if alive(record) then
		self:_sendSpectator(record)
	end
	self:_publish()
	return true
end

function Service:_hit(record, cycle, now)
	if not self.active or self.phase ~= "Playing" or now >= self.endsAt or not record.participating
		or not alive(record) or (record.lastHitCycle and cycle <= record.lastHitCycle) then return false end
	record.lastHitCycle = cycle
	record.hits = (record.hits or 0) + 1
	attribute(record.player, "SKHitAt", now)
	attribute(record.player, "SKHits", record.hits)
	attribute(record.player, "SKHealthPercent", math.max(0, 100 - record.hits * 50))
	if record.hits >= 2 then return self:_retire(record, "Rope") end
	record.humanoid.Health = math.max(1, math.min(record.humanoid.MaxHealth, record.humanoid.MaxHealth * 0.5))
	return true
end

function Service:_sample(record, now)
	if not record.participating or not alive(record) then return end
	local lane = self.lanes[record.laneIndex]
	local position = lane.origin.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(record.root.Position)
	local expected = lane.origin.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(record.spot.Position)
	if math.abs(position.X - expected.X) > 2.75 or math.abs(position.Z - expected.Z) > 2.75 or position.Y < -5 or position.Y > 22 then
		local height = math.clamp(position.Y, expected.Y, expected.Y + 8)
		local target = lane.origin.CFrame * CFrame.new(expected.X, height, expected.Z)
		self:_teleport(record, target)
		position = lane.origin.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(record.root.Position)
		record.previousPosition, record.previousAt = position, now
	end
	local firstAt, firstPosition = record.previousAt or now, record.previousPosition or position
	if now - firstAt > 0.35 then firstAt, firstPosition = now - 0.18, position end
	local leg = record.character:FindFirstChild("Left Leg") or record.character:FindFirstChild("Right Leg")
	local legHeight = record.humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 and leg and leg:IsA("BasePart") and leg.Size.Y or 0
	local lower = -(record.humanoid.HipHeight + legHeight + record.root.Size.Y * 0.5)
	local head = record.character:FindFirstChild("Head")
	local upper = 2.8
	if head and head:IsA("BasePart") then
		local headPosition = lane.origin.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(head.Position)
		upper = math.clamp(headPosition.Y + head.Size.Y * 0.5 - position.Y, 1.5, 5)
	end
	local halfWidth = math.clamp(record.root.Size.X * 0.5, 0.5, 2)
	local halfDepth = math.clamp(record.root.Size.Z * 0.5 + 0.4, 0.6, 1.6)
	for _, cycle in ipairs(RopeMath.SweepAvatar(math.max(0, firstAt - self.startedAt), math.max(0, now - self.startedAt),
		firstPosition, position, lower, upper, halfWidth, halfDepth, lane.settings)) do
		self:_hit(record, cycle, now)
	end
	record.previousPosition, record.previousAt = position, now
end

function Service:_guardSpectator(record)
	if not record.inRound or record.participating or not alive(record) then return end
	for _, lane in ipairs(self.lanes) do
		local position = lane.origin.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(record.root.Position)
		if math.abs(position.X) < lane.settings.halfSpan + 3 and math.abs(position.Z) < lane.settings.radius + 5 and position.Y > -5 and position.Y < 25 then
			self:_sendSpectator(record)
			return
		end
	end
end

function Service:_bindCharacter(record, character)
	self:_restoreCharacter(record)
	disconnect(record.characterConnections)
	record.character, record.ready = character, false
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
	if self.records[record.player] ~= record or record.character ~= character or not character.Parent
		or not humanoid or not humanoid:IsA("Humanoid") or not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then return end
	record.humanoid, record.root, record.ready = humanoid, root, true
	record.original = { WalkSpeed = humanoid.WalkSpeed, JumpPower = humanoid.JumpPower, JumpHeight = humanoid.JumpHeight,
		AutoRotate = humanoid.AutoRotate, Anchored = root.Anchored, Health = humanoid.Health, HealthDisplayType = humanoid.HealthDisplayType }
	table.insert(record.characterConnections, humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
		if record.inRound then self:_retire(record, "Reset") end
	end))
	if record.inRound then
		if record.participating then self:_retire(record, "Reset") end
		self:_role(record, "Spectator")
		self:_sendSpectator(record)
	end
end

function Service:_addPlayer(player)
	if self.records[player] then return end
	local record = { player = player, connections = {}, characterConnections = {}, ready = false,
		inRound = false, participating = false, role = "", hits = 0 }
	self.records[player] = record
	for name, value in pairs({ SKParticipating = false, SKRole = "", SKEliminated = false, SKHits = 0,
		SKHealthPercent = 100, SKLane = 0, SKSpot = 0, SKResult = "", SKOutReason = "", SKHitAt = 0 }) do attribute(player, name, value) end
	table.insert(record.connections, player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character) task.spawn(function() self:_bindCharacter(record, character) end) end))
	table.insert(record.connections, player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(character)
		if record.character ~= character then return end
		if record.inRound then self:_retire(record, "Reset") end
		self:_restoreCharacter(record)
		record.ready = false
	end))
	if player.Character then task.spawn(function() self:_bindCharacter(record, player.Character) end) end
end

function Service:_removePlayer(player)
	local record = self.records[player]
	if not record then return end
	self:_restoreCharacter(record)
	disconnect(record.connections) disconnect(record.characterConnections)
	self.records[player] = nil
	self:_publish()
end

function Service:_readyPlayers(selected)
	local ready, seen = {}, {}
	for _, player in ipairs(selected or Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local record = self.records[player]
		if not seen[player] and player.Parent == Players and alive(record) and not record.inRound
			and player:GetAttribute("PCDataReady") == true and not player:GetAttribute("PCAFK") and not player:GetAttribute("PCAFKRequested")
			and not player:GetAttribute("BBParticipating") and not player:GetAttribute("TGParticipating")
			and not player:GetAttribute("MDParticipating") and not player:GetAttribute("HSParticipating")
			and not player:GetAttribute("DGParticipating") and not player:GetAttribute("DGEliminated") then
			seen[player] = true table.insert(ready, player)
		end
	end
	for index = #ready, 2, -1 do local other = self.random:NextInteger(1, index) ready[index], ready[other] = ready[other], ready[index] end
	while #ready > self:_setting("MaxPlayers", 24, 2, 24) do table.remove(ready) end
	return ready
end

function Service:_begin(participants, practice)
	self.active, self.mode, self.currentRound = true, practice and "Practice" or "Round", {}
	self.startedAt, self.endsAt = 0, 0
	self.roundNumber += 1
	attribute(self.state, "Mode", self.mode)
	attribute(self.state, "RoundNumber", self.roundNumber)
	attribute(self.state, "StartedAt", 0)
	attribute(self.state, "FinishedAt", 0)
	attribute(self.state, "WinnersText", "")
	self:_phase("Countdown")
	for index, player in ipairs(participants) do
		local record = self.records[player]
		local laneIndex, spotIndex = (index - 1) % 3 + 1, math.floor((index - 1) / 3) + 1
		record.roundHealth = record.humanoid.Health
		record.humanoid.Health = record.humanoid.MaxHealth
		record.inRound, record.participating, record.spawnIndex = true, true, index
		record.hits, record.lastHitCycle, record.laneIndex, record.spotIndex = 0, nil, laneIndex, spotIndex
		record.spot = self.lanes[laneIndex].spots[spotIndex]
		record.previousAt, record.previousPosition = nil, nil
		for name, value in pairs({ SKEliminated = false, SKHits = 0, SKHealthPercent = 100, SKLane = laneIndex,
			SKSpot = spotIndex, SKResult = "", SKOutReason = "", SKHitAt = 0 }) do attribute(player, name, value) end
		record.humanoid.HealthDisplayType = Enum.HumanoidHealthDisplayType.AlwaysOff
		self:_role(record, "Jumper")
		self:_teleport(record, record.spot.CFrame)
	end
	self.countdownEndsAt = workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + self:_setting("CountdownSeconds", 8, 3, 15)
	attribute(self.state, "EndsAt", self.countdownEndsAt)
	attribute(self.state, "CountdownValue", math.ceil(self.countdownEndsAt - workspace:GetServerTimeNow()))
	self:_publish()
	return true
end

function Service:StartRound(selected)
	if not self.running then return false, "Service is not running" end
	if self.active then return false, "A round is already running" end
	local ready = self:_readyPlayers(selected)
	if #ready < self:_setting("MinimumPlayers", 2, 2, 24) then return false, "Not enough ready players" end
	local ok, result = xpcall(function() return self:_begin(ready) end, debug.traceback)
	if not ok then self:_cleanup() warn("Skipping Rope could not start: " .. tostring(result)) return false, "Skipping Rope could not prepare the round" end
	return result
end

function Service:StartPractice(player, role)
	if not self.running then return false, "Service is not running" end
	if self.active then return false, "A round is already running" end
	if role ~= nil and role ~= "Jumper" then return false, "Choose the Jumper practice role" end
	if not self.records[player] then return false, "Player is not ready" end
	local ready = self:_readyPlayers({player})
	if #ready ~= 1 then return false, "Player is not ready for practice" end
	local ok, result = xpcall(function() return self:_begin(ready, true) end, debug.traceback)
	if not ok then self:_cleanup() warn("Skipping Rope practice could not start: " .. tostring(result)) return false, "Skipping Rope could not prepare practice" end
	return result
end

function Service:_finish(cancelled)
	if not self.active or self.phase == "Results" then return end
	local practice = cancelled == true or self.mode == "Practice"
	local winners, participants, names = {}, {}, {}
	for player, record in pairs(self.records) do
		if record.inRound and player.Parent == Players then
			local won = not cancelled and record.participating and alive(record)
			table.insert(participants, player.UserId)
			if won then table.insert(winners, player.UserId) table.insert(names, player.DisplayName) end
			attribute(player, "SKResult", cancelled and "Cancelled" or won and "Won" or "Lost")
		end
	end
	table.sort(winners) table.sort(participants) table.sort(names)
	attribute(self.state, "WinnersText", cancelled and "Round cancelled" or #winners > 0 and "Time's up! Jumpers win" or "Everybody is out")
	attribute(self.state, "WinnerNames", table.concat(names, ", "))
	attribute(self.state, "LastResultWinnerIds", table.concat(winners, ","))
	attribute(self.state, "LastResultParticipantIds", table.concat(participants, ","))
	attribute(self.state, "LastResultPractice", practice)
	attribute(self.state, "LastResultRound", self.roundNumber)
	local finishedAt = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	attribute(self.state, "FinishedAt", finishedAt)
	self.resultsEndsAt = finishedAt + self:_setting("ResultsSeconds", 7, 0, 15)
	attribute(self.state, "EndsAt", self.resultsEndsAt)
	self:_phase("Results")
	for _, record in pairs(self.records) do if record.inRound then self:_movement(record) end end
	local event = self.state:FindFirstChild("RoundFinished")
	if event and event:IsA("BindableEvent") then event:Fire({game = "SkippingRope", roundNumber = self.roundNumber,
		winnerUserIds = winners, participantUserIds = participants, practice = practice}) end
end

function Service:_tick()
	if not self.active then return end
	local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	if self.phase == "Results" then if now >= self.resultsEndsAt then self:_cleanup(self.currentRound) end return end
	local living, total = self:_publish()
	local minimum = self.mode == "Practice" and 1 or self:_setting("MinimumPlayers", 2, 2, 24)
	if total < minimum then self:_finish(true) return end
	if self.phase == "Countdown" then
		attribute(self.state, "CountdownValue", math.max(0, math.ceil(self.countdownEndsAt - now)))
		if now < self.countdownEndsAt then return end
		self.startedAt, self.endsAt = now, now + self:_setting("RoundDuration", 120, 120, 120)
		attribute(self.state, "StartedAt", now) attribute(self.state, "EndsAt", self.endsAt)
		self:_phase("Playing")
		for _, record in pairs(self.records) do
			if record.participating then record.previousAt = now self:_movement(record) end
		end
	end
	if self.phase ~= "Playing" then return end
	if now >= self.endsAt then self:_finish(false) return end
	attribute(self.state, "SpeedMultiplier", RopeMath.GetSpeedMultiplier(now - self.startedAt))
	for _, record in pairs(self.records) do
		if record.inRound then
			if record.participating and not alive(record) then self:_retire(record, "Reset")
			elseif record.participating then self:_movement(record) self:_sample(record, now)
			else self:_guardSpectator(record) end
		end
	end
	local survivors = self:_publish()
	if survivors == 0 then self:_finish(false) end
end

function Service:_cleanup(token)
	if token and token ~= self.currentRound then return end
	for _, record in pairs(self.records) do
		if record.inRound then
			self:_restoreCharacter(record)
			record.inRound, record.participating, record.role = false, false, ""
			record.spot, record.laneIndex, record.spotIndex = nil, nil, nil
			for name, value in pairs({ SKParticipating = false, SKRole = "", SKEliminated = false, SKHits = 0,
				SKHealthPercent = 100, SKLane = 0, SKSpot = 0 }) do attribute(record.player, name, value) end
			if record.character then attribute(record.character, "SKRole", "") end
			if self.lobbySpawn and self.lobbySpawn.Parent and alive(record) then self:_teleport(record, self.lobbySpawn.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, self.lobbySpawn.Size.Y * 0.5 + 3, 0)) end
		end
	end
	self.active, self.currentRound, self.mode, self.startedAt, self.endsAt = false, nil, "Waiting", 0, 0
	attribute(self.state, "Mode", "Waiting") attribute(self.state, "StartedAt", 0) attribute(self.state, "EndsAt", 0)
	attribute(self.state, "FinishedAt", 0)
	attribute(self.state, "CountdownValue", 0) attribute(self.state, "SpeedMultiplier", 1)
	self:_phase("Waiting")
end

function Service:StopRound()
	if not self.active then return false, "No round is running" end
	attribute(self.state, "LastResultPractice", true)
	attribute(self.state, "LastResultWinnerIds", "")
	self:_cleanup()
	attribute(self.state, "WinnersText", "Round stopped by admin")
	return true
end

function Service:Start()
	if self.running then return self end
	self.running, runningService = true, self
	for name, value in pairs({ Phase = "Waiting", Mode = "Waiting", EndsAt = 0, StartedAt = 0, FinishedAt = 0, CountdownValue = 0,
		RoundNumber = 0, RoundDuration = 120, CountdownSeconds = self:_setting("CountdownSeconds", 8, 3, 15),
		MinimumPlayers = self:_setting("MinimumPlayers", 2, 2, 24), MaxPlayers = 24, ParticipantCount = 0, AliveCount = 0,
		SpeedMultiplier = 1, WinnersText = "", WinnerNames = "", LastResultWinnerIds = "", LastResultParticipantIds = "",
		LastResultPractice = true, LastResultRound = 0 }) do attribute(self.state, name, value) end
	table.insert(self.connections, Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player) self:_addPlayer(player) end))
	table.insert(self.connections, Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player) self:_removePlayer(player) end))
	table.insert(self.connections, RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		self.tickAccumulator += dt
		if self.tickAccumulator < 0.033 then return end
		self.tickAccumulator = 0
		local ok, failure = xpcall(function() self:_tick() end, debug.traceback)
		if not ok then warn("Skipping Rope round failed: " .. tostring(failure)) self:_cleanup() end
	end))
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do self:_addPlayer(player) end
	return self
end

function Service:Stop()
	self.running = false
	self:_cleanup()
	disconnect(self.connections)
	for _, record in pairs(self.records) do disconnect(record.connections) disconnect(record.characterConnections) end
	table.clear(self.records)
	if runningService == self then runningService = nil end
end

local function direction(value)

		or math.abs(value.X) == math.huge or math.abs(value.Y) == math.huge or math.abs(value.Z) == math.huge
		or value.Magnitude < 0.01 or value.Magnitude > 10000 then return nil end
	return value.Unit

local function managedGun(tool)

function Service:_setting(name,fallback,minimum,maximum)
 local value=self.arena:GetAttribute(name)
 if typeof(value)~="number" or value~=value or math.abs(value)==math.huge then value=fallback end
 return math.clamp(value,minimum or 0,maximum or math.huge)
end

function Service.TeamAssignments(count)
 count = math.clamp(math.floor(count), 0, 60)
 if count < 2 then return {}, 0 end
 local result, offset = {}, count % 2 == 1 and math.random(0, 1) or 0
 for index=1,count do result[index]=(index-1+offset)%2+1 end
 return result, 2
end

function Service.ChooseTimeoutTeams(active, survivors, lives)
 local winners, bestAlive, bestLives = {}, -1, -1
 for _, team in ipairs(active) do
  local count, hearts = survivors[team] or 0, lives[team] or 0
  if count > 0 then
   if count > bestAlive or count == bestAlive and hearts > bestLives then
    winners, bestAlive, bestLives = {team}, count, hearts
   elseif count == bestAlive and hearts == bestLives then table.insert(winners,team) end
  end
 end
 table.sort(winners)
 return winners
end
function Service:_timeoutWinners()
 local active, _, survivors, lives = self:_teams(false)
 return Service.ChooseTimeoutTeams(active,survivors,lives)
end
function Service:_spawn(index, team)
	team = typeof(team) == "number" and team or 1
	local pads = self.spawnPads
	if #self.teamSpawns > 0 then
		local groupIndex = math.floor((team - 1) * #self.teamSpawns / math.max(self.teamCount, 1)) + 1
		local choices = parts(self.teamSpawns[math.clamp(groupIndex, 1, #self.teamSpawns)])
		if #choices > 0 then pads = choices end
	end
	local position = pads[(index - 1) % #pads + 1].Position
	local ring = math.floor((index - 1) / #pads)
	if ring > 0 then
		local angle = ring * 2.4
		position += Vector3.new(math.cos(angle), 0, math.sin(angle)) * (4 * ring)
	end
	local target = Vector3.new(self.bounds.Position.X, position.Y, self.bounds.Position.Z)
	if (target - position).Magnitude < 1 then target = position + Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end
	return CFrame.lookAt(position, target)
end

function Service:_teleport(record,cframe)
 if not record.root or not record.root.Parent or not record.character then return end
 if record.humanoid then record.humanoid.Sit=false end
 record.character:PivotTo(cframe*record.root.CFrame:Inverse()*record.character:GetPivot())
 record.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity,record.root.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero,Vector3.zero
 if record.frozen then record.lockedCFrame=record.root.CFrame end
end
function Service:_spectatorCFrame(record)
 local pads=parts(self.gameplay:FindFirstChild("SpectatorSpawns"))
 if #pads>0 then return pads[((record.spectatorIndex or record.spawnIndex or 1)-1)%#pads+1].CFrame end
 if self.lobbySpawn and self.lobbySpawn.Parent then return self.lobbySpawn.CFrame+Vector3.new(0,self.lobbySpawn.Size.Y/2+3,0) end
 return self.bounds.CFrame*CFrame.new(0,self.bounds.Size.Y/2+6,0)
end
function Service:_publishRecord(record)
 local colorName = record.participating and self:_colorName(record.teamId) or ""
 for name,value in pairs({
  MDParticipating=record.participating, MDTeamId=record.teamId or 0,
  MDTeamColorName=colorName, MDTeamColor=TEAM_COLORS[colorName] or Color3.new(1,1,1),
  MDTeamName=colorName~="" and colorName.." Team" or "",
  MDLives=record.lives or 0, MDMuddy=false, MDEliminated=record.eliminated==true,
  MDRescueProgress=0, MDHeatActive=false, MDHeatTargetUserId=0, MDHeatProgress=0,
  MDSprintMax=record.sprintMax or 0, MDSprintRemaining=math.floor((record.sprintRemaining or 0)*10)/10,
  MDSprinting=record.sprinting==true, MDSprintExhausted=record.sprintExhausted==true,
  MDFireReadyAt=record.fireReadyAt or 0
 }) do attribute(record.player,name,value) end
 local tool=record.participating and not record.eliminated and record.character and record.character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
 attribute(record.player,"MDTool",tool and managedGun(tool) and tool.Name or "")
end
function Service:_collision(record, part)
	if not record.participating or not part:IsA("BasePart") then return end
	if not record.originalGroups[part] then record.originalGroups[part] = part.CollisionGroup end
	part.CollisionGroup = "MudPlayer"

function Service:_role(record)
 self:_publishRecord(record)
 if not record.character or not record.character.Parent then return end
 for _, part in ipairs(record.character:GetDescendants()) do self:_collision(record,part) end
 if not record.participating then return end
 local outline=record.character:FindFirstChild("MDOutline")

 outline.OutlineColor=TEAM_COLORS[self:_colorName(record.teamId)]
 outline.Enabled=not record.eliminated
 local label=record.character:FindFirstChild("MDLivesDisplay")
 local assets=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("MudAssets")

 if not label and template and template:IsA("BillboardGui") then

   end
  end
  local team=label:FindFirstChild("TeamName",true)
  if team and team:IsA("TextLabel") then team.Text=record.eliminated and "OUT" or self:_colorName(record.teamId):upper()
   team.TextColor3=record.eliminated and Color3.fromRGB(210,214,225) or TEAM_COLORS[self:_colorName(record.teamId)] end
 end
 local torso=record.isBot and record.character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
 if torso then torso.Color=TEAM_COLORS[self:_colorName(record.teamId)] end
end
function Service:_movement(record)
 if not record.participating or not alive(record) then return end
 local h=record.humanoid
 if not record.originalMovement then record.originalMovement={WalkSpeed=h.WalkSpeed,JumpPower=h.JumpPower,JumpHeight=h.JumpHeight,AutoRotate=h.AutoRotate} end
 local multiplier=not record.frozen and not record.eliminated and record.sprinting and (record.sprintRemaining or 0)>0
  and workspace:GetServerTimeNow()<(record.sprintLeaseEndsAt or 0) and self:_setting("SprintMultiplier",2.5,1,3) or 1
 h.WalkSpeed=record.frozen and 0 or self:_setting("BaseSpeed",16,0,30)*multiplier
 h.JumpPower=record.frozen and 0 or record.originalMovement.JumpPower
 h.JumpHeight=record.frozen and 0 or record.originalMovement.JumpHeight
 h.AutoRotate=not record.frozen and record.originalMovement.AutoRotate
 if record.frozen then record.lockedCFrame=record.lockedCFrame or record.root.CFrame h.Jump=false end
end

 record.frozen=frozen

end
function Service:_toolsAllowed(record)
 return not record.isBot and self.active and record.participating and not record.eliminated and alive(record)
  and record.player.Character==record.character and (record.teamId==1 or record.teamId==2)
  and not record.player:GetAttribute("BBParticipating") and not record.player:GetAttribute("TGParticipating")
  and not record.player:GetAttribute("HSParticipating") and not record.player:GetAttribute("DGParticipating")
  and not record.player:GetAttribute("SKParticipating")
end
function Service:_destroyTools(record)
	if record.isBot then return end
	for _, tool in ipairs(record.managedTools or {}) do if tool.Parent then tool:Destroy() end end
	record.managedTools = {}
	local containers = { record.character, record.player.Character, record.player:FindFirstChild("Backpack"), record.player:FindFirstChild("StarterGear") }
	for _, container in pairs(containers) do
		for _, tool in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do if managedGun(tool) then tool:Destroy() end end
	end
	attribute(record.player, "MDTool", "")
end

function Service:_watchTools(record, container, connections)
	local function validate(tool)
		if not managedGun(tool) then return end
		task.defer(function()
			if not tool.Parent or tool.Parent ~= container then return end
			if container.Name == "StarterGear" or not self:_toolsAllowed(record)
				or tool:GetAttribute("MDRound") ~= self.roundNumber or tool:GetAttribute("MDOwnerUserId") ~= record.player.UserId
				or tool:GetAttribute("MDTeamId") ~= record.teamId or tool.Name ~= (record.teamId==1 and "HeatGun" or "MudGun") then
				tool:Destroy()
				self:_publishRecord(record)
			end
		end)
	end
	table.insert(connections, container.ChildAdded:Connect(validate))
	for _, tool in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do validate(tool) end
end

function Service:_giveTools(record)
 self:_destroyTools(record)

 local backpack=record.player:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
 local assets=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("MudAssets")

 if not backpack or not template or not template:IsA("Tool") then return end
 record.humanoid:UnequipTools()
 local tool=template:Clone()
 tool:SetAttribute("MDManaged",true) tool:SetAttribute("MDRound",self.roundNumber)
 tool:SetAttribute("MDOwnerUserId",record.player.UserId) tool:SetAttribute("MDTeamId",record.teamId)
 tool.CanBeDropped=false tool.Enabled=true
 table.insert(record.managedTools,tool) tool.Parent=backpack
 record.humanoid:EquipTool(tool)
 self:_publishRecord(record)
end
function Service:_restore(record)
	record.sprintHeld, record.sprinting = false, false
	if record.originalMovement and record.humanoid and record.humanoid.Parent then for name, value in pairs(record.originalMovement) do record.humanoid[name] = value end end
	record.originalMovement, record.frozen, record.lockedCFrame = nil, false, nil
	for part, group in pairs(record.originalGroups) do if part.Parent then pcall(function() part.CollisionGroup = group end) end end
	table.clear(record.originalGroups)
	if record.character then for _, name in ipairs({ "MDOutline", "MDMuddyLabel", "MDMudCoating", "MDLivesDisplay" }) do local object = record.character:FindFirstChild(name) if object then object:Destroy() end end end
	self:_destroyTools(record)
	if record.root and record.root.Parent and not record.isBot then pcall(function() record.root:SetNetworkOwnershipAuto() end) end
end

function Service:_record(player, isBot)

		teamId = 0, lives = 0, muddy = false, eliminated = false, originalGroups = {}, connections = {}, characterConnections = {},
		spawnIndex = 1, rescueProgress = 0, sprintMax = 0, sprintRemaining = 0, fireReadyAt = 0, requests = {}, managedTools = {} }
	self.records[player] = record self:_publishRecord(record)
	return record
end

function Service:_setupCharacter(record, character)
	if self.records[record.player] ~= record or record.player.Character ~= character then return end
	record.generation = (record.generation or 0) + 1
	local generation = record.generation
	disconnect(record.characterConnections) self:_restore(record)
	record.character, record.root, record.humanoid, record.ready = character, nil, nil, false
	local humanoid, root = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10), character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
	if self.records[record.player] ~= record or record.generation ~= generation or record.player.Character ~= character or not character.Parent or not humanoid or not root then return end
	record.humanoid, record.root, record.ready = humanoid, root, true
	table.insert(record.characterConnections, character.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(part) self:_collision(record, part) end))
	self:_watchTools(record, character, record.characterConnections)
	table.insert(record.characterConnections, humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
		if record.participating then self:_eliminate(record, "Reset") end
		record.ready = false
		self:_destroyTools(record)
	end))
	if record.participating then
		self:_eliminate(record, "Reset")
		self:_teleport(record, self:_spectatorCFrame(record))
		self:_freeze(record, self.phase ~= "Playing") self:_role(record)
	end
end

function Service:_addPlayer(player)
	if self.records[player] then return end
	local record = self:_record(player, false)
	table.insert(record.connections, player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character) task.spawn(function() self:_setupCharacter(record, character) end) end))
	table.insert(record.connections, player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(character)
		if record.character == character then
			if record.participating then self:_eliminate(record, "Reset") end
			record.ready = false
			self:_destroyTools(record)
		end
	end))
	local function watchContainer(container)
		if container:IsA("Backpack") or container.Name == "StarterGear" then self:_watchTools(record, container, record.connections) end
	end
	table.insert(record.connections, player.ChildAdded:Connect(watchContainer))
	for _, container in ipairs(player:GetChildren()) do watchContainer(container) end
	for _, name in ipairs({ "BBParticipating", "TGParticipating", "HSParticipating", "DGParticipating", "SKParticipating" }) do
		table.insert(record.connections, player:GetAttributeChangedSignal(name):Connect(function()
			if player:GetAttribute(name) then self:_destroyTools(record) end
		end))
	end
	self:_destroyTools(record)
	if player.Character then task.spawn(function() self:_setupCharacter(record, player.Character) end) end
end

function Service:_removePlayer(player)
	local record = self.records[player] if not record then return end
	record.participating = false self:_restore(record) disconnect(record.connections) disconnect(record.characterConnections) self.records[player] = nil
	if self.practiceOwner == player then self:StopRound() else self:_teams(true) end
end

function Service:_readyPlayers(selected)
