-- Variables used in tracking if the character is using a ControllerManager.
-- This implementation assumes the common case of the ControllerManager being a
-- child of the character, and that only one ControllerManager exists under a given
-- character. If a ControllerManager is not placed under its associated character,
-- then it will not be detected by this script.
-- The basis for this decision is performance: A ChildAdded listener on the
-- character is less of a performance hit than a ChildAdded listener on the
-- Workspace. And a FindFirstChild is more performant than checking for multiple
-- controllers via GetChildren.
local groundSensorChangedListener:RBXScriptSignal? = nil
local managerRootChangedListener:RBXScriptSignal? = nil
local managerParentChangedListener:RBXScriptSignal? = nil
local charGroundSensor:ControllerPartSensor? = nil
local charControllerManager:ControllerManager? = nil

local CCLAnimationFixed
do
	local success, result = pcall(function()
		return UserSettings():IsUserFeatureEnabled("UserAnimationAbilityManagerFixed")
	end)
	CCLAnimationFixed = success and result
end

-- Clean up listeners associated with the character's ControllerManager
function resetManagerListeners()
	if groundSensorChangedListener then
		groundSensorChangedListener:Disconnect()
		groundSensorChangedListener = nil
	end
	if managerRootChangedListener then
		managerRootChangedListener:Disconnect()
		managerRootChangedListener = nil
	end
	if managerParentChangedListener then
		managerParentChangedListener:Disconnect()
		managerParentChangedListener = nil
	end
end

-- Clean up all listeners and reset state.
function teardownManager()
	resetManagerListeners()
	charGroundSensor = nil
	charControllerManager = nil
end

-- Returns true if checkManager controls the character associated with this script
-- If so, then checkManager is assigned to charControllerManager.
-- TODO: Remove this method when UserAnimationAbilityManagerFixed is made permanently true.
function processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(checkManager:ControllerManager):boolean
	if checkManager.RootPart == Character.PrimaryPart then
		if charControllerManager ~= checkManager then
			resetManagerListeners()
			charGroundSensor = checkManager.GroundSensor
			groundSensorChangedListener = checkManager:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
				if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(checkManager) then
					groundSensorChangedListener:Disconnect()
					groundSensorChangedListener = nil
				end
			end)
			managerRootChangedListener = checkManager:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
				if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(checkManager) then
					managerRootChangedListener:Disconnect()
					managerRootChangedListener = nil
				end
			end)
			managerParentChangedListener = checkManager.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
				if parent == nil then
					resetManagerListeners()
					lookForControllerManager()
				end
			end)
			charControllerManager = checkManager
		end
		return true
	end
	return false
end

-- Attach to a confirmed-valid manager: record it, read its current GroundSensor,
-- and watch for GroundSensor changes, RootPart changes, and removal.
function setupManager(manager:ControllerManager)
	charControllerManager = manager
	charGroundSensor = manager.GroundSensor

	groundSensorChangedListener = manager:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
		charGroundSensor = charControllerManager.GroundSensor
	end)

	managerRootChangedListener = manager:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
		if manager.RootPart ~= Character.PrimaryPart then
			teardownManager()
			lookForControllerManager()
		end
	end)

	managerParentChangedListener = manager.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
		if parent == nil then
			teardownManager()
			lookForControllerManager()
		end
	end)
end

-- Looks for the first ControllerManager directly childed to the character. If such
-- a controller does not exist or if it does not control that character, then a listener
-- is set up to check if a controller is ever added.
function lookForControllerManager()
	if CCLAnimationFixed then
		local child:ControllerManager? = Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
		if child then
			if child.RootPart == Character.PrimaryPart then
				setupManager(child)
			else
				-- Manager exists but RootPart not yet assigned; wait for it.
				local rootPartListener:RBXScriptSignal
				rootPartListener = child:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
					if child.RootPart == Character.PrimaryPart then
						rootPartListener:Disconnect()
						setupManager(child)
					end
				end)
			end
		else
			local managerAddedListener:RBXScriptSignal
			managerAddedListener = Character.ChildAdded:Connect(function(newChild)
				if newChild:IsA("ControllerManager") then
					managerAddedListener:Disconnect()
					lookForControllerManager()
				end
			end)
		end
	else
		charGroundSensor = nil
		charControllerManager = nil

		local child:ControllerManager? = Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
		if child then
			processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(child)
		end
		-- The call to processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter above will have
		-- assigned charControllerManager on success
		if charControllerManager == nil then
			local managerAddedListener:RBXScriptSignal
			managerAddedListener = Character.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
				if child:IsA("ControllerManager") then
					if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(child) then
						managerAddedListener:Disconnect()
						managerAddedListener = nil
					end
				end
			end)
		end
	end
end

function configureAnimationSet(name, fileList)
	if (animTable[name] ~= nil) then
		for _, connection in pairs(animTable[name].connections) do
			connection:disconnect()
		end
	end
	animTable[name] = {}
	animTable[name].count = 0
	animTable[name].totalWeight = 0
	animTable[name].connections = {}

	local allowCustomAnimations = true

	local success, msg = pcall(function() allowCustomAnimations = game:GetService("StarterPlayer").AllowCustomAnimations end)
	if not success then
		allowCustomAnimations = true
	end

	-- check for config values
	local config = script:FindFirstChild(name)
	if (allowCustomAnimations and config ~= nil) then
		table.insert(animTable[name].connections, config.ChildAdded:connect(function(child) configureAnimationSet(name, fileList) end))
		table.insert(animTable[name].connections, config.ChildRemoved:connect(function(child) configureAnimationSet(name, fileList) end))

		local idx = 0
		for _, childPart in pairs(config:GetChildren()) do
			if (childPart:IsA("Animation")) then
				local newWeight = 1
				local weightObject = childPart:FindFirstChild("Weight")
				if (weightObject ~= nil) then
					newWeight = weightObject.Value
				end
				animTable[name].count = animTable[name].count + 1
				idx = animTable[name].count
				animTable[name][idx] = {}
				animTable[name][idx].anim = childPart
				animTable[name][idx].weight = newWeight
				animTable[name].totalWeight = animTable[name].totalWeight + animTable[name][idx].weight
				table.insert(animTable[name].connections, childPart.Changed:connect(function(property) configureAnimationSet(name, fileList) end))
				table.insert(animTable[name].connections, childPart.ChildAdded:connect(function(property) configureAnimationSet(name, fileList) end))
				table.insert(animTable[name].connections, childPart.ChildRemoved:connect(function(property) configureAnimationSet(name, fileList) end))
			end
		end
	end

	-- fallback to defaults
	if (animTable[name].count <= 0) then
		for idx, anim in pairs(fileList) do
			animTable[name][idx] = {}
			animTable[name][idx].anim = Instance.new("Animation")
			animTable[name][idx].anim.Name = name
			animTable[name][idx].anim.AnimationId = anim.id
			animTable[name][idx].weight = anim.weight
			animTable[name].count = animTable[name].count + 1
			animTable[name].totalWeight = animTable[name].totalWeight + anim.weight
		end
	end

	-- preload anims
	for i, animType in pairs(animTable) do
		for idx = 1, animType.count, 1 do
			if PreloadedAnims[animType[idx].anim.AnimationId] == nil then
				Humanoid:LoadAnimation(animType[idx].anim)
				PreloadedAnims[animType[idx].anim.AnimationId] = true
			end
		end
	end
end

-- declarations
local toolAnim = "None"
local toolAnimTime = 0

local jumpAnimTime = 0
local jumpAnimDuration = 0.31

local toolTransitionTime = 0.1
local fallTransitionTime = 0.2

local currentlyPlayingEmote = false

-- functions

function stopAllAnimations()
	local oldAnim = currentAnim

	-- return to idle if finishing an emote
	if (emoteNames[oldAnim] ~= nil and emoteNames[oldAnim] == false) then
		oldAnim = "idle"
	end

	if currentlyPlayingEmote then
		oldAnim = "idle"
		currentlyPlayingEmote = false
	end

	currentAnim = ""
	currentAnimInstance = nil
	if (currentAnimKeyframeHandler ~= nil) then
		currentAnimKeyframeHandler:disconnect()
	end

	if (currentAnimTrack ~= nil) then
		currentAnimTrack:Stop()
		currentAnimTrack:Destroy()
		currentAnimTrack = nil
	end

	-- clean up walk if there is one
	if (runAnimKeyframeHandler ~= nil) then
		runAnimKeyframeHandler:disconnect()
	end

	if (runAnimTrack ~= nil) then
		runAnimTrack:Stop()
		runAnimTrack:Destroy()
		runAnimTrack = nil
	end

	return oldAnim
end

function getHeightScale()
	if Humanoid then
		if not Humanoid.AutomaticScalingEnabled then
			-- When auto scaling is not enabled, the rig scale stands in for
			-- a computed scale.
			return getRigScale()
		end

		local scale = Humanoid.HipHeight / HumanoidHipHeight
		if AnimationSpeedDampeningObject == nil then
			AnimationSpeedDampeningObject = script:FindFirstChild("ScaleDampeningPercent")
		end
		if AnimationSpeedDampeningObject ~= nil then
			scale = 1 + (Humanoid.HipHeight - HumanoidHipHeight) * AnimationSpeedDampeningObject.Value / HumanoidHipHeight
		end
		return scale
	end
	return getRigScale()
end

local function rootMotionCompensation(speed)
	local speedScaled = speed * 1.25
	local heightScale = getHeightScale()
	local runSpeed = speedScaled / heightScale
	return runSpeed
end

local smallButNotZero = 0.0001
local function setRunSpeed(speed)
	local normalizedWalkSpeed = 0.5 -- established empirically using current `913402848` walk animation
	local normalizedRunSpeed  = 1
	local runSpeed = rootMotionCompensation(speed)

	local walkAnimationWeight = smallButNotZero
	local runAnimationWeight = smallButNotZero
	local timeWarp = 1

	if runSpeed <= normalizedWalkSpeed then
		walkAnimationWeight = 1
		timeWarp = runSpeed/normalizedWalkSpeed
	elseif runSpeed < normalizedRunSpeed then
		local fadeInRun = (runSpeed - normalizedWalkSpeed)/(normalizedRunSpeed - normalizedWalkSpeed)
		walkAnimationWeight = 1 - fadeInRun
		runAnimationWeight  = fadeInRun
	else
		timeWarp = runSpeed/normalizedRunSpeed
		runAnimationWeight = 1
	end
	currentAnimTrack:AdjustWeight(walkAnimationWeight)
	runAnimTrack:AdjustWeight(runAnimationWeight)
	currentAnimTrack:AdjustSpeed(timeWarp)
	runAnimTrack:AdjustSpeed(timeWarp)
end

function setAnimationSpeed(speed)
	if currentAnim == "walk" then
		setRunSpeed(speed)
	else
		if speed ~= currentAnimSpeed then
			currentAnimSpeed = speed
			currentAnimTrack:AdjustSpeed(currentAnimSpeed)
		end
	end
end

function keyFrameReachedFunc(frameName)
	if (frameName == "End") then
		if currentAnim == "walk" then
			if runAnimTrack.Looped ~= true then
				runAnimTrack.TimePosition = 0.0
			end
			if currentAnimTrack.Looped ~= true then
				currentAnimTrack.TimePosition = 0.0
			end
		else
			local repeatAnim = currentAnim
			-- return to idle if finishing an emote
			if (emoteNames[repeatAnim] ~= nil and emoteNames[repeatAnim] == false) then
				repeatAnim = "idle"
			end

			if currentlyPlayingEmote then
				if currentAnimTrack.Looped then
					-- Allow the emote to loop
					return
				end

				repeatAnim = "idle"
				currentlyPlayingEmote = false
			end

			local animSpeed = currentAnimSpeed
			playAnimation(repeatAnim, 0.15, Humanoid)
			setAnimationSpeed(animSpeed)
		end
	end
end

function rollAnimation(animName)
	local roll = math.random(1, animTable[animName].totalWeight)
	local origRoll = roll
	local idx = 1
	while (roll > animTable[animName][idx].weight) do
		roll = roll - animTable[animName][idx].weight
		idx = idx + 1
	end
	return idx
end

local function switchToAnim(anim, animName, transitionTime, humanoid)
	-- switch animation
	if (anim ~= currentAnimInstance) then

		if (currentAnimTrack ~= nil) then
			currentAnimTrack:Stop(transitionTime)
			currentAnimTrack:Destroy()
		end

		if (runAnimTrack ~= nil) then
			runAnimTrack:Stop(transitionTime)
			runAnimTrack:Destroy()
			runAnimTrack = nil
		end

		currentAnimSpeed = 1.0

		-- load it to the humanoid; get AnimationTrack
		currentAnimTrack = humanoid:LoadAnimation(anim)
		currentAnimTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Core

		-- play the animation
		currentAnimTrack:Play(transitionTime)
		currentAnim = animName
		currentAnimInstance = anim

		-- set up keyframe name triggers
		if (currentAnimKeyframeHandler ~= nil) then
			currentAnimKeyframeHandler:disconnect()
		end
		currentAnimKeyframeHandler = currentAnimTrack.KeyframeReached:connect(keyFrameReachedFunc)

		-- check to see if we need to blend a walk/run animation
		if animName == "walk" then
			local runAnimName = "run"
			local runIdx = rollAnimation(runAnimName)

			runAnimTrack = humanoid:LoadAnimation(animTable[runAnimName][runIdx].anim)
			runAnimTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Core
			runAnimTrack:Play(transitionTime)

			if (runAnimKeyframeHandler ~= nil) then
				runAnimKeyframeHandler:disconnect()
			end
			runAnimKeyframeHandler = runAnimTrack.KeyframeReached:connect(keyFrameReachedFunc)
		end
	end
end

function playAnimation(animName, transitionTime, humanoid)
	local idx = rollAnimation(animName)
	local anim = animTable[animName][idx].anim

	switchToAnim(anim, animName, transitionTime, humanoid)
	currentlyPlayingEmote = false
end

function playEmote(emoteAnim, transitionTime, humanoid)
	switchToAnim(emoteAnim, emoteAnim.Name, transitionTime, humanoid)
	currentlyPlayingEmote = true
end

function playToolAnimation(animName, transitionTime, humanoid, priority)

		if (toolAnimTrack ~= nil) then

		-- load it to the humanoid; get AnimationTrack
		toolAnimTrack = humanoid:LoadAnimation(anim)

		toolAnimName = animName

		currentToolAnimKeyframeHandler = toolAnimTrack.KeyframeReached:connect(toolKeyFrameReachedFunc)
	end

function onRunning(speed)
	local heightScale = getHeightScale()

	-- Adjust the walking speed if a ControllerManager is being used.
	-- "speed" is world speed, whereas we want local speed.
	-- IE, do not animate a walk if the character is stationary atop
	-- a moving platform.
	if charGroundSensor ~= nil and Humanoid.EvaluateStateMachine == false then
		local hrp = Humanoid.RootPart
		local sensedPart = charGroundSensor.SensedPart
		if sensedPart then
			local pos = charGroundSensor.HitFrame.Position
			local floorVel = sensedPart:GetVelocityAtPosition(pos)
			local assemblyVel = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			-- Ignore y-velocity, so that jumping does not influence the animation speed
			local relVel = Vector3.new(assemblyVel.X - floorVel.X, 0, assemblyVel.Z - floorVel.Z)
			local relSpeed = relVel.Magnitude
			local moveMag = charControllerManager.MovingDirection.Magnitude
			if moveMag < 0.1 then
				relSpeed = 0
				moveMag = 0
			elseif moveMag > 1.0 then
				moveMag = 1.0
			end
			speed = relSpeed * moveMag
		end
	end

	local movedDuringEmote = currentlyPlayingEmote and Humanoid.MoveDirection == Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	local speedThreshold = movedDuringEmote and (Humanoid.WalkSpeed / heightScale) or 0.75
	if speed > speedThreshold * heightScale then
		local scale = 16.0
		playAnimation("walk", 0.2, Humanoid)
		setAnimationSpeed(speed / scale)
		pose = "Running"
	else
		if emoteNames[currentAnim] == nil and not currentlyPlayingEmote then
			playAnimation("idle", 0.2, Humanoid)
			pose = "Standing"
		end
	end
end

local lastTick = 0

function stepAnimate(currentTime)
	local amplitude = 1
	local frequency = 1
	local deltaTime = currentTime - lastTick
	lastTick = currentTime

	local climbFudge = 0
	local setAngles = false

	if (jumpAnimTime > 0) then
		jumpAnimTime = jumpAnimTime - deltaTime
	end

	if (pose == "FreeFall" and jumpAnimTime <= 0) then
		playAnimation("fall", fallTransitionTime, Humanoid)
	elseif (pose == "Seated") then
		playAnimation("sit", 0.5, Humanoid)
		return
	elseif (pose == "Running") then
		playAnimation("walk", 0.2, Humanoid)
	elseif (pose == "Dead" or pose == "GettingUp" or pose == "FallingDown" or pose == "Seated" or pose == "PlatformStanding") then
		stopAllAnimations()
		amplitude = 0.1
		frequency = 1
		setAngles = true
	end

	-- Tool Animation handling
	local tool = Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
	if tool and tool:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
		local animStringValueObject = getToolAnim(tool)

		if animStringValueObject then
			toolAnim = animStringValueObject.Value
			-- message recieved, delete StringValue
			animStringValueObject.Parent = nil
			toolAnimTime = currentTime + .3
		end

		if currentTime > toolAnimTime then
			toolAnimTime = 0
			toolAnim = "None"
		end

		animateTool()
	else
		stopToolAnimations()
		toolAnim = "None"
		toolAnimInstance = nil
		toolAnimTime = 0
	end
end

function configureAnimationSet(name, fileList)
	if (animTable[name] ~= nil) then
		for _, connection in pairs(animTable[name].connections) do
			connection:disconnect()
		end
	end
	animTable[name] = {}
	animTable[name].count = 0
	animTable[name].totalWeight = 0	
	animTable[name].connections = {}

	-- check for config values
	local config = script:FindFirstChild(name)
	if (config ~= nil) then
--		print("Loading anims " .. name)
		table.insert(animTable[name].connections, config.ChildAdded:connect(function(child) configureAnimationSet(name, fileList) end))
		table.insert(animTable[name].connections, config.ChildRemoved:connect(function(child) configureAnimationSet(name, fileList) end))
		local idx = 1
		for _, childPart in pairs(config:GetChildren()) do
			if (childPart:IsA("Animation")) then
				table.insert(animTable[name].connections, childPart.Changed:connect(function(property) configureAnimationSet(name, fileList) end))
				animTable[name][idx] = {}
				animTable[name][idx].anim = childPart
				local weightObject = childPart:FindFirstChild("Weight")
				if (weightObject == nil) then
					animTable[name][idx].weight = 1
				else
					animTable[name][idx].weight = weightObject.Value
				end
				animTable[name].count = animTable[name].count + 1
				animTable[name].totalWeight = animTable[name].totalWeight + animTable[name][idx].weight
	--			print(name .. " [" .. idx .. "] " .. animTable[name][idx].anim.AnimationId .. " (" .. animTable[name][idx].weight .. ")")
				idx = idx + 1
			end
		end
	end

	-- fallback to defaults
	if (animTable[name].count <= 0) then
		for idx, anim in pairs(fileList) do
			animTable[name][idx] = {}
			animTable[name][idx].anim = Instance.new("Animation")
			animTable[name][idx].anim.Name = name
			animTable[name][idx].anim.AnimationId = anim.id
			animTable[name][idx].weight = anim.weight
			animTable[name].count = animTable[name].count + 1
			animTable[name].totalWeight = animTable[name].totalWeight + anim.weight
--			print(name .. " [" .. idx .. "] " .. anim.id .. " (" .. anim.weight .. ")")
		end
	end
end

	local climbFudge = 0
	local setAngles = false

  	if (jumpAnimTime > 0) then
  		jumpAnimTime = jumpAnimTime - deltaTime
  	end

	if (pose == "FreeFall" and jumpAnimTime <= 0) then
		playAnimation("fall", fallTransitionTime, Humanoid)
	elseif (pose == "Seated") then
		playAnimation("sit", 0.5, Humanoid)
		return
	elseif (pose == "Running") then
		playAnimation("walk", 0.1, Humanoid)
	elseif (pose == "Dead" or pose == "GettingUp" or pose == "FallingDown" or pose == "Seated" or pose == "PlatformStanding") then
--		print("Wha " .. pose)
		stopAllAnimations()
		amplitude = 0.1
		frequency = 1
		setAngles = true
	end

	if (setAngles) then
		local desiredAngle = amplitude * math.sin(time * frequency)

		RightShoulder:SetDesiredAngle(desiredAngle + climbFudge)
		LeftShoulder:SetDesiredAngle(desiredAngle - climbFudge)
		RightHip:SetDesiredAngle(-desiredAngle)
		LeftHip:SetDesiredAngle(-desiredAngle)
	end

	-- Tool Animation handling
	local tool = getTool()
	if tool and tool:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
	
		local animStringValueObject = getToolAnim(tool)

		if animStringValueObject then
			toolAnim = animStringValueObject.Value
			-- message recieved, delete StringValue
			animStringValueObject.Parent = nil
			toolAnimTime = time + .3
		end

		if time > toolAnimTime then
			toolAnimTime = 0
			toolAnim = "None"
		end

		animateTool()		
	else
		stopToolAnimations()
		toolAnim = "None"
		toolAnimInstance = nil
		toolAnimTime = 0
	end
end

local function connect(bucket, signal, callback)

local function release(skin)
	local record = records[skin]
	if not record then return end
	records[skin] = nil
	if record.fallback.Parent then record.fallback.Visible = false end
	for _, connection in ipairs(record.connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
end

local function tint(color, imageColor)
	return Color3.new(color.R * imageColor.R, color.G * imageColor.G, color.B * imageColor.B)
end

local function faceColor(skin, fallback)
	local image = skin.Image
	local id = string.match(image, "^rbxassetid://(%d+)") or string.match(image, "[?&]id=(%d+)")
	local palette = id and imagePalettes[id]
	if palette then return palettes[palette] end
	for name, color in pairs(palettes) do
		if image ~= "" and skin:GetAttribute(name .. "Image") == image then return color end
	end
	return fallback:GetAttribute("FallbackFaceColor") or palettes.Cream
end

local function bind(skin)
	if not alive or records[skin] or not (skin:IsA("ImageLabel") or skin:IsA("ImageButton")) then return end
	local parent = skin.Parent
	local fallback = parent and parent:FindFirstChild(skin.Name .. "Fallback")
	if not fallback or not fallback:IsA("Frame") or fallback:GetAttribute("BackgroundFallbackFor") ~= skin.Name then return end
	local edge = fallback:FindFirstChild("Edge")
	local face = edge and edge:FindFirstChild("Face")
	if not edge or not face then return end
	local record = { connections = {}, fallback = fallback }
	records[skin] = record
	local function refresh()
		if not alive or records[skin] ~= record or skin.Parent ~= fallback.Parent then return end
		local transparency = math.clamp(skin.ImageTransparency, 0, 1)
		fallback.Visible = skin.Visible and skin.Image ~= "" and not skin.IsLoaded and transparency < 1
		fallback.BackgroundTransparency = transparency
		edge.BackgroundTransparency = transparency
		face.BackgroundTransparency = transparency
		fallback.BackgroundColor3 = tint(fallback:GetAttribute("FallbackInkColor") or Color3.fromRGB(31, 38, 60), skin.ImageColor3)
		local color = faceColor(skin, fallback)
		edge.BackgroundColor3 = tint(color:Lerp(white, 0.72), skin.ImageColor3)
		face.BackgroundColor3 = tint(color, skin.ImageColor3)
	end
	record.refresh = refresh
	for _, property in ipairs({ "IsLoaded", "Image", "ImageTransparency", "ImageColor3", "Visible" }) do
		connect(record.connections, skin:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property), refresh)
	end
	connect(record.connections, skin.AttributeChanged, refresh)
	connect(record.connections, fallback.AttributeChanged, refresh)
	connect(record.connections, skin.AncestryChanged, function()
		if not skin:IsDescendantOf(gui) or skin.Parent ~= fallback.Parent then release(skin) end
	end)
	connect(record.connections, fallback.AncestryChanged, function()
		if not fallback:IsDescendantOf(gui) or fallback.Parent ~= skin.Parent then release(skin) end
	end)
	refresh()
end

local function syncMusic(participating, phase)
	local sound = SoundService:FindFirstChild("BritishBulldogMusic")
	local canPlay = participating and musicStarted and (phase == "Countdown" or phase == "Crossing")
	canPlay = canPlay and sound and sound:IsA("Sound") and sound:GetAttribute("Enabled") == true
	canPlay = canPlay and sound.SoundId ~= "" and sound.SoundId ~= "rbxassetid://0"
	if not canPlay then

local function update()
	local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	local phase = textAttribute(state, "Phase", "Waiting")
	local round = numberAttribute(state, "RoundNumber", 0)
	local participating = player:GetAttribute("BBParticipating") == true
	local role = textAttribute(player, "BBRole", "Spectator")
	local active = phase == "Countdown" or phase == "Crossing" or phase == "Results"

	if round ~= previousRound then
		musicStarted = false
		callEndsAt = 0
		previousRound = round
	end
	if phase ~= previousPhase then
		if phase == "Crossing" then
			musicStarted = true
			if previousPhase == "Countdown" then
				callEndsAt = now + 0.9
			end
		elseif phase == "Waiting" or phase == "Intermission" or phase == "Results" then
			musicStarted = false
			callEndsAt = 0
		end
		previousPhase = phase
	end

	gui.Enabled = participating and active
	topCard.Visible = phase ~= "Results"
	gui.RolePill.Visible = phase ~= "Results" and not gui:FindFirstChild("MovementControls")
	results.Visible = phase == "Results"
	tagged.Visible = role == "Tagged" and phase ~= "Results"

	local endsAt = numberAttribute(state, "EndsAt", 0)
	local timeLeft = math.max(0, math.ceil(endsAt - now))
	if phase == "Countdown" and endsAt <= 0 then
		timeLeft = math.max(0, math.ceil(numberAttribute(state, "RoundDuration", 180)))
	end
	local minutes = math.floor(timeLeft / 60)
	timer.Text = string.format("%d:%02d", minutes, timeLeft % 60)
	timer.TextColor3 = timeLeft <= 30 and Color3.fromRGB(255, 211, 78) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 249, 224)
	bulldogChip.Count.Text = tostring(math.max(0, math.floor(numberAttribute(state, "BulldogCount", 0))))
	runnerChip.Count.Text = tostring(math.max(0, math.floor(numberAttribute(state, "RunnerCount", 0))))
	bulldogChip.Caption.Text = numberAttribute(state, "BulldogCount", 0) == 1 and "BULLDOG" or "BULLDOGS"
	runnerChip.Caption.Text = numberAttribute(state, "RunnerCount", 0) == 1 and "RUNNER" or "RUNNERS"
	phaseLabel.Text = "CROSSING " .. tostring(math.max(1, math.floor(numberAttribute(state, "CrossingNumber", 1))))

	local roleColor = colors[role] or colors.Spectator
	rolePanel.BackgroundColor3 = roleColor
	roleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 249, 224)
	roleLabel.Text = string.upper(role)
	local status = textAttribute(player, "BBStatus", "")
	taggedStatus.Text = status ~= "" and status or "FROZEN"

	local deadline = numberAttribute(player, "BBDepartureEndsAt", 0)
	local departureTime = math.max(0, math.ceil(deadline - now))
	local showDeparture = participating and role == "Runner" and phase == "Crossing" and player:GetAttribute("BBMustLeave") == true and departureTime > 0
	local compactDeparture = gui:FindFirstChild("CompactDeparture")
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local useCompactDeparture = compactDeparture and camera and (camera.ViewportSize.X < 980 or camera.ViewportSize.Y < 450)
	departure.Visible = showDeparture and not useCompactDeparture
	if compactDeparture then
		compactDeparture.Visible = showDeparture and useCompactDeparture == true
		compactDeparture.Panel.SecondsBadge.Seconds.Text = tostring(departureTime)
	end
	departureSeconds.Text = tostring(departureTime)

	local count = math.floor(numberAttribute(state, "CountdownValue", 0))
	local counting = phase == "Countdown" and count >= 1 and count <= 3
	local called = phase == "Crossing" and now < callEndsAt
	countdown.Visible = counting or called
	countdown.Text = called and "BULLDOG!" or tostring(count)
	countdown.TextColor3 = called and colors.Tagged or colors.White

	local winnerTeam = textAttribute(state, "WinnerTeam", "None")
	if winnerTeam == "Bulldogs" then
		resultTitle.Text = "BULLDOGS WIN!"
		resultTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 249, 224)
	elseif winnerTeam == "Runners" then
		resultTitle.Text = "SURVIVORS WIN!"
		resultTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 249, 224)
	else
		resultTitle.Text = "ROUND FINISHED!"
		resultTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 249, 224)
	end
	resultWinners.Text = textAttribute(state, "WinnersText", "")
	syncMusic(participating, phase)
end

local function requestSprint(value)
 requestPending=value==true
 if requestRunning or not alive then return end
 requestRunning=true sprintSerial+=1
 local serial=sprintSerial
 local worker=task.spawn(function()
  while requestPending~=nil and alive and serial==sprintSerial do
   local held=requestPending
   requestPending=nil
   local remote=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("BBMovementRequest")
   if remote and remote:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
    pcall(function() remote:InvokeServer("Sprint",held) end)
   end
  end
  if serial==sprintSerial then requestRunning=false end
 end)
 task.delay(2,function()
  if serial==sprintSerial and requestRunning then sprintSerial+=1 requestRunning=false requestPending=nil pcall(task.cancel,worker) end
 end)
end

  if not focused or UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass end

  holdChanged()
 end
 return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink

local function progress(fraction)

  gradient.Transparency=NumberSequence.new({
   NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,0),
   NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(math.max(0.0001,fraction-0.0001),0),
   NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(math.min(0.9999,fraction+0.0001),1),
   NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,1),
  })
 end
end

local function dodgeDirection()
 local character=player.Character
 local root=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 local right=arenaRight()
 if humanoid then
  local lateral=humanoid.MoveDirection:Dot(right)
  if math.abs(lateral)>0.12 then return lateral<0 and -1 or 1 end
 end
 if not root then return 1 end
 local nearest=nil
 local distance=math.huge
 local function consider(candidate)
  local target=candidate and candidate:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  if target then
   local delta=target.Position-root.Position
   local squared=delta:Dot(delta)
   if squared<distance then distance=squared nearest=target end
  end
 end
 for _,other in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
  if other~=player and other:GetAttribute("BBParticipating")==true and other:GetAttribute("BBRole")=="Bulldog" then consider(other.Character) end
 end
 local bots=workspace:FindFirstChild("BritishBulldogPracticeBots")
 if bots then
  for _,bot in ipairs(bots:GetChildren()) do
   local outline=bot:FindFirstChild("BBOutline")
   if outline and outline:IsA("Highlight") and outline.OutlineColor.R>outline.OutlineColor.B then consider(bot) end
  end
 end
 if nearest then
  local away=(root.Position-nearest.Position):Dot(right)
  if math.abs(away)>0.1 then return away<0 and -1 or 1 end
 end
 return 1
end

 local arena=workspace:FindFirstChild("British Bulldog game")

 dodgeBusy=true
 dodgeSerial+=1
 local serial=dodgeSerial
 lastDodgeDirection=dodgeDirection()

  local success,response=pcall(function() return remote:InvokeServer("Dodge",lastDodgeDirection) end)

local captionFill = Color3.fromRGB(255, 249, 224)

local palette = {
	{ name = "Blue", color = Color3.fromRGB(42, 160, 255) },
	{ name = "Blue", color = Color3.fromRGB(89, 193, 244) },
	{ name = "Red", color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 81, 92) },
	{ name = "Green", color = Color3.fromRGB(94, 203, 162) },
	{ name = "Green", color = Color3.fromRGB(130, 225, 180) },
	{ name = "Gold", color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 211, 78) },
	{ name = "Cream", color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 248) },
	{ name = "Black", color = Color3.fromRGB(48, 56, 75) },
	{ name = "Orange", color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 158, 69) },
	{ name = "Pink", color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 153, 166) },
	{ name = "Silver", color = Color3.fromRGB(194, 201, 206) },
	{ name = "Silver", color = Color3.fromRGB(162, 169, 184) },
	{ name = "Mud", color = Color3.fromRGB(151, 94, 44) },
}

local function closestColour(color)
	local nearest = "Cream"
	local distance = math.huge
	for _, entry in ipairs(palette) do
		local reference = entry.color
		local difference = (color.R - reference.R) ^ 2 + (color.G - reference.G) ^ 2 + (color.B - reference.B) ^ 2
		if difference < distance then
			distance = difference
			nearest = entry.name
		end
	end
	return nearest
end

local function connect(bucket, signal, callback)
	local connection = signal:Connect(callback)
	table.insert(bucket, connection)
	return connection
end

local function release(target)
	local record = records[target]
	if not record then return end
	records[target] = nil
	for _, connection in ipairs(record.connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
end

local bind
bind = function(target)
	if not alive or records[target] or not target:IsA("GuiObject") or target:GetAttribute("UISkinManaged") ~= true then return end
	local skin = target:FindFirstChild("ReusableSkin")
	if not skin or not skin:IsA("ImageLabel") then return end
	local record = { connections = {}, hovering = false, pressed = false }
	records[target] = record
	local function refresh()
		if not alive or records[target] ~= record or not target.Parent then return end
		if target.BackgroundTransparency ~= 1 then target.BackgroundTransparency = 1 end
		local caption = target:FindFirstChild("LiveCaption")
		if caption and caption:IsA("TextLabel") and (target:IsA("TextButton") or target:IsA("TextLabel")) then
			caption.Text = target.Text
			caption.TextColor3 = captionFill
			if target.TextTransparency ~= 1 then target.TextTransparency = 1 end
			if target.TextStrokeTransparency ~= 1 then target.TextStrokeTransparency = 1 end
		end
		local colourName = closestColour(target.BackgroundColor3)
		local asset = skin:GetAttribute("DefaultImage")
		if target:GetAttribute("UISkinDynamic") == true then asset = skin:GetAttribute(colourName .. "Image") or asset end
		if typeof(asset) == "string" and asset ~= "" and skin.Image ~= asset then skin.Image = asset end
		local tinted = target:IsA("GuiButton") and target.Active and (record.hovering or record.pressed)
		skin.ImageColor3 = tinted and Color3.new(0.94, 0.94, 0.94) or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		local selection = target:FindFirstChild("SelectionMark")
		if selection and selection:IsA("GuiObject") then
			if target:GetAttribute("UISkinSelectionFromOutline") == true then
				local outline = target:FindFirstChild("Outline")
				selection.Visible = outline ~= nil and outline:IsA("UIStroke") and outline.Enabled
			elseif target:GetAttribute("UISkinSelectionFromColour") == true then
				selection.Visible = colourName == "Gold"
			end
		end
		local sourceGradient = target:FindFirstChild("Progress")
		local skinGradient = skin:FindFirstChild("Progress")
		if sourceGradient and sourceGradient:IsA("UIGradient") and skinGradient and skinGradient:IsA("UIGradient") then
			for _, property in ipairs({ "Color", "Transparency", "Offset", "Rotation", "Enabled" }) do
				skinGradient[property] = sourceGradient[property]
			end
		end
	end
	record.refresh = refresh
	for _, property in ipairs({ "BackgroundColor3", "BackgroundTransparency" }) do
		connect(record.connections, target:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property), refresh)
	end
	if target:IsA("TextButton") or target:IsA("TextLabel") then
		for _, property in ipairs({ "Text", "TextColor3", "TextTransparency", "TextStrokeTransparency" }) do
			connect(record.connections, target:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property), refresh)
		end
	end
	connect(record.connections, target.AttributeChanged, refresh)
	connect(record.connections, skin.AttributeChanged, refresh)
	local gradient = target:FindFirstChild("Progress")
	if gradient and gradient:IsA("UIGradient") then
		for _, property in ipairs({ "Color", "Transparency", "Offset", "Rotation", "Enabled" }) do
			connect(record.connections, gradient:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property), refresh)
		end
	end
	local outline = target:FindFirstChild("Outline")
	if outline and outline:IsA("UIStroke") then connect(record.connections, outline:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"), refresh) end
	if target:IsA("GuiButton") then
		connect(record.connections, target.MouseEnter, function() record.hovering = true refresh() end)
		connect(record.connections, target.MouseLeave, function() record.hovering = false record.pressed = false refresh() end)
		connect(record.connections, target.MouseButton1Down, function() record.pressed = target.Active refresh() end)
		connect(record.connections, target.MouseButton1Up, function() record.pressed = false refresh() end)
		connect(record.connections, target.Activated, function() record.pressed = false refresh() end)
		connect(record.connections, target:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Active"), function()
			if not target.Active then record.pressed = false record.hovering = false end
			refresh()
		end)
		connect(record.connections, target:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"), function()
			if not target.Visible then record.pressed = false record.hovering = false end
			refresh()
		end)
	end
	local function rebind(child)
		if child.Name ~= "ReusableSkin" and child.Name ~= "Progress" and child.Name ~= "Outline" and child.Name ~= "LiveCaption" and child.Name ~= "SelectionMark" then return end
		release(target)
		task.defer(function() if target:IsDescendantOf(gui) then bind(target) end end)
	end
	connect(record.connections, target.ChildAdded, rebind)
	connect(record.connections, target.ChildRemoved, rebind)
	connect(record.connections, target.AncestryChanged, function()
		if not target:IsDescendantOf(gui) then release(target) end
	end)
	refresh()
end

connect(connections, gui.DescendantAdded, function(descendant)
	task.defer(function()
		if not alive or not descendant:IsDescendantOf(gui) then return end
		bind(descendant)
		local parent = descendant.Parent
		if parent and parent:IsA("GuiObject") then bind(parent) end
	end)
end)

connect(connections, script.Destroying, function()
	alive = false
	for target in pairs(records) do release(target) end
	for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
end)

local function finite(value, fallback)
	return typeof(value) == "number" and value == value and math.abs(value) ~= math.huge and value or fallback
end
local function clock(seconds)
	return string.format("%d:%02d", math.floor(seconds / 60), seconds % 60)

local function sessionFlags()
	local session = gui.Parent:FindFirstChild("PlaygroundSessionControls")
	local muted = session and (session:GetAttribute("UIHidden") == true or session:GetAttribute("SessionMenuOpen") == true)
	local round = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("PlaygroundState")
	local watching = session and session:GetAttribute("Spectating") == true
		and round and round:GetAttribute("ActiveGame") == "DuckDuckGoose"
	return muted == true, watching == true
end
local function inputReady()
	return focused and gui.Enabled and not GuiService.MenuIsOpen and not UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox()
end
local function canSprint()
	local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local role = player:GetAttribute("DGRole")
	local muted, watching = sessionFlags()
	return inputReady() and not muted and not watching and player:GetAttribute("DGParticipating") == true
		and state:GetAttribute("Phase") == "Playing" and (role == "Picker" or role == "Runner" or role == "Goose")
		and player:GetAttribute("DGRagdolled") ~= true and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0
end
local function requestSprint(value, force)
	value = value == true and canSprint() == true
	if value == sprintRequested and not force then return end
	sprintRequested = value
	sprintRemote:FireServer(value)
end
local function clearInputs()
	table.clear(keysHeld)

	local muted, watching = sessionFlags()
	return inputReady() and not muted and not watching and player:GetAttribute("DGParticipating") == true
		and player:GetAttribute("DGRole") == "Picker" and state:GetAttribute("Phase") == "Playing"
		and state:GetAttribute("TurnPhase") == "Choosing"
end
local function nearestDuck()
	local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then return nil end
	local nearest, distance = nil, 10
	for _, other in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if other ~= player and other:GetAttribute("DGParticipating") == true and other:GetAttribute("DGRole") == "Duck" then
			local targetRoot = other.Character and other.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local humanoid = other.Character and other.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if targetRoot and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
				local separation = (targetRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
				if separation <= distance then nearest, distance = other, separation end
			end
		end
	end
	return nearest
end
local function chooseGoose()
	if not canChoose() or os.clock() < nextChoose then return end
	local target = nearestDuck()
	if not target then return end
	nextChoose = os.clock() + 0.35
	actionRemote:FireServer("ChooseGoose", target.UserId)
end
local function refreshPrompts()
	local arena = workspace:FindFirstChild("Duck Duck Goose")
	local seats = arena and arena:FindFirstChild("Gameplay") and arena.Gameplay:FindFirstChild("Seats")
	if not seats then return end
	local enabled = canChoose()
	for _, model in seats:GetChildren() do
		local prompt = model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
		if prompt and prompt:GetAttribute("DGGoosePrompt") == true then
			local occupant = model:GetAttribute("DGSeatedUserId")
			prompt.Enabled = enabled and typeof(occupant) == "number" and occupant > 0 and occupant ~= player.UserId
		end
	end
end
local function refresh()
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local viewport = camera and camera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
	local short = math.min(viewport.X, viewport.Y)
	local compact = viewport.X <= 900 or short <= 600 or (short <= 1024 and math.max(viewport.X, viewport.Y) <= 1400)
	local selectedHeader = not compact and gui.DesktopHeader or viewport.Y > viewport.X and gui.PortraitHeader or gui.CompactHeader
	local muted, watching = sessionFlags()
	local phase, turn = state:GetAttribute("Phase"), state:GetAttribute("TurnPhase")
	local participating = player:GetAttribute("DGParticipating") == true
	local eliminated = player:GetAttribute("DGEliminated") == true and phase ~= "Waiting"
	local shown = gui.Enabled and (participating or eliminated or watching) and not muted
	local role = player:GetAttribute("DGRole") or "Duck"
	local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	local seconds = math.max(0, math.ceil(finite(state:GetAttribute("EndsAt"), now) - now))
	local alive = finite(state:GetAttribute("AliveCount"), 0)
	local ownLap = role == "Runner" or role == "Goose"
	local lap = math.clamp(finite(ownLap and player:GetAttribute("DGLapProgress") or state:GetAttribute("LapProgress"), 0), 0, 1)
	local _, instruction = Guidance.Describe(role, player:GetAttribute("DGRouteStatus"),
		player:GetAttribute("DGSeatReady") == true, eliminated)
	if turn == "FinalDuck" and participating and not eliminated then instruction = "You are the last duck standing!" end
	if watching then instruction = "Watching Duck Duck Goose" end
	if phase == "Countdown" then instruction = "Get ready! One player will choose a goose"
	elseif phase == "Results" then instruction = state:GetAttribute("WinnersText") or "Round finished" end
	local counts = string.format("%d still in", alive)
	if phase == "Playing" and turn == "Chasing" then counts = string.format("%d in · LAP %d%%", alive, math.floor(lap * 100))
	elseif phase == "Playing" and turn == "Choosing" then
		local choiceSeconds = math.max(0, math.ceil(finite(state:GetAttribute("TurnEndsAt"), now) - now))
		counts = string.format("%d in · Choose: %ds", alive, choiceSeconds)
	end
	for _, header in headers do
		header.Visible = shown and header == selectedHeader
		header.Title.Text = phase == "Results" and "ROUND FINISHED" or "DUCK DUCK GOOSE"
		header.Timer.Text = phase == "Countdown" and tostring(state:GetAttribute("CountdownValue") or 8)
			or phase == "Results" and "" or clock(seconds)
		header.Role.Text = watching and "WATCHING" or eliminated and "OUT" or role == "Goose" and "CHASER" or string.upper(role)
		header.Role.TextColor3 = (role == "Picker" or role == "Runner") and Color3.fromRGB(185, 55, 73)
			or role == "Goose" and Color3.fromRGB(152, 94, 27) or Color3.fromRGB(38, 105, 133)
		header.Counts.Text, header.Hint.Text = counts, instruction
		header.Fallback.Visible = not header.ReusableSkin.IsLoaded
	end
	local active = canSprint() == true
	local context = tostring(phase) .. ":" .. tostring(turn) .. ":" .. role
	if not active then
		clearInputs()
	elseif sprintContext ~= context then
		requestSprint(next(keysHeld) ~= nil or next(pointersHeld) ~= nil, true)
	end
	sprintContext = context
	for _, button in sprintButtons do
		button.Visible = shown and participating and phase == "Playing" and (role == "Picker" or role == "Runner" or role == "Goose")
			and button == (UserInputService.TouchEnabled and gui.MobileSprint or gui.DesktopSprint)
		button.Active = active
		button.Selectable = not UserInputService.TouchEnabled and active
		local maximum = math.max(0.1, finite(player:GetAttribute("DGMaxStamina"), 5))
		local current = math.clamp(finite(player:GetAttribute("DGStamina"), 0), 0, maximum)
		button.StaminaTrack.StaminaFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(current / maximum, 1)
		button.StaminaText.Text = string.format("%.1f / %d", current, maximum)
		button.ReusableSkin.ImageColor3 = active and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or Color3.fromRGB(150, 157, 170)
		button.ArtFallback.Visible = not button.ReusableSkin.IsLoaded
	end
	gui.ChooseGoose.Visible = shown and participating and role == "Picker" and phase == "Playing" and turn == "Choosing"
	gui.ChooseGoose.Active = canChoose() and nearestDuck() ~= nil
	gui.ChooseGoose.Selectable = gui.ChooseGoose.Active
	gui.ChooseGoose.Hint.Text = gui.ChooseGoose.Active and "CHOOSE NEARBY" or "MOVE CLOSER"
	gui.ChooseGoose.Fallback.Visible = not gui.ChooseGoose.ReusableSkin.IsLoaded

		compact = compact, portrait = compact and viewport.Y > viewport.X, touch = UserInputService.TouchEnabled})

local Guidance = {}

function Guidance.Describe(role, status, ready, eliminated)
	if eliminated then return "TAGGED - YOU'RE OUT", "Watch from outside the circle until next round" end
	if role == "Duck" then return "DUCK", "Stay seated. Chosen as goose? Chase the runner!" end
	if role == "Picker" then return "PICKER", "Choose a duck, then follow the glowing arrows" end
	if status == "WrongWay" then return "FOLLOW THE ARROWS", "Turn around and run clockwise" end
	if status == "OffTrack" or status == "ReturnToTrack" then
		return "RETURN TO THE TRACK", "Go to the RETURN HERE marker, then follow arrows"
	end
	if ready and role == "Runner" then return "LAP COMPLETE", "Go to the glowing gold chair to be safe!" end
	if role == "Runner" then return "RUNNER", "One clockwise lap, then sit in the gold chair" end
	if role == "Goose" then return "CHASER", "Run after them! Keep moving forward to tag" end
	return "WATCHING", "Runner: one lap. Chaser: follow and tag!"
end

function Guidance.Start(gui, state, player)
	local templates = gui:WaitForChild("GuidanceTemplates")
	local rules = {gui.DesktopRules, gui.CompactRules, gui.PortraitRules}
	local notices = {gui.DesktopNotice, gui.CompactNotice, gui.PortraitNotice}
	local buttons = {gui.DesktopRulesButton, gui.TouchRulesButton}
	local connections, paints = {}, {}
	local open, priorPhase, priorRole, priorEliminated, noticeUntil = false, "", "", false, 0
	local noticeText = ""
	local directions, arena, seatMarker, returnMarker, returnPart
	local disposed = false
	local function connect(signal, callback)
		table.insert(connections, signal:Connect(callback))
	end
	for _, button in buttons do connect(button.Activated, function() open = not open end) end
	for _, card in rules do connect(card.Close.Activated, function() open = false end) end
	local function restorePaints()
		for part, original in pairs(paints) do
			if part.Parent then part.Color, part.Material, part.Transparency = original.color, original.material, original.transparency end
		end
	end
	local function findDirections()
		local previous = directions
		arena = workspace:FindFirstChild("Duck Duck Goose")
		local grounds = arena and arena:FindFirstChild("Grounds")
		local track = grounds and grounds:FindFirstChild("CircularRunningTrack")
		directions = track and track:FindFirstChild("TrackDirections")
		if directions ~= previous then restorePaints() table.clear(paints) end
		for part in pairs(paints) do if not directions or not part:IsDescendantOf(directions) then paints[part] = nil end end
		if directions then
			for _, arrow in directions:GetChildren() do
				for _, part in arrow:GetChildren() do
					if part:IsA("BasePart") and not paints[part] then
						paints[part] = {color = part.Color, material = part.Material, transparency = part.Transparency,
							angle = arrow:GetAttribute("ClockwiseAngle") or 0}
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	local function worldMarker(name)
		local marker = templates.WorldNotice:Clone()
		marker.Name, marker.Parent = name, gui
		return marker
	end
	local function clearWorldMarkers()
		if seatMarker then seatMarker:Destroy() seatMarker = nil end
		if returnMarker then returnMarker:Destroy() returnMarker = nil end
		if returnPart then returnPart:Destroy() returnPart = nil end
	end
	local handle = {}
	function handle.Update(context)
		if disposed then return end
		local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
		local phase, role = context.phase, context.role
		local eliminated = context.eliminated
		if phase ~= priorPhase then
			if phase == "Countdown" then open = true
			elseif priorPhase == "Countdown" or phase == "Waiting" or phase == "Results" then open = false end
		end
		if eliminated and not priorEliminated then
			noticeText, noticeUntil = "TAGGED! YOU'RE OUT", now + 4
		elseif phase == "Playing" and role ~= priorRole then
			if role == "Runner" then noticeText, noticeUntil = "RUN! ONE LAP, THEN THE GOLD CHAIR", now + 3
			elseif role == "Goose" then noticeText, noticeUntil = "YOU'RE THE GOOSE! CHASE AND TAG", now + 3
			elseif role == "Duck" and priorRole == "Runner" then noticeText, noticeUntil = "SAFE! YOU MADE IT BACK", now + 3 end
		end
		priorPhase, priorRole, priorEliminated = phase, role, eliminated
		local variant = context.portrait and 3 or context.compact and 2 or 1
		local status = player:GetAttribute("DGRouteStatus")
		local attention = (role == "Runner" or role == "Goose") and (status == "WrongWay" or status == "OffTrack" or status == "ReturnToTrack" or status == "Ready")
		local routeTitle = Guidance.Describe(role, status, player:GetAttribute("DGSeatReady"), eliminated)
		for index, card in rules do card.Visible = context.shown and open and index == variant end
		for index, card in notices do
			card.Visible = context.shown and not open and (now < noticeUntil or attention) and index == variant and phase == "Playing"
			card.Caption.Text = now < noticeUntil and noticeText or routeTitle
			card.Caption.TextColor3 = eliminated and Color3.fromRGB(173, 35, 51) or Color3.fromRGB(24, 35, 62)
		end
		buttons[1].Visible = context.shown and not context.touch and phase ~= "Results"
		buttons[2].Visible = context.shown and context.touch and phase ~= "Results"
		findDirections()
		local chase = phase == "Playing" and context.turn == "Chasing"
		local glow = chase and context.shown
		for part, original in pairs(paints) do
			if part.Parent then
				if glow then
					local wave = (now * 2.8 - original.angle) % (math.pi * 2)
					local pulse = math.max(0, 1 - wave / 1.8)
					part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
					part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(241, 170, 38):Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(255, 252, 176), pulse)
					part.Transparency = 0.12 * (1 - pulse)
				else part.Color, part.Material, part.Transparency = original.color, original.material, original.transparency end
			end
		end
		if not chase or not context.shown or (role ~= "Runner" and role ~= "Goose") then clearWorldMarkers() return end
		local gameplay = arena and arena:FindFirstChild("Gameplay")
		local seats = gameplay and gameplay:FindFirstChild("Seats")
		local targetIndex = state:GetAttribute("EmptySeatIndex")
		local target
		if seats and role == "Runner" then
			for _, model in seats:GetChildren() do
				if model:GetAttribute("DGSeatIndex") == targetIndex then target = model:FindFirstChild("Seat") break end
			end
		end
		local recovering = status == "ReturnToTrack" or status == "OffTrack" or status == "WrongWay"
		if target and not recovering then
			seatMarker = seatMarker or worldMarker("DGGoalNotice")
			seatMarker.Adornee, seatMarker.Enabled = target, true
			seatMarker.Caption.Text = player:GetAttribute("DGSeatReady") and "LAP DONE - SIT HERE!" or "ONE LAP, THEN THIS CHAIR"
		elseif seatMarker then seatMarker:Destroy() seatMarker = nil end
		local returnPoint = player:GetAttribute("DGReturnPoint")
		local status = player:GetAttribute("DGRouteStatus")
		if typeof(returnPoint) == "Vector3" and (status == "ReturnToTrack" or status == "OffTrack") then
			if not returnPart then
				returnPart = Instance.new("Part")
				returnPart.Name, returnPart.Size = "DGLocalReturnPoint", Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
				returnPart.Anchored, returnPart.CanCollide, returnPart.CanTouch, returnPart.CanQuery = true, false, false, false
				returnPart.Transparency, returnPart.Parent = 1, workspace
			end
			returnPart.Position = returnPoint
			returnMarker = returnMarker or worldMarker("DGReturnNotice")
			returnMarker.Adornee, returnMarker.Enabled = returnPart, true
			returnMarker.Caption.Text, returnMarker.Caption.TextColor3 = "RETURN HERE", Color3.fromRGB(193, 59, 35)
		elseif returnMarker or returnPart then
			if returnMarker then returnMarker:Destroy() returnMarker = nil end
			if returnPart then returnPart:Destroy() returnPart = nil end
		end
	end
	function handle.Destroy()
		if disposed then return end
		disposed = true
		restorePaints()
		clearWorldMarkers()
		for _, connection in connections do connection:Disconnect() end
	end
	return handle
end

return Guidance

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local ContextActionService = game:GetService("ContextActionService")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")

local Abilities = {}

local function remaining(player, name, now)
	local value = player:GetAttribute(name)
	return typeof(value) == "number" and value == value and value < math.huge and math.max(0, value - now) or 0
end

function Abilities.Describe(player, phase, now)
	local role = player:GetAttribute("HSRole")
	local participating = player:GetAttribute("HSParticipating") == true
	local active = participating and (phase == "Hiding" or phase == "Seeking")
	local mobile = active and player:GetAttribute("HSHiding") ~= true and player:GetAttribute("HSRagdolled") ~= true
	local hider = active and role == "Hider" and player:GetAttribute("HSPropMorphed") == true
	local seeker = active and role == "Seeker" and phase == "Seeking"
	local primary = hider and "ChangeProp" or seeker and "Scan" or nil
	local primaryWait = remaining(player, hider and "HSSwitchReadyAt" or "HSScanReadyAt", now)
	local scanTime = seeker and remaining(player, "HSScanActiveUntil", now) or 0
	local decoyWait = remaining(player, "HSDecoyReadyAt", now)
	return {
		primary = primary, primaryReady = mobile and primary ~= nil and primaryWait <= 0,
		primaryWait = primaryWait, scanTime = scanTime,
		decoy = hider, decoyReady = mobile and hider and decoyWait <= 0,
		decoyWait = decoyWait, decoyCount = math.clamp(tonumber(player:GetAttribute("HSDecoyCount")) or 0, 0, 3),
		revealed = active and role == "Hider" and remaining(player, "HSRevealedUntil", now) or 0,
		hidden = player:GetAttribute("HSHiding") == true,
	}
end

function Abilities.Layout(viewport, touch)
	if viewport.Y > viewport.X then return "Portrait" end
	local short, long = math.min(viewport.X, viewport.Y), math.max(viewport.X, viewport.Y)
	if touch or viewport.X <= 900 or short <= 600 or (short <= 1024 and long <= 1400) then return "Compact" end
	return "Desktop"
end

function Abilities.Start(gui, state, remote)
	local player = Players.LocalPlayer
	local connections, reveals = {}, {}
	local running, focused, elapsed, nextSendAt = true, true, 0, 0
	local actionName = "HideSeekPropAbilities"
	local bars = { Desktop = gui.DesktopAbilities, Compact = gui.CompactAbilities, Portrait = gui.PortraitAbilities }
	local notices = { Desktop = gui.DesktopRevealNotice, Compact = gui.CompactRevealNotice, Portrait = gui.PortraitRevealNotice }
	local effectFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	effectFolder.Name = "LocalHideSeekRevealEffects"
	effectFolder.Parent = workspace

	local function connect(signal, callback)
		table.insert(connections, signal:Connect(callback))
	end
	local function session()
		return gui.Parent and gui.Parent:FindFirstChild("PlaygroundSessionControls")
	end
	local function inputReady()
		local controls = session()
		local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		return running and focused and gui.Enabled and not GuiService.MenuIsOpen
			and not UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0
			and not (controls and controls:GetAttribute("SessionMenuOpen") == true)
	end
	local function keyHint(pc, gamepad)
		local last = UserInputService:GetLastInputType()
		if last == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled then return "TAP" end
		if last.Name:find("Gamepad", 1, true) then
			local label = UserInputService:GetStringForKeyCode(gamepad)
			return label ~= "" and label or gamepad.Name:gsub("Button", "")
		end
		return "[" .. pc .. "]"
	end
	local function dropEffect(target)
		local record = reveals[target]
		if not record then return end
		record.folder:Destroy()
		if record.sourceAttachment then record.sourceAttachment:Destroy() end
		if record.targetAttachment then record.targetAttachment:Destroy() end
		reveals[target] = nil
	end
	local function clearEffects()
		for target in pairs(reveals) do dropEffect(target) end
	end
	local function lockerModel(target)
		local name = target:GetAttribute("HSLockerName")
		if target:GetAttribute("HSHiding") ~= true or typeof(name) ~= "string" or name == "" then return nil end
		local arena = workspace:FindFirstChild("Hide and Seek")
		local gameplay = arena and arena:FindFirstChild("Gameplay")
		local lockers = gameplay and gameplay:FindFirstChild("LockerSpots")
		return lockers and lockers:FindFirstChild(name)
	end
	local function makeEffect(target, character, root)
		local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name = tostring(target.UserId)
		folder.Parent = effectFolder
		local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
		highlight.Name = "RevealedHider"
		highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 44, 62)
		highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 45, 58)
		highlight.FillTransparency = 0.83
		highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
		highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
		highlight.Parent = folder
		local marker = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
		marker.Name = "RevealMarker"
		marker.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(106, 26)
		marker.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0)
		marker.AlwaysOnTop = true
		marker.MaxDistance = 1800
		marker.Adornee = root
		marker.Parent = folder
		local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		label.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(133, 22, 38)
		label.BackgroundTransparency = 0.12
		label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 249, 230)
		label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		label.TextSize = 13
		label.Text = "REVEALED"
		label.Parent = marker
		local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
		corner.Parent = label
		local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
		attachment.Name = "LocalRevealTarget"
		attachment.Parent = root
		local beam = Instance.new("Beam")
		beam.Name = "RedRevealBeam"
		beam.Attachment1 = attachment
		beam.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 45, 62))
		beam.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.35)
		beam.Width0, beam.Width1 = 0.09, 0.16
		beam.FaceCamera = true
		beam.LightEmission = 0.8
		beam.Segments = 1
		beam.Enabled = false
		beam.Parent = folder
		local record = { folder = folder, character = character, root = root, highlight = highlight, marker = marker, label = label, beam = beam, targetAttachment = attachment }
		reveals[target] = record
		return record
	end
	local function updateEffects(now)
		local phase = state:GetAttribute("Phase")
		local participating = player:GetAttribute("HSParticipating") == true
		local viewing = participating and (phase == "Hiding" or phase == "Seeking")
		if not viewing then clearEffects() return end
		local seeker = player:GetAttribute("HSRole") == "Seeker" and phase == "Seeking"
		local seen = {}
		for _, target in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			local seconds = remaining(target, "HSRevealedUntil", now)
			local character = target.Character
			local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if (seeker or target == player) and target:GetAttribute("HSParticipating") == true
				and target:GetAttribute("HSRole") == "Hider" and seconds > 0 and root and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
				seen[target] = true
				local record = reveals[target]
				if record and (record.character ~= character or record.root ~= root) then dropEffect(target) record = nil end
				record = record or makeEffect(target, character, root)
				record.highlight.Adornee = lockerModel(target) or character:FindFirstChild("SchoolPropMorph") or character
				record.highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0.1 + 0.12 * (0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(now * 6))
				record.label.Text = "REVEALED " .. math.ceil(seconds) .. "s"
				local sourceId = target:GetAttribute("HSRevealSource")
				local source = typeof(sourceId) == "number" and Players:GetPlayerByUserId(sourceId)
				local sourceRoot = source and source.Character and source.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if sourceRoot ~= record.sourceRoot then
					if record.sourceAttachment then record.sourceAttachment:Destroy() end
					record.sourceRoot, record.sourceAttachment = sourceRoot, nil
					if sourceRoot then
						local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
						attachment.Name = "LocalRevealSource"
						attachment.Position = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
						attachment.Parent = sourceRoot
						record.sourceAttachment = attachment
					end
					record.beam.Attachment0 = record.sourceAttachment
				end
				record.beam.Enabled = sourceRoot ~= nil and record.sourceAttachment ~= nil
			end
		end
		for target in pairs(reveals) do if not seen[target] then dropEffect(target) end end
	end
	local refresh
	local function send(action)
		if not inputReady() or os.clock() < nextSendAt then return end
		local data = Abilities.Describe(player, state:GetAttribute("Phase"), workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
		if action == "Primary" then action = data.primary end
		if action == "DropDecoy" and not data.decoyReady or action ~= "DropDecoy" and (action ~= data.primary or not data.primaryReady) then return end
		nextSendAt = os.clock() + 0.2
		remote:FireServer(action)
		refresh()
	end
	refresh = function()
		if not running or not gui.Parent then return end
		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local variant = Abilities.Layout(camera and camera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280,720), UserInputService.TouchEnabled)
		local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
		local data = Abilities.Describe(player, state:GetAttribute("Phase"), now)
		local controls = session()
		local shown = gui.Enabled and not (controls and (controls:GetAttribute("UIHidden") == true or controls:GetAttribute("SessionMenuOpen") == true))
		local ready = inputReady() == true
		for name, bar in pairs(bars) do
			bar.Visible = shown and name == variant and data.primary ~= nil and not data.hidden
			local primary = bar.Primary
			local decoy = bar.Decoy
			primary.Caption.Text = data.primary == "Scan" and (data.scanTime > 0 and "SCANNING" or "SCAN") or "CHANGE PROP"
			primary.Hint.Text = data.scanTime > 0 and (math.ceil(data.scanTime) .. "s ACTIVE")
				or data.primaryWait > 0 and (math.ceil(data.primaryWait) .. "s")
				or keyHint("E", Enum.KeyCode.ButtonY)
			primary.Active = ready and data.primaryReady
			primary.Selectable = primary.Active and not UserInputService.TouchEnabled
			primary.ReusableSkin.ImageColor3 = primary.Active and Color3.new(1,1,1) or Color3.fromRGB(150,155,170)
			primary.Fallback.Visible = not primary.ReusableSkin.IsLoaded
			decoy.Visible = data.decoy == true
			decoy.Caption.Text = data.decoyCount >= 3 and "REPLACE DECOY" or "DECOY"
			decoy.Hint.Text = string.format("%d/3 · %s", data.decoyCount, data.decoyWait > 0 and (math.ceil(data.decoyWait) .. "s") or keyHint("Q", Enum.KeyCode.ButtonB))
			decoy.Active = ready and data.decoyReady
			decoy.Selectable = decoy.Active and not UserInputService.TouchEnabled
			decoy.ReusableSkin.ImageColor3 = decoy.Active and Color3.new(1,1,1) or Color3.fromRGB(150,155,170)
			decoy.Fallback.Visible = not decoy.ReusableSkin.IsLoaded
		end
		for name, notice in pairs(notices) do
			notice.Visible = shown and name == variant and data.revealed > 0
			notice.Caption.Text = "REVEALED — MOVE! " .. math.ceil(data.revealed) .. "s"
			notice.Reason.Text = player:GetAttribute("HSRevealReason") == "Decoy" and "A seeker hit your decoy" or "A seeker is scanning"
		end
		updateEffects(now)
	end
	for _,bar in pairs(bars) do
		connect(bar.Primary.Activated, function() send("Primary") end)
		connect(bar.Decoy.Activated, function() send("DropDecoy") end)
	end
	ContextActionService:BindActionAtPriority(actionName, function(_, inputState, input)
		if not inputReady() or player:GetAttribute("HSParticipating") ~= true then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass end
		local data = Abilities.Describe(player, state:GetAttribute("Phase"), workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
		local decoy = input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Q or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonB
		if not data.primary or data.hidden or decoy and not data.decoy then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass end
		if inputState == Enum.UserInputState.Begin then send(decoy and "DropDecoy" or "Primary") end
		return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
	end, false, Enum.ContextActionPriority.Default.Value + 1, Enum.KeyCode.E, Enum.KeyCode.Q, Enum.KeyCode.ButtonY, Enum.KeyCode.ButtonB)
	connect(UserInputService.WindowFocusReleased, function() focused = false refresh() end)
	connect(UserInputService.WindowFocused, function() focused = true refresh() end)
	connect(UserInputService.LastInputTypeChanged, refresh)
	connect(player.CharacterRemoving, clearEffects)
	connect(Players.PlayerRemoving, dropEffect)
	connect(RunService.Heartbeat, function(dt)
		elapsed += dt
		if elapsed >= 0.1 then elapsed = 0 refresh() end
	end)
	local function destroy()
		if not running then return end
		running = false
		ContextActionService:UnbindAction(actionName)
		clearEffects()
		effectFolder:Destroy()
		for _,connection in ipairs(connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
		for _,bar in pairs(bars) do bar.Visible = false end
		for _,notice in pairs(notices) do notice.Visible = false end
	end
	connect(gui.Destroying, destroy)
	refresh()
	return destroy
end

return Abilities

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local ContextActionService = game:GetService("ContextActionService")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local gui = script.Parent
local state = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("HideAndSeekState")
local sprintRemote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("HideAndSeekSprintRequest")
local actionRemote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("HideAndSeekActionRequest")
local headers = { gui.DesktopHeader, gui.CompactHeader, gui.PortraitHeader }
local sprintButtons = { gui.DesktopSprint, gui.MobileSprint }
local connections = {}
local sprintRequested = false
local keysHeld = {}
local touchHeld = {}
local focused = true
local elapsed = 0
local nextLockerExit = 0
local stopAbilities = require(gui:WaitForChild("Abilities")).Start(gui, state, actionRemote)
local function clock(seconds)
	return string.format("%d:%02d", math.floor(seconds / 60), seconds % 60)
end
local function canSprint()
	local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local phase = state:GetAttribute("Phase")
	return focused and not GuiService.MenuIsOpen and not UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox()
		and gui.Enabled and player:GetAttribute("HSParticipating") == true
		and (phase == "Hiding" or phase == "Seeking") and player:GetAttribute("HSHiding") ~= true
		and not (phase == "Hiding" and player:GetAttribute("HSRole") == "Seeker")
		and player:GetAttribute("HSRagdolled") ~= true and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0
end
local function requestSprint(value)
	value = value == true and canSprint() == true
	if value == sprintRequested then return end
	sprintRequested = value
	sprintRemote:FireServer(value)
end
local function clearInputs()
	table.clear(keysHeld)
	table.clear(touchHeld)
	requestSprint(false)
end
local function leaveLocker()
	if not focused or GuiService.MenuIsOpen or UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox()
		or player:GetAttribute("HSParticipating") ~= true or player:GetAttribute("HSHiding") ~= true
		or os.clock() < nextLockerExit then return end
	nextLockerExit = os.clock() + 0.3
	actionRemote:FireServer("LeaveLocker")
end
local function refresh()
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local viewport = camera and camera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
	local short = math.min(viewport.X, viewport.Y)
	local compact = viewport.X <= 900 or short <= 600 or (short <= 1024 and math.max(viewport.X, viewport.Y) <= 1400)
	local selectedHeader = not compact and gui.DesktopHeader or viewport.Y > viewport.X and gui.PortraitHeader or gui.CompactHeader
	local session = gui.Parent:FindFirstChild("PlaygroundSessionControls")
	local muted = session and (session:GetAttribute("UIHidden") == true or session:GetAttribute("SessionMenuOpen") == true)
	local participating = player:GetAttribute("HSParticipating") == true
	local roundState = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("PlaygroundState")
	local watching = session and session:GetAttribute("Spectating") == true and roundState and roundState:GetAttribute("ActiveGame") == "HideAndSeek"
	local shown = (participating or watching) and not muted
	local phase = state:GetAttribute("Phase")
	local role = player:GetAttribute("HSRole")
	local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	local ending = phase == "Hiding" and state:GetAttribute("HidingEndsAt") or state:GetAttribute("EndsAt")
	local seconds = typeof(ending) == "number" and ending == ending and math.abs(ending) ~= math.huge and math.max(0, math.ceil(ending - now)) or 0
	local blindfold = participating and role == "Seeker" and phase == "Hiding"
	gui.SeekerBlindfold.Visible = blindfold
	gui.SeekerBlindfold.WaitingCard.Countdown.Text = clock(seconds)
	local instruction = "Find a hiding spot!"
	if phase == "Countdown" then instruction = "Get ready!"
	elseif phase == "Hiding" then instruction = role == "Seeker" and "Wait while players hide" or "Blend in before seekers are released"
	elseif phase == "Seeking" then instruction = role == "Seeker" and "Find props • Search cupboards and drawers" or "Stay hidden or run from seekers"
	elseif phase == "Results" then instruction = state:GetAttribute("WinnersText") or "Round finished" end
	local propName = player:GetAttribute("HSPropName")
	if role ~= "Seeker" and player:GetAttribute("HSPropMorphed") == true and typeof(propName) == "string" and phase ~= "Results" then
		instruction = "YOU ARE A " .. string.upper(propName)
	end
	if player:GetAttribute("HSHiding") == true then instruction = "Hidden inside • Leave to run" end
	for _, header in headers do
		header.Visible = shown and not blindfold and header == selectedHeader
		header.Title.Text = phase == "Results" and "ROUND FINISHED" or "HIDE & SEEK"
		header.Timer.Text = phase == "Countdown" and tostring(state:GetAttribute("CountdownValue") or 3) or phase == "Results" and "" or clock(seconds)
		header.Role.Text = watching and "WATCHING" or role == "Seeker" and "SEEKER" or "HIDER"
		header.Role.TextColor3 = role == "Seeker" and Color3.fromRGB(245,83,117) or Color3.fromRGB(68,163,245)

local function release(skin)
	local record = records[skin]
	if not record then return end
	records[skin] = nil
	if record.fallback.Parent then record.fallback.Visible = false end
	for _, connection in ipairs(record.connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
end

local function tint(color, imageColor)
	return Color3.new(color.R * imageColor.R, color.G * imageColor.G, color.B * imageColor.B)
end

local function faceColor(skin, fallback)
	local image = skin.Image
	local id = string.match(image, "^rbxassetid://(%d+)") or string.match(image, "[?&]id=(%d+)")
	local palette = id and imagePalettes[id]
	if palette then return palettes[palette] end
	for name, color in pairs(palettes) do
		if image ~= "" and skin:GetAttribute(name .. "Image") == image then return color end
	end
	return fallback:GetAttribute("FallbackFaceColor") or palettes.Cream
end

local function bind(skin)
	if not alive or records[skin] or not (skin:IsA("ImageLabel") or skin:IsA("ImageButton")) then return end
	local parent = skin.Parent
	local fallback = parent and parent:FindFirstChild(skin.Name .. "Fallback")
	if not fallback or not fallback:IsA("Frame") or fallback:GetAttribute("BackgroundFallbackFor") ~= skin.Name then return end
	local edge = fallback:FindFirstChild("Edge")
	local face = edge and edge:FindFirstChild("Face")
	if not edge or not face then return end
	local record = { connections = {}, fallback = fallback }
	records[skin] = record
	local function refresh()
		if not alive or records[skin] ~= record or skin.Parent ~= fallback.Parent then return end
		local transparency = math.clamp(skin.ImageTransparency, 0, 1)
		fallback.Visible = skin.Visible and skin.Image ~= "" and not skin.IsLoaded and transparency < 1
		fallback.BackgroundTransparency = transparency
		edge.BackgroundTransparency = transparency
		face.BackgroundTransparency = transparency
		fallback.BackgroundColor3 = tint(fallback:GetAttribute("FallbackInkColor") or Color3.fromRGB(31, 38, 60), skin.ImageColor3)
		local color = faceColor(skin, fallback)
		edge.BackgroundColor3 = tint(color:Lerp(white, 0.72), skin.ImageColor3)
		face.BackgroundColor3 = tint(color, skin.ImageColor3)
	end
	record.refresh = refresh
	for _, property in ipairs({ "IsLoaded", "Image", "ImageTransparency", "ImageColor3", "Visible" }) do
		connect(record.connections, skin:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property), refresh)
	end
	connect(record.connections, skin.AttributeChanged, refresh)
	connect(record.connections, fallback.AttributeChanged, refresh)
	connect(record.connections, skin.AncestryChanged, function()
		if not skin:IsDescendantOf(gui) or skin.Parent ~= fallback.Parent then release(skin) end
	end)
	connect(record.connections, fallback.AncestryChanged, function()
		if not fallback:IsDescendantOf(gui) or fallback.Parent ~= skin.Parent then release(skin) end
	end)
	refresh()
end

end)

local function request(action, value, quiet)
 pending[action] = { value = value, quiet = quiet }
 if sending[action] then return end
 sending[action] = true
 task.spawn(function()
  while alive and pending[action] do
   local nextRequest = pending[action]
   pending[action] = nil
   local ok, result = pcall(remote.InvokeServer, remote, action, nextRequest.value)
   if not nextRequest.quiet and (not ok or typeof(result) == "table" and result.ok == false) then
    message = ok and tostring(result.message or "Try again.") or "Try again."
    messageUntil = workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + 1.4
   end
  end
  sending[action] = nil
 end)
end

  and UserInputService.MouseBehavior ~= Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter

  local forward = camera.CFrame.Position + camera.CFrame.LookVector * 100

  return Vector2.new(projected.X, projected.Y)
 end

 return viewportAim(camera.ViewportSize, UserInputService:GetMouseLocation(), deviceArea.Min - screenArea.Min, cursorAim)
end

local function progress(track, fraction)
 fraction = math.clamp(fraction, 0, 1)
 local gradient = track.Fill.Progress
 if fraction <= 0 then gradient.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(1)
 elseif fraction >= 1 then gradient.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0)
 else
  local edge = math.clamp(fraction, 0.001, 0.999)
  gradient.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(edge-0.0001,0),
   NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(edge+0.0001,1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,1)})
 end
end
