local function closestColour(color)
	local nearest = "Cream"
	local distance = math.huge
	for _, entry in ipairs(palette) do
		local reference = entry.color
		local difference = (color.R - reference.R) ^ 2 + (color.G - reference.G) ^ 2 + (color.B - reference.B) ^ 2
		if difference < distance then
			distance = difference
			nearest = entry.name
		end
	end
	return nearest
end

local function connect(bucket, signal, callback)
	local connection = signal:Connect(callback)
	table.insert(bucket, connection)
	return connection
end

local function release(target)
	local record = records[target]
	if not record then return end
	records[target] = nil
	for _, connection in ipairs(record.connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
end

local bind
bind = function(target)
	if not alive or records[target] or not target:IsA("GuiObject") or target:GetAttribute("UISkinManaged") ~= true then return end
	local skin = target:FindFirstChild("ReusableSkin")
	if not skin or not skin:IsA("ImageLabel") then return end
	local record = { connections = {}, hovering = false, pressed = false }
	records[target] = record
	local function refresh()
		if not alive or records[target] ~= record or not target.Parent then return end
		if target.BackgroundTransparency ~= 1 then target.BackgroundTransparency = 1 end
		local caption = target:FindFirstChild("LiveCaption")
		if caption and caption:IsA("TextLabel") and (target:IsA("TextButton") or target:IsA("TextLabel")) then
			caption.Text = target.Text
			caption.TextColor3 = captionFill
			if target.TextTransparency ~= 1 then target.TextTransparency = 1 end
			if target.TextStrokeTransparency ~= 1 then target.TextStrokeTransparency = 1 end
		end
		local colourName = closestColour(target.BackgroundColor3)
		local asset = skin:GetAttribute("DefaultImage")
		if target:GetAttribute("UISkinDynamic") == true then asset = skin:GetAttribute(colourName .. "Image") or asset end
		if typeof(asset) == "string" and asset ~= "" and skin.Image ~= asset then skin.Image = asset end
		local tinted = target:IsA("GuiButton") and target.Active and (record.hovering or record.pressed)
		skin.ImageColor3 = tinted and Color3.new(0.94, 0.94, 0.94) or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		local selection = target:FindFirstChild("SelectionMark")
		if selection and selection:IsA("GuiObject") then
			if target:GetAttribute("UISkinSelectionFromOutline") == true then
				local outline = target:FindFirstChild("Outline")
				selection.Visible = outline ~= nil and outline:IsA("UIStroke") and outline.Enabled
			elseif target:GetAttribute("UISkinSelectionFromColour") == true then
				selection.Visible = colourName == "Gold"
			end
		end
		local sourceGradient = target:FindFirstChild("Progress")
		local skinGradient = skin:FindFirstChild("Progress")
		if sourceGradient and sourceGradient:IsA("UIGradient") and skinGradient and skinGradient:IsA("UIGradient") then
			for _, property in ipairs({ "Color", "Transparency", "Offset", "Rotation", "Enabled" }) do
				skinGradient[property] = sourceGradient[property]
			end
		end
	end
	record.refresh = refresh
	for _, property in ipairs({ "BackgroundColor3", "BackgroundTransparency" }) do
		connect(record.connections, target:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property), refresh)
	end
	if target:IsA("TextButton") or target:IsA("TextLabel") then
		for _, property in ipairs({ "Text", "TextColor3", "TextTransparency", "TextStrokeTransparency" }) do
			connect(record.connections, target:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property), refresh)
		end
	end
	connect(record.connections, target.AttributeChanged, refresh)
	connect(record.connections, skin.AttributeChanged, refresh)
	local gradient = target:FindFirstChild("Progress")
	if gradient and gradient:IsA("UIGradient") then
		for _, property in ipairs({ "Color", "Transparency", "Offset", "Rotation", "Enabled" }) do
			connect(record.connections, gradient:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property), refresh)
		end
	end
	local outline = target:FindFirstChild("Outline")
	if outline and outline:IsA("UIStroke") then connect(record.connections, outline:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"), refresh) end
	if target:IsA("GuiButton") then
		connect(record.connections, target.MouseEnter, function() record.hovering = true refresh() end)
		connect(record.connections, target.MouseLeave, function() record.hovering = false record.pressed = false refresh() end)
		connect(record.connections, target.MouseButton1Down, function() record.pressed = target.Active refresh() end)
		connect(record.connections, target.MouseButton1Up, function() record.pressed = false refresh() end)
		connect(record.connections, target.Activated, function() record.pressed = false refresh() end)
		connect(record.connections, target:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Active"), function()
			if not target.Active then record.pressed = false record.hovering = false end
			refresh()
		end)
		connect(record.connections, target:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"), function()
			if not target.Visible then record.pressed = false record.hovering = false end
			refresh()
		end)
	end
	local function rebind(child)
		if child.Name ~= "ReusableSkin" and child.Name ~= "Progress" and child.Name ~= "Outline" and child.Name ~= "LiveCaption" and child.Name ~= "SelectionMark" then return end
		release(target)
		task.defer(function() if target:IsDescendantOf(gui) then bind(target) end end)
	end
	connect(record.connections, target.ChildAdded, rebind)
	connect(record.connections, target.ChildRemoved, rebind)
	connect(record.connections, target.AncestryChanged, function()
		if not target:IsDescendantOf(gui) then release(target) end
	end)
	refresh()
end

connect(connections, gui.DescendantAdded, function(descendant)
	task.defer(function()
		if not alive or not descendant:IsDescendantOf(gui) then return end
		bind(descendant)
		local parent = descendant.Parent
		if parent and parent:IsA("GuiObject") then bind(parent) end
	end)
end)

connect(connections, script.Destroying, function()
	alive = false
	for target in pairs(records) do release(target) end
	for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
end)

	["90528629970043"] = "Blue", ["84589903135132"] = "Gold",
	["80217215544210"] = "Cream", ["117403446558356"] = "Cream",
	["78972575698291"] = "Green", ["96220174131051"] = "Red",

local function connect(bucket, signal, callback)
	table.insert(bucket, signal:Connect(callback))
end

local function release(skin)
	local record = records[skin]
	if not record then return end
	records[skin] = nil
	if record.fallback.Parent then record.fallback.Visible = false end
	for _, connection in ipairs(record.connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
end

local function tint(color, imageColor)
	return Color3.new(color.R * imageColor.R, color.G * imageColor.G, color.B * imageColor.B)
end

local function faceColor(skin, fallback)
	local image = skin.Image
	local id = string.match(image, "^rbxassetid://(%d+)") or string.match(image, "[?&]id=(%d+)")
	local palette = id and imagePalettes[id]
	if palette then return palettes[palette] end
	for name, color in pairs(palettes) do
		if image ~= "" and skin:GetAttribute(name .. "Image") == image then return color end
	end
	return fallback:GetAttribute("FallbackFaceColor") or palettes.Cream
end

local function bind(skin)
	if not alive or records[skin] or not (skin:IsA("ImageLabel") or skin:IsA("ImageButton")) then return end
	local parent = skin.Parent
	local fallback = parent and parent:FindFirstChild(skin.Name .. "Fallback")
	if not fallback or not fallback:IsA("Frame") or fallback:GetAttribute("BackgroundFallbackFor") ~= skin.Name then return end
	local edge = fallback:FindFirstChild("Edge")
	local face = edge and edge:FindFirstChild("Face")
	if not edge or not face then return end
	local record = { connections = {}, fallback = fallback }
	records[skin] = record
	local function refresh()
		if not alive or records[skin] ~= record or skin.Parent ~= fallback.Parent then return end
		local transparency = math.clamp(skin.ImageTransparency, 0, 1)
		fallback.Visible = skin.Visible and skin.Image ~= "" and not skin.IsLoaded and transparency < 1
		fallback.BackgroundTransparency = transparency
		edge.BackgroundTransparency = transparency
		face.BackgroundTransparency = transparency
		fallback.BackgroundColor3 = tint(fallback:GetAttribute("FallbackInkColor") or Color3.fromRGB(31, 38, 60), skin.ImageColor3)
		local color = faceColor(skin, fallback)
		edge.BackgroundColor3 = tint(color:Lerp(white, 0.72), skin.ImageColor3)
		face.BackgroundColor3 = tint(color, skin.ImageColor3)
	end
	record.refresh = refresh
	for _, property in ipairs({ "IsLoaded", "Image", "ImageTransparency", "ImageColor3", "Visible" }) do
		connect(record.connections, skin:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property), refresh)
	end
	connect(record.connections, skin.AttributeChanged, refresh)
	connect(record.connections, fallback.AttributeChanged, refresh)
	connect(record.connections, skin.AncestryChanged, function()
		if not skin:IsDescendantOf(gui) or skin.Parent ~= fallback.Parent then release(skin) end
	end)
	connect(record.connections, fallback.AncestryChanged, function()
		if not fallback:IsDescendantOf(gui) or fallback.Parent ~= skin.Parent then release(skin) end
	end)
	refresh()
end

connect(connections, gui.DescendantAdded, function(descendant)

		bind(descendant)
		if descendant:IsA("Frame") then

			local parent = descendant.Parent
			local skin = typeof(name) == "string" and parent and parent:FindFirstChild(name)
			if skin then bind(skin) end
		end
	end)
end)

	alive = false
	for skin in pairs(records) do release(skin) end
	for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
end)

local function syncVisibility()

	gui.Enabled = allowed
	if not allowed then opened = false end
	hub.Visible = allowed and opened

	gui.CompactPanel.Visible = false
	gui.CompactToggle.Visible = false

	local short, long = math.min(viewport.X,viewport.Y), math.max(viewport.X,viewport.Y)
	local compact = viewport.X <= 900 or short <= 600 or (short <= 1024 and long <= 1400)
	gui.Toggle.Visible = allowed and not compact
	caption(gui.Toggle, opened and "CLOSE" or "ADMIN")

	end
	for _, button in ipairs(hub.Tabs:GetChildren()) do

local function sortedRoster(source)
	local result = {}
	for _, entry in ipairs(source) do
		if typeof(entry.userId) == "number" and typeof(entry.name) == "string" then table.insert(result, entry) end
	end
	table.sort(result, function(a, b)
		if a.userId == player.UserId then return b.userId ~= player.UserId end
		if b.userId == player.UserId then return false end
		return string.lower(a.name) < string.lower(b.name)
	end)
	return result
end
local function refreshLocalRoster()
	local list = {}
	for _, current in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		table.insert(list, { userId = current.UserId, name = current.Name, displayName = current.DisplayName, ready = current:GetAttribute("PCDataReady") == true })
	end
	roster = sortedRoster(list)
end
local function selectedEntry()
	for index, entry in ipairs(roster) do if entry.userId == selectedUserId then return entry, index end end
	return nil, nil
end
local function rewardReady()
	return admin() and not busy and targetData ~= nil and targetData.ready == true
end
local function syncTarget()
	local entry = selectedEntry()
	local own = selectedUserId == player.UserId
	local name = entry and ((entry.displayName or entry.name) .. " (@" .. entry.name .. ")") or "Player unavailable"
	hub.Target.PlayerName.Text = (own and "SELF · " or "") .. name
	hub.Target.PlayerStats.Text = targetData and targetData.ready and (tostring(targetData.coins or 0) .. " coins · Level " .. tostring(targetData.level or 1)) or "Profile loading..."
	enabled(hub.Target.Previous, admin() and not busy and #roster > 1)
	enabled(hub.Target.Next, admin() and not busy and #roster > 1)
	enabled(hub.Target.Self, admin() and not busy, own and gold or blue)
	enabled(pages.Rewards.Coins.GrantCoins, rewardReady())
	enabled(pages.Rewards.Levels.AddLevels, rewardReady())
	local entitlements = targetData and targetData.entitlements or {}
	for _, kind in ipairs({ "VIP", "BetaTester" }) do
		local button = pages.Rewards.Entitlements["Grant" .. kind]
		local granted = entitlements[kind] == true
		local label = kind == "VIP" and "VIP" or "BETA TESTER"
		caption(button, busy and "WAIT..." or granted and (label .. " ACTIVE") or ("GRANT " .. label))
		enabled(button, rewardReady() and not granted, kind == "VIP" and gold or green)
	end
end
local function unlockText(item)
	local unlock = item.unlock
	if not unlock or unlock.kind == "Starter" then return "Starter reward" end
	if unlock.kind == "Coins" then return tostring(item.price) .. " coins" end
	if unlock.kind == "Level" then return "Level " .. tostring(unlock.amount) end
	if unlock.kind == "VIP" then return "VIP reward" end
	if unlock.kind == "BetaTester" then return "Beta Tester reward" end
	return tostring(unlock.amount) .. " " .. (gameNames[unlock.gameId] or "total") .. " wins"
end
local function syncItems()
	local query = string.lower(string.sub(itemsPage.Search.Value.Text, 1, 100))
	local matches = {}
	for _, item in ipairs(catalog.Items) do
		if (category == "All" or item.category == category) and (query == "" or string.find(string.lower(item.id .. " " .. item.name), query, 1, true)) then table.insert(matches, item) end
	end
	pageCount = math.max(1, math.ceil(#matches / #slots))
	page = math.clamp(page, 1, pageCount)
	itemsPage.Empty.Visible = #matches == 0
	itemsPage.Pager.PageLabel.Text = tostring(page) .. " / " .. tostring(pageCount)
	enabled(itemsPage.Pager.Previous, page > 1 and not busy)
	enabled(itemsPage.Pager.Next, page < pageCount and not busy)
	for index, record in ipairs(slots) do
		local item = matches[(page - 1) * #slots + index]
		record.item = item
		record.row.Visible = item ~= nil
		if item then
			record.row:SetAttribute("CatalogId", item.id)
			local owned = targetData and targetData.owned and targetData.owned[item.id] == true
			local equipped = targetData and targetData.equipped and targetData.equipped[item.slot] == item.id
			record.row.ItemName.Text = item.id .. " · " .. item.name
			record.row.Detail.Text = item.category .. " · " .. (equipped and "Equipped" or owned and "Owned" or unlockText(item))
			caption(record.row.Grant, busy and "WAIT..." or owned and "OWNED" or "GRANT")
			caption(record.row.GrantEquip, busy and "WAIT..." or equipped and "EQUIPPED" or owned and "EQUIP" or "GRANT + EQUIP")
			enabled(record.row.Grant, rewardReady() and not owned and item.available ~= false)
			enabled(record.row.GrantEquip, rewardReady() and not equipped and item.available ~= false, green)
		end
	end
	for _, id in ipairs({ "All", "Bats", "Pets", "Toys" }) do enabled(itemsPage.Filters[id], admin(), id == category and gold or blue) end
end
local function syncRounds()
	local mud = states.MudState
	for action, button in pairs(gameControls) do
		local allowed = admin() and not busy
		enabled(button, allowed)
	end
	for id, stateName in pairs({ BritishBulldog = "BritishBulldogState", TagYoureIt = "TagState", StuckInTheMud = "MudState", HideAndSeek = "HideAndSeekState", DuckDuckGoose = "DuckDuckGooseState", SkippingRope = "SkippingRopeState" }) do
		local state = states[stateName]
		local phase = state and state:GetAttribute("Phase") or "Waiting"
		local mode = state and state:GetAttribute("Mode") or ""
		local text = (string.find(mode, "Practice", 1, true) and "Solo practice · " or "") .. (phases[phase] or phase)
		if id == "StuckInTheMud" and (not mud or mud:GetAttribute("GunAccessReady") ~= true) then text = mud and "Blasters unavailable · tap Start for details" or "Laser Tag is starting..." end
		pages.Rounds[id].Status.Text = text
	end
	local state = states.PlaygroundState
	caption(gameControls.ToggleAutomatic, state and state:GetAttribute("AutomaticRounds") == true and "AUTO ROUNDS: ON" or "AUTO ROUNDS: OFF")
end
local function sync()
	syncVisibility()
	syncTarget()
	syncItems()
	syncRounds()
end
local function applyReply(reply, requestedTarget)
	if typeof(reply.players) == "table" then roster = sortedRoster(reply.players) end
	if typeof(reply.limits) == "table" then
		for key in pairs(limits) do if typeof(reply.limits[key]) == "number" then limits[key] = reply.limits[key] end end
	end
	if requestedTarget == selectedUserId and typeof(reply.target) == "table" and reply.target.userId == selectedUserId then targetData = reply.target end
end
request = function(action, payload, quiet)
	if not admin() or busy then return end
	local remote = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("PlaygroundAdminRequest")
	if not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteFunction") then message("Admin controls are getting ready.") return end
	local requestedTarget = selectedUserId
	payload = payload or {}
	payload.targetUserId = requestedTarget
	busy = true
	if action ~= "GetStatus" then
		errorPanel.Visible = false
		message("Sending command...")
	end
	sync()
	task.spawn(function()
		local ok, reply = pcall(function() return remote:InvokeServer(action, payload) end)
		busy = false
		if not gui.Parent then return end
		if ok and typeof(reply) == "table" then
			applyReply(reply, requestedTarget)
			if typeof(reply.errorDetail) == "string" and reply.errorDetail ~= "" then
				errorPanel.Details.Text = reply.errorDetail
				errorPanel.Visible = true
			elseif not reply.ok and mudActions[action] and typeof(reply.message) == "string" and reply.message:find("Laser Tag blasters:", 1, true) == 1 then
				errorPanel.Details.Text = string.format("Laser Tag · Place version %d\n%s", game.PlaceVersion, reply.message)
				errorPanel.Visible = true
			end
			if not quiet or not reply.ok then message(reply.message or (reply.ok and "Done." or "Request did not complete.")) end
		else message("Server unavailable. Try again.") end
		sync()
		if requestedTarget ~= selectedUserId and admin() then task.defer(function() request("GetStatus", nil, true) end) end
	end)
end
local function selectTarget(userId)
	if busy then return end
	selectedUserId = userId
	targetData = nil
	message("Rewards will go to the selected player.")
	sync()
	request("GetStatus", nil, true)
end

	local _, index = selectedEntry()
	selectTarget(roster[((index or 1) - 1 + direction) % #roster + 1].userId)
end

local palette = {
	{ name = "Blue", color = Color3.fromRGB(42, 160, 255) },
	{ name = "Blue", color = Color3.fromRGB(89, 193, 244) },
	{ name = "Red", color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 81, 92) },

	{ name = "Mud", color = Color3.fromRGB(151, 94, 44) },
}

local function closestColour(color)
	local nearest = "Cream"
	local distance = math.huge
	for _, entry in ipairs(palette) do
		local reference = entry.color
		local difference = (color.R - reference.R) ^ 2 + (color.G - reference.G) ^ 2 + (color.B - reference.B) ^ 2
		if difference < distance then
			distance = difference
			nearest = entry.name
		end
	end
	return nearest
end

local function connect(bucket, signal, callback)
	local connection = signal:Connect(callback)
	table.insert(bucket, connection)
	return connection
end

local function release(target)
	local record = records[target]
	if not record then return end
	records[target] = nil
	for _, connection in ipairs(record.connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
end

local bind
bind = function(target)
	if not alive or records[target] or not target:IsA("GuiObject") or target:GetAttribute("UISkinManaged") ~= true then return end
	local skin = target:FindFirstChild("ReusableSkin")
	if not skin or not skin:IsA("ImageLabel") then return end
	local record = { connections = {}, hovering = false, pressed = false }
	records[target] = record
	local function refresh()
		if not alive or records[target] ~= record or not target.Parent then return end
		if target.BackgroundTransparency ~= 1 then target.BackgroundTransparency = 1 end
		local caption = target:FindFirstChild("LiveCaption")
		if caption and caption:IsA("TextLabel") and (target:IsA("TextButton") or target:IsA("TextLabel")) then
			caption.Text = target.Text
			caption.TextColor3 = captionFill
			if target.TextTransparency ~= 1 then target.TextTransparency = 1 end
			if target.TextStrokeTransparency ~= 1 then target.TextStrokeTransparency = 1 end
		end
		local colourName = closestColour(target.BackgroundColor3)
		local asset = skin:GetAttribute("DefaultImage")
		if target:GetAttribute("UISkinDynamic") == true then asset = skin:GetAttribute(colourName .. "Image") or asset end
		if typeof(asset) == "string" and asset ~= "" and skin.Image ~= asset then skin.Image = asset end
		local tinted = target:IsA("GuiButton") and target.Active and (record.hovering or record.pressed)
		skin.ImageColor3 = tinted and Color3.new(0.94, 0.94, 0.94) or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		local selection = target:FindFirstChild("SelectionMark")
		if selection and selection:IsA("GuiObject") then
			if target:GetAttribute("UISkinSelectionFromOutline") == true then
				local outline = target:FindFirstChild("Outline")
				selection.Visible = outline ~= nil and outline:IsA("UIStroke") and outline.Enabled
			elseif target:GetAttribute("UISkinSelectionFromColour") == true then
				selection.Visible = colourName == "Gold"
			end
		end
		local sourceGradient = target:FindFirstChild("Progress")
		local skinGradient = skin:FindFirstChild("Progress")
		if sourceGradient and sourceGradient:IsA("UIGradient") and skinGradient and skinGradient:IsA("UIGradient") then
			for _, property in ipairs({ "Color", "Transparency", "Offset", "Rotation", "Enabled" }) do
				skinGradient[property] = sourceGradient[property]
			end
		end
	end
	record.refresh = refresh
	for _, property in ipairs({ "BackgroundColor3", "BackgroundTransparency" }) do
		connect(record.connections, target:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property), refresh)
	end
	if target:IsA("TextButton") or target:IsA("TextLabel") then
		for _, property in ipairs({ "Text", "TextColor3", "TextTransparency", "TextStrokeTransparency" }) do
			connect(record.connections, target:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property), refresh)
		end
	end
	connect(record.connections, target.AttributeChanged, refresh)
	connect(record.connections, skin.AttributeChanged, refresh)
	local gradient = target:FindFirstChild("Progress")
	if gradient and gradient:IsA("UIGradient") then
		for _, property in ipairs({ "Color", "Transparency", "Offset", "Rotation", "Enabled" }) do
			connect(record.connections, gradient:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property), refresh)
		end
	end
	local outline = target:FindFirstChild("Outline")
	if outline and outline:IsA("UIStroke") then connect(record.connections, outline:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"), refresh) end
	if target:IsA("GuiButton") then
		connect(record.connections, target.MouseEnter, function() record.hovering = true refresh() end)
		connect(record.connections, target.MouseLeave, function() record.hovering = false record.pressed = false refresh() end)
		connect(record.connections, target.MouseButton1Down, function() record.pressed = target.Active refresh() end)
		connect(record.connections, target.MouseButton1Up, function() record.pressed = false refresh() end)
		connect(record.connections, target.Activated, function() record.pressed = false refresh() end)
		connect(record.connections, target:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Active"), function()
			if not target.Active then record.pressed = false record.hovering = false end
			refresh()
		end)
		connect(record.connections, target:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"), function()
			if not target.Visible then record.pressed = false record.hovering = false end
			refresh()
		end)
	end
	local function rebind(child)
		if child.Name ~= "ReusableSkin" and child.Name ~= "Progress" and child.Name ~= "Outline" and child.Name ~= "LiveCaption" and child.Name ~= "SelectionMark" then return end
		release(target)
		task.defer(function() if target:IsDescendantOf(gui) then bind(target) end end)
	end
	connect(record.connections, target.ChildAdded, rebind)
	connect(record.connections, target.ChildRemoved, rebind)
	connect(record.connections, target.AncestryChanged, function()
		if not target:IsDescendantOf(gui) then release(target) end
	end)
	refresh()
end

end)

local function equippedBat()
	if not UserInputService.TouchEnabled or player:GetAttribute("PCDataReady") ~= true
		or player:GetAttribute("MDParticipating") == true then return nil end
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or player:GetAttribute("BBRagdolled") == true
		or player:GetAttribute("TGRagdolled") == true or player:GetAttribute("HSRagdolled") == true or player:GetAttribute("DGRagdolled") == true then return nil end
	local gameId
	if player:GetAttribute("BBParticipating") == true and player:GetAttribute("BBRole") == "Bulldog" then
		local state = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("BritishBulldogState")
		if state and state:GetAttribute("Phase") == "Crossing" then gameId = "BritishBulldog" end
	elseif player:GetAttribute("TGParticipating") == true and player:GetAttribute("TGRole") == "Tagger" then
		local state = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("TagState")
		if state and state:GetAttribute("Phase") == "Playing" then gameId = "TagYoureIt" end
	elseif player:GetAttribute("HSParticipating") == true and player:GetAttribute("HSRole") == "Seeker" then
		local state = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("HideAndSeekState")
		if state and state:GetAttribute("Phase") == "Seeking" then gameId = "HideAndSeek" end
	elseif player:GetAttribute("DGParticipating") == true and player:GetAttribute("DGRole") == "Goose" then
		local state = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("DuckDuckGooseState")
		if state and state:GetAttribute("Phase") == "Playing" and state:GetAttribute("TurnPhase") == "Chasing" then gameId = "DuckDuckGoose" end
	end
	if not gameId then return nil end
	for _, tool in character:GetChildren() do
		if tool:IsA("Tool") and tool.Enabled and tool:GetAttribute("PCBatWeapon") == true
			and tool:GetAttribute("WeaponGame") == gameId then return tool end
	end
	return nil
end

local function remainingCooldown()
	local at = player:GetAttribute("PCBatSwingAt")
	local serverRemaining = typeof(at) == "number" and at > 0 and at + 0.75 - workspace:GetServerTimeNow() or 0
	return math.max(0, nextTapAt - os.clock(), serverRemaining)
end

local function refresh()
	local bat = equippedBat()
	button.Visible = bat ~= nil
	local ready = bat ~= nil and focused and not GuiService.MenuIsOpen
		and not UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() and remainingCooldown() <= 0
	button.Active = ready
	button.Selectable = false
	skin.ImageColor3 = ready and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or Color3.fromRGB(164, 170, 184)
	button.Hint.Text = remainingCooldown() > 0 and string.format("%.1fs", remainingCooldown()) or "TAP"
	fallback.Visible = not skin.IsLoaded
end

local function swing()
	local bat = equippedBat()
	if not button.Visible or not gui.Enabled or not bat or not focused or GuiService.MenuIsOpen
		or UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() or remainingCooldown() > 0 then return end
	nextTapAt = os.clock() + 0.75
	local ok = pcall(function()
		bat:Activate()
		bat:Deactivate()
	end)
	if not ok then nextTapAt = 0 end
	refresh()
end

local function fit()
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera then return end
	local viewport = camera.ViewportSize
	panel.Fit.Scale = math.min(1, math.max(0.25, (viewport.X - 32) / 460), math.max(0.25, (viewport.Y - 100) / 460))

local function buy(offer)
	if not panel.Visible or inRound() or pending then return end
	if commerce:GetAttribute("Ready") ~= true then panel.Status.Text = "Donations are not available right now." return end
	if not offer then panel.Status.Text = "That amount isn't available yet. Choose an available button." return end
	pending = offer.id
	panel.Status.Text = "Confirm your donation in the Roblox window."
	local ok = pcall(function() MarketplaceService:PromptProductPurchase(player, offer.id) end)
	if not ok then pending = nil panel.Status.Text = "Roblox couldn't open the purchase. Please try again." end
end

local function loadOffers()
	if loading then return end
	loading = true
	table.clear(offers)
	panel.Status.Text = "Checking donation options..."
	for _, button in panel.Amounts:GetChildren() do
		if button:IsA("GuiButton") then button.Active = false button:SetAttribute("ProductId", nil) end
	end
	local count = 0
	for _, entry in config:GetChildren() do
		if not entry:IsA("IntValue") or entry.Value <= 0 then continue end
		local ok, info = pcall(function() return MarketplaceService:GetProductInfoAsync(entry.Value, Enum.InfoType.Product) end)
		if not ok or typeof(info) ~= "table" or info.IsForSale == false or typeof(info.PriceInRobux) ~= "number" or info.PriceInRobux < 1 then continue end
		local offer = { id = entry.Value, price = info.PriceInRobux }
		table.insert(offers, offer)
		count += 1
		local button = panel.Amounts:FindFirstChild(entry.Name)
		if button then
			button.Label.Text = tostring(offer.price) .. " ROBUX"
			button:SetAttribute("ProductId", offer.id)
			button.Active = true
		end
	end
	loading = false
	panel.Status.Text = count > 0 and "Every donation helps. Thank you!" or "Donations are coming soon."
end

for _, button in panel.Amounts:GetChildren() do
	if button:IsA("GuiButton") then
		button.Activated:Connect(function()
			local id = button:GetAttribute("ProductId")
			for _, offer in offers do if offer.id == id then buy(offer) return end end
			panel.Status.Text = "This donation option is not available yet."
		end)
	end
end

	if selected and selected:IsDescendantOf(gui) then
		GuiService.SelectedObject = previousSelection and previousSelection.Parent and previousSelection or nil
	end
	previousSelection = nil
end

local function selectFirst()
	if not gamepadActive() then return end
	for _, record in ipairs(slots) do
		if record.button.Visible and record.button.Selectable then GuiService.SelectedObject = record.button return end
	end
	GuiService.SelectedObject = panel.ShopButton
end

local function imageState(record)
	if not record.item then return end
	if record.button.Thumbnail.IsLoaded then
		record.imageStatus = ""
	else
		if panel.Visible and not record.imageStartedAt then record.imageStartedAt = os.clock() end
		record.imageStatus = record.imageStartedAt and os.clock() - record.imageStartedAt >= 8 and "IMAGE UNAVAILABLE" or "LOADING IMAGE"
	end
end

local function setImage(record, item)
	if record.item == item then imageState(record) return end
	record.item = item
	record.imageStartedAt = nil
	record.imageStatus = ""
	local thumbnail = record.button.Thumbnail
	thumbnail.Image = item and item.thumbnail or ""
	thumbnail.Visible = item ~= nil
	if not item then return end
	imageState(record)
end

render = function()
	if not alive then return end
	dances = {}
	for _, item in ipairs(catalog.Items) do
		if item.slot == "Emote" and item.playable == true and item.available ~= false and owned[item.id] == true then
			table.insert(dances, item)
		end
	end
	pageCount = math.max(1, math.ceil(#dances / 8))
	page = math.clamp(page, 1, pageCount)
	local active = isPlaying() and player:GetAttribute("PCEmoteAction") or ""
	for index, record in ipairs(slots) do
		local item = dances[(page - 1) * 8 + index]
		setImage(record, item)
		local button = record.button
		button.Visible = item ~= nil
		buttonState(button, item ~= nil and ready and not busy, item ~= nil and (active == item.id or record.hovered == true))
		button.ItemName.Text = item and item.name or ""
		record.selected.Visible = item ~= nil and (active == item.id or record.hovered == true)
		button.State.Text = item and (active == item.id and "PLAYING" or record.imageStatus ~= "" and record.imageStatus or equipped.Emote == item.id and "PODIUM EMOTE" or "") or ""
	end
	panel.PageLabel.Text = tostring(page) .. " / " .. tostring(pageCount)
	buttonState(panel.Previous, not busy and page > 1)
	buttonState(panel.Next, not busy and page < pageCount)
	buttonState(panel.StopButton, not busy and isPlaying())
	panel.StopButton.Visible = isPlaying()
	if notice ~= "" and os.clock() < noticeUntil then panel.Status.Text = notice
	elseif busy then panel.Status.Text = "Loading..."
	elseif not ready then panel.Status.Text = "Your emotes are getting ready."
	elseif #dances == 0 then panel.Status.Text = "No emotes yet. Unlock dances in the shop."
	else panel.Status.Text = tostring(#dances) .. " owned • Move or jump to stop" end
	panel.Hint.Text = not ready and "LOADING\nEMOTES" or #dances == 0 and "UNLOCK DANCES\nIN THE SHOP" or gamepadActive() and "A TO PLAY\nB TO CLOSE" or UserInputService.TouchEnabled and "TAP A\nDANCE" or "CLICK OR 1–8\nTO DANCE"
	local caption = toggle:FindFirstChild("LiveCaption")
	if caption then caption.Text = gamepadActive() and "EMOTES [D-PAD]" or UserInputService.TouchEnabled and "EMOTES" or "EMOTES [ . ]" end
end

local function acceptStatus(reply)
	if typeof(reply) ~= "table" then return false end
	if typeof(reply.owned) == "table" and typeof(reply.equipped) == "table" and typeof(reply.ready) == "boolean" then
		owned, equipped, ready = reply.owned, reply.equipped, reply.ready
		return true
	end
	return false
end

request = function(action, id)
	if not alive then return end
	if busy then
		if action == "GetStatus" then refreshQueued = true end
		return
	end
	local remote = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("PlaygroundShopRequest")
	if not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteFunction") then tell("The emote shop is getting ready.") render() return end
	if action == "GetStatus" and os.clock() - lastFetch < 0.2 then
		refreshQueued = true
		return
	end
	busy = true
	requestSerial += 1
	local serial = requestSerial
	if action == "GetStatus" then lastFetch = os.clock() end
	render()
	task.delay(8, function()
		if not alive or serial ~= requestSerial or not busy then return end
		requestSerial += 1
		busy = false
		if requestWorker then pcall(task.cancel, requestWorker) requestWorker = nil end
		tell("That took too long. Open the wheel to try again.")
		render()
	end)
	requestWorker = task.spawn(function()
		local ok, reply = pcall(function() return remote:InvokeServer(action, id) end)
		if not alive or serial ~= requestSerial then return end
		requestWorker = nil
		busy = false
		local valid = ok and acceptStatus(reply)
		if not valid then
			tell("The emote shop could not respond. Try again.")
		elseif action == "UseEmote" and reply.ok == true then
			notice = ""
			setOpen(false)
		elseif action ~= "GetStatus" then
			tell(reply.message ~= "" and reply.message or (reply.ok and "Done." or "Try again in a moment."))
		end
		render()
		if panel.Visible then selectFirst() end
	end)
end

setOpen = function(show)
	if not alive then return end
	if show and (not gui.Enabled or inRound() or otherModalOpen()) then return end
	if show == panel.Visible then return end
	panel.Visible = show
	backdrop.Visible = show
	if show then
		previousSelection = GuiService.SelectedObject
		notice = ""
		render()
		selectFirst()
		request("GetStatus")
	else
		restoreSelection()
	end
end

local function playSlot(index)
	local record = slots[index]
	if not panel.Visible or busy or not ready or inRound() or otherModalOpen() or not record or not record.item then return end
	request("UseEmote", record.item.id)
end

for index = 1, 8 do

	local record = { button = button, selected = button:WaitForChild("Selected"), imageStatus = "", hovered = false }
	table.insert(slots, record)
	connect(button.Activated, function() playSlot(index) end)
	connect(button.MouseEnter, function() record.hovered = true render() end)
	connect(button.MouseLeave, function() record.hovered = false render() end)
	connect(button.SelectionGained, function() record.hovered = true render() end)
	connect(button.SelectionLost, function() record.hovered = false render() end)
	connect(button.Thumbnail:GetPropertyChangedSignal("IsLoaded"), function() imageState(record) render() end)
end

local function movePage(delta)

	page = math.clamp(page + delta, 1, pageCount)
	for _, record in ipairs(slots) do record.hovered = false end
	render()

end

local function inputAction(_, state, input)
	if not gui.Enabled or UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() or GuiService.MenuIsOpen then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass end
	local key = input.KeyCode
	if key == Enum.KeyCode.DPadDown and panel.Visible then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass end
	if key == Enum.KeyCode.Period or key == Enum.KeyCode.DPadDown then
		if inRound() or otherModalOpen() then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass end
		if state == Enum.UserInputState.Begin then setOpen(not panel.Visible) end
		return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
	end
	if not panel.Visible then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass end
	if state == Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
		if key == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonB then setOpen(false)
		elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL1 then movePage(-1)
		elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonR1 then movePage(1)
		else
			local index = table.find(numberKeys, key)
			if index then playSlot(index) end
		end
	end
	return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
end

local function remaining(expires, now)
	if typeof(expires) ~= "number" or expires ~= expires or math.abs(expires) == math.huge then return 0 end
	return math.max(0, math.ceil(expires - now))
end

local function formatTime(seconds)
	return string.format("%d:%02d", math.floor(seconds / 60), seconds % 60)
end

local function modalOpen(playerGui)
	local panels = {
		PlaygroundShell = { "ShopPanel", "VotePanel", "CompactVotePanel" },
		PlaygroundEmoteWheel = { "Panel" },
		PlaygroundDonations = { "Panel" },
		PlaygroundAdminPanel = { "Panel", "CompactPanel", "AdminHub" },
		PlaygroundSessionControls = { "Dock" },
		MudHUD = { "ColourPicker" },
	}
	for name, children in pairs(panels) do
		local screen = playerGui:FindFirstChild(name)
		if screen and screen.Enabled then
			for _, child in ipairs(children) do
				local panel = screen:FindFirstChild(child)
				if panel and panel.Visible then return true end
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function refresh()
	local playerGui = gui.Parent
	local session = playerGui:FindFirstChild("PlaygroundSessionControls")
	local hidden = session and (session:GetAttribute("UIHidden") == true
		or session:GetAttribute("Spectating") == true or session:GetAttribute("SessionMenuOpen") == true)
	hidden = hidden or modalOpen(playerGui)
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local viewport = camera and camera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280,720)
	local short = math.min(viewport.X,viewport.Y)
	local isCompact = viewport.X <= 900 or short <= 600
		or (short <= 1024 and math.max(viewport.X,viewport.Y) <= 1400)
	local participating = player:GetAttribute("BBParticipating") == true
		or player:GetAttribute("TGParticipating") == true or ( player:GetAttribute("MDParticipating") == true or player:GetAttribute("HSParticipating") == true or player:GetAttribute("DGParticipating") == true or player:GetAttribute("DGEliminated") == true or player:GetAttribute("SKParticipating") == true or player:GetAttribute("SKEliminated") == true )
	local selected = not isCompact and desktop or participating and round
		or viewport.Y > viewport.X and portrait or compact
	for _, dock in docks do dock.Visible = not hidden and dock == selected end
	local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	for name, attribute in pairs(attributes) do
		local seconds = remaining(player:GetAttribute(attribute),now)
		for _, dock in docks do
			local row = dock[name]
			row.Visible = seconds > 0
			row.Timer.Text = formatTime(seconds)
		end
	end
end

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local state = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PlaygroundState")
local connections = {}
local elapsed = 0

local function render()
	local phase = state:GetAttribute("Phase")
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local viewport = camera and camera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280,720)
	local short = math.min(viewport.X,viewport.Y)
	local compact = viewport.X <= 900 or short <= 600
		or (short <= 1024 and math.max(viewport.X,viewport.Y) <= 1400)
	local portrait = compact and viewport.Y > viewport.X
	local participating = player:GetAttribute("BBParticipating") == true
		or player:GetAttribute("TGParticipating") == true or ( player:GetAttribute("MDParticipating") == true or player:GetAttribute("HSParticipating") == true or player:GetAttribute("DGParticipating") == true or player:GetAttribute("DGEliminated") == true or player:GetAttribute("SKParticipating") == true or player:GetAttribute("SKEliminated") == true )
	local shown = not participating and phase ~= "Playing"
	local shell = gui.Parent:FindFirstChild("PlaygroundShell")
	local toast = shell and shell:FindFirstChild("RewardToast")
	local backdrop = shell and shell:FindFirstChild("Backdrop")
	local session = gui.Parent:FindFirstChild("PlaygroundSessionControls")
	if backdrop and backdrop.Visible then shown = false end
	if session and (session:GetAttribute("UIHidden") == true or session:GetAttribute("SessionMenuOpen") == true) then shown = false end
	if compact and toast and toast.Visible then shown = false end
	for name, panels in pairs({ PlaygroundEmoteWheel = { "Panel" }, PlaygroundDonations = { "Panel" },
		PlaygroundAdminPanel = { "Panel", "CompactPanel", "AdminHub" } }) do
		local screen = gui.Parent:FindFirstChild(name)
		if screen and screen.Enabled then
			for _, name in ipairs(panels) do
				local panel = screen:FindFirstChild(name)
				if panel and panel.Visible then shown = false end
			end
		end
	end
	local title, timer, detail = "NEXT ROUND", "", "Preparing the lobby..."
	local status = state:GetAttribute("IntermissionStatus")
	if phase == "Voting" then
		local endsAt = state:GetAttribute("VotingEndsAt")
		if typeof(endsAt) == "number" and endsAt == endsAt and math.abs(endsAt) < math.huge then
			local seconds = math.max(0,math.ceil(endsAt-workspace:GetServerTimeNow()))
			timer = string.format("%d:%02d",math.floor(seconds/60),seconds%60)
		end
		title = "INTERMISSION"
		detail = status == "Next round starts in" and "Vote for the next game!" or status or "Vote for the next game!"
	elseif phase == "Paused" then
		title, detail = "ROUNDS PAUSED", "Automatic rounds paused by an admin"
	elseif phase == "Waiting" then
		title = "WAITING FOR PLAYERS"
		local count = state:GetAttribute("ReadyPlayerCount") or 0
		local minimum = state:GetAttribute("MinimumReadyPlayers") or 2
		detail = typeof(status) == "string" and status ~= "" and status or string.format("%d / %d players ready",count,minimum)
	end
	local compactDetail = detail
	if phase == "Waiting" then
		compactDetail = typeof(status) == "string" and string.find(string.lower(status),"data",1,true)
			and "Loading player data" or string.format("Players ready: %d/%d",state:GetAttribute("ReadyPlayerCount") or 0,state:GetAttribute("MinimumReadyPlayers") or 2)
	elseif phase == "Paused" then
		compactDetail = "Paused by an admin"
	elseif phase == "Voting" and status ~= nil and status ~= "Next round starts in" then
		compactDetail = "Retrying next round"
	end
	for _,card in {gui.Desktop,gui.Compact,gui.Portrait} do
		card.Visible = shown and (card == gui.Desktop and not compact
			or card == gui.Compact and compact and not portrait
			or card == gui.Portrait and portrait)
		card.Title.Text = card ~= gui.Desktop and phase == "Waiting" and "WAITING" or title
		card.Timer.Text = timer
		card.Detail.Text = card == gui.Desktop and detail or compactDetail
		card.Fallback.Visible = not card.ReusableSkin.IsLoaded
	end
end

	["80217215544210"] = "Cream", ["117403446558356"] = "Cream",
	["78972575698291"] = "Green", ["96220174131051"] = "Red",

local function connect(bucket, signal, callback)
	table.insert(bucket, signal:Connect(callback))
end

local function release(skin)
	local record = records[skin]
	if not record then return end
	records[skin] = nil
	if record.fallback.Parent then record.fallback.Visible = false end
	for _, connection in ipairs(record.connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
end

local function tint(color, imageColor)
	return Color3.new(color.R * imageColor.R, color.G * imageColor.G, color.B * imageColor.B)
end

local function faceColor(skin, fallback)
	local image = skin.Image
	local id = string.match(image, "^rbxassetid://(%d+)") or string.match(image, "[?&]id=(%d+)")
	local palette = id and imagePalettes[id]
	if palette then return palettes[palette] end
	for name, color in pairs(palettes) do
		if image ~= "" and skin:GetAttribute(name .. "Image") == image then return color end
	end
	return fallback:GetAttribute("FallbackFaceColor") or palettes.Cream
end

local function bind(skin)
	if not alive or records[skin] or not (skin:IsA("ImageLabel") or skin:IsA("ImageButton")) then return end
	local parent = skin.Parent
	local fallback = parent and parent:FindFirstChild(skin.Name .. "Fallback")
	if not fallback or not fallback:IsA("Frame") or fallback:GetAttribute("BackgroundFallbackFor") ~= skin.Name then return end
	local edge = fallback:FindFirstChild("Edge")
	local face = edge and edge:FindFirstChild("Face")
	if not edge or not face then return end
	local record = { connections = {}, fallback = fallback }
	records[skin] = record
	local function refresh()
		if not alive or records[skin] ~= record or skin.Parent ~= fallback.Parent then return end
		local transparency = math.clamp(skin.ImageTransparency, 0, 1)
		fallback.Visible = skin.Visible and skin.Image ~= "" and not skin.IsLoaded and transparency < 1
		fallback.BackgroundTransparency = transparency
		edge.BackgroundTransparency = transparency
		face.BackgroundTransparency = transparency
		fallback.BackgroundColor3 = tint(fallback:GetAttribute("FallbackInkColor") or Color3.fromRGB(31, 38, 60), skin.ImageColor3)
		local color = faceColor(skin, fallback)
		edge.BackgroundColor3 = tint(color:Lerp(white, 0.72), skin.ImageColor3)
		face.BackgroundColor3 = tint(color, skin.ImageColor3)
	end
	record.refresh = refresh
	for _, property in ipairs({ "IsLoaded", "Image", "ImageTransparency", "ImageColor3", "Visible" }) do
		connect(record.connections, skin:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property), refresh)
	end
	connect(record.connections, skin.AttributeChanged, refresh)
	connect(record.connections, fallback.AttributeChanged, refresh)
	connect(record.connections, skin.AncestryChanged, function()
		if not skin:IsDescendantOf(gui) or skin.Parent ~= fallback.Parent then release(skin) end
	end)
	connect(record.connections, fallback.AncestryChanged, function()
		if not fallback:IsDescendantOf(gui) or fallback.Parent ~= skin.Parent then release(skin) end
	end)
	refresh()
end

		bind(descendant)

	end)
end)

local function connect(signal, callback)

 table.insert(connections, connection)
 return connection

local function finite(value)
 return typeof(value) == "number" and value == value and math.abs(value) < math.huge
end

local function label(value, fallback)
 return typeof(value) == "string" and value ~= "" and value or fallback
end

local function pollSeconds(scope, state, retryAfter)
 if state == "loading" then
  return finite(retryAfter) and math.clamp(retryAfter, 5, 60) or 5
 end
 if state == "unavailable" then return 60 end
 if state == "stale" then return 30 end
 return scope == "server" and 10 or 60
end

local function setSelected(record)
 for name, button in pairs(record.buttons) do
  local selected = name == record.scope
  button:SetAttribute("Selected", selected)
  button.ReusableSkin.Image = selected and "rbxassetid://84589903135132" or "https://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=90528629970043&version=1"
 end
end

local function scopeHeading(record, region)
 local heading = record.scope == "region" and label(region, "REGION") or string.upper(record.scope)
 record.display.Header.Subtitle.Text = string.upper(heading) .. " · TOP 10"
end

local function clearRows(record)
 for _, row in ipairs(record.rows) do row.Visible = false end
 record.hasEntries = false
end

local function loading(record)
 clearRows(record)
 record.dataScope = nil
 record.display.Empty.Visible = true
 local name = record.scope == "region" and "regional" or record.scope
 record.display.Empty.Text = "Loading " .. name .. " rankings..."
 record.display.Status.Text = "Loading..."
 scopeHeading(record)
end

local function restoreWorld(record)
 if record.worldConnection then record.worldConnection:Disconnect() record.worldConnection = nil end
 if record.world and record.world.Parent then record.world.Enabled = record.worldEnabled end
 record.world = nil
end

local function showLocal(record)
 local face = record.display.Adornee
 local visible = alive and gui.Enabled and record.ready and face and face:IsDescendantOf(workspace)
 record.display.Enabled = visible == true
 if record.world and record.world.Parent then
  if visible then record.world.Enabled = false else record.world.Enabled = record.worldEnabled end
 end
end

local function bindWorld(record)
 local lobby = workspace:FindFirstChild("Playground Lobby")
 local boards = lobby and lobby:FindFirstChild("Leaderboards")
 local board = boards and boards:FindFirstChild(record.id)
 local face = board and board:FindFirstChild("Face")
 local world = face and face:FindFirstChild("Display")
 if world ~= record.world then
  restoreWorld(record)
  if world and world:IsA("SurfaceGui") then
   record.world = world
   record.worldEnabled = world.Enabled
   record.worldConnection = world:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function()
    if alive and record.ready and gui.Enabled and record.display.Enabled and world.Enabled then world.Enabled = false end
   end)
  end
 end
 if face and face:IsA("BasePart") and record.display.Adornee ~= face then record.display.Adornee = face end
 showLocal(record)
end

local function validBoard(data)
 return typeof(data) == "table" and typeof(data.entries) == "table"
  and (data.state == nil or data.state == "loading" or data.state == "ready" or data.state == "stale" or data.state == "unavailable")
end

local function publishPodium(record, reply)
 if gui:GetAttribute("PodiumBoard") ~= record.id or gui:GetAttribute("PodiumScope") ~= record.scope then return end
 local data = reply.boards[record.id]
 if not validBoard(data) then return end
 local entries = {}
 for index = 1, 3 do
  local entry = data.entries[index]
  if entry then entries[index] = entry end
 end
 local packet = { board = record.id, scope = record.scope, region = reply.region, state = data.state or reply.state or "ready", status = data.status or reply.status, entries = entries }
 gui:SetAttribute("PodiumSnapshot", HttpService:JSONEncode(packet))
end

local function render(record, reply, receivedAt)
 local data = reply.boards[record.id]
 if not validBoard(data) then return false end
 local count = 0
 for index, row in ipairs(record.rows) do
  local entry = data.entries[index]
  local valid = typeof(entry) == "table" and finite(entry.userId)
   and typeof(entry.name) == "string" and typeof(entry.value) == "string"
  row.Visible = valid
  if valid then
   count += 1
   row.Rank.Text = tostring(index)
   row.PlayerName.Text = label(entry.name, "Player")
   row.Value.Text = entry.value
   row.Avatar.Image = typeof(entry.image) == "string" and entry.image or ""
   row.Avatar.Placeholder.Visible = row.Avatar.Image == ""
  end
 end
 record.hasEntries = count > 0
 record.dataScope = record.scope
 record.state = data.state or reply.state or "ready"
 record.display.Empty.Visible = count == 0
 record.display.Empty.Text = label(data.emptyText, record.state == "loading" and "Loading rankings..." or "No scores yet.")
 record.display.Status.Text = label(data.status, label(reply.status, ""))
 scopeHeading(record, reply.region)
 record.nextRefresh = receivedAt + pollSeconds(record.scope, record.state, data.retryAfter or reply.retryAfter)
 record.ready = true
 record.lastReply = reply
 publishPodium(record, reply)
 showLocal(record)
 return true
end

local function showFailure(record, message)
 record.display.Status.Text = message
 if not record.hasEntries or record.dataScope ~= record.scope then
  clearRows(record)
  record.display.Empty.Visible = true
  record.display.Empty.Text = "Couldn't load these rankings. Try again shortly."
 end
 record.state = "error"
 record.nextRefresh = clock() + 15
 local previous = record.dataScope == record.scope and record.lastReply
 local data = previous and previous.boards[record.id]
 local failedReply = { region = previous and previous.region, boards = {
  [record.id] = { state = record.hasEntries and "stale" or "unavailable", status = message, entries = data and data.entries or {} },
 } }
 record.lastReply = failedReply
 publishPodium(record, failedReply)
end

local function selectScope(record, scope)
 if not alive or not scopes[scope] then return end
 gui:SetAttribute("PodiumBoard", record.id)
 gui:SetAttribute("PodiumScope", scope)
 if record.scope == scope then
  if record.lastReply and record.dataScope == scope then publishPodium(record, record.lastReply) end
  if record.state == "error" then record.nextRefresh = clock() end
  return
 end
 record.scope = scope
 record.version += 1
 record.state = "loading"
 record.nextRefresh = 0
 setSelected(record)
 loading(record)
 publishPodium(record, { boards = { [record.id] = { state = "loading", entries = {} } } })
 local cached = cache[scope]
 if cached and clock() < cached.expiresAt then
  render(record, cached.reply, cached.receivedAt)
 end
end

local function failRequest(request, message)
 for record, version in pairs(request.targets) do
  if record.version == version and record.scope == request.scope then showFailure(record, message) end
 end
end

local function cancelRequest(request)
 if not request then return end
 request.expired = true
 if request.thread and coroutine.status(request.thread) ~= "dead" then pcall(task.cancel, request.thread) end
end

local function beginRequest(remote, scope, now)
 requestSerial += 1
 local request = { serial = requestSerial, scope = scope, startedAt = now, targets = {}, remote = remote }
 for _, record in ipairs(records) do
  if record.scope == scope then request.targets[record] = record.version end
 end
 inFlight = request
 lastRequestAt = now
 request.thread = task.spawn(function()
  local ok, reply = pcall(function() return remote:InvokeServer(scope) end)
  if not alive or inFlight ~= request then return end
  inFlight = nil
  if request.expired then return end
  if not ok or typeof(reply) ~= "table" or reply.scope ~= scope or typeof(reply.boards) ~= "table" then
   failRequest(request, "Refresh unavailable. Please try again.")
   return
  end
  local receivedAt = clock()
  local interval = pollSeconds(scope, reply.state, reply.retryAfter)
  local hasValidBoard = false
  for _, record in ipairs(records) do
   local data = reply.boards[record.id]
   if validBoard(data) then
    hasValidBoard = true
    interval = math.min(interval, pollSeconds(scope, data.state or reply.state, data.retryAfter or reply.retryAfter))
   end
  end
  if hasValidBoard then cache[scope] = { reply = reply, receivedAt = receivedAt, expiresAt = receivedAt + interval } end
  for record, version in pairs(request.targets) do
   if record.version == version and record.scope == scope then
    if not render(record, reply, receivedAt) then showFailure(record, "These rankings are temporarily unavailable.") end
   end
  end
 end)
end

local function tick()
 if not alive then return end
 local now = clock()
 for _, record in ipairs(records) do bindWorld(record) end
 local remote = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("PlaygroundLeaderboardRequest")
 if not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
  if inFlight then
   local removed = inFlight
   cancelRequest(removed)
   inFlight = nil
   failRequest(removed, "Connection interrupted. Rankings will retry when available.")
  end
  lastRemote = nil
  return
 end
 if remote ~= lastRemote then
  lastRemote = remote
  cancelRequest(inFlight)
  inFlight = nil
  requestSerial += 1
  for _, record in ipairs(records) do record.nextRefresh = 0 end
 end
 if inFlight then
  if now - inFlight.startedAt >= 12 then
   local timedOut = inFlight
   cancelRequest(timedOut)
   inFlight = nil
   failRequest(timedOut, "Refresh is taking too long. Please try again.")
  end
  return
 end
 if now - lastRequestAt < 1.05 then return end
 local candidate
 for _, record in ipairs(records) do
  if now >= record.nextRefresh and (not candidate or record.nextRefresh < candidate.nextRefresh) then candidate = record end
 end
 if candidate then beginRequest(remote, candidate.scope, now) end
end

local function cleanup()

local function finite(value)
	return typeof(value) == "number" and value == value and math.abs(value) < math.huge
end

local function animationId(value)
	if typeof(value) == "number" then
		if not finite(value) or value <= 0 or value % 1 ~= 0 then return nil end
		value = string.format("%.0f", value)
	end
	if typeof(value) ~= "string" then return nil end
	local digits = value:match("^rbxassetid://(%d+)$") or value:match("^(%d+)$")
	if not digits or #digits > 18 or tonumber(digits) <= 0 then return nil end
	return "rbxassetid://" .. digits
end

local function readableIsA(object, className)
	local ok, result = pcall(function() return object:IsA(className) end)
	return ok and result
end

local function bodyBounds(model)
	local low, high = math.huge, -math.huge
	for _, part in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
		if readableIsA(part, "BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
			local half, frame = part.Size * 0.5, part.CFrame
			local extent = math.abs(frame.RightVector.Y) * half.X + math.abs(frame.UpVector.Y) * half.Y + math.abs(frame.LookVector.Y) * half.Z
			low = math.min(low, part.Position.Y - extent)
			high = math.max(high, part.Position.Y + extent)
		end
	end
	return low, high
end

local STATUE_SCALE = 4

local function prepareModel(model)
	assert(model and model:IsA("Model"), "Avatar model unavailable")
	local humanoid = assert(model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"), "Avatar humanoid unavailable")
	local root = assert(model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"), "Avatar root unavailable")
	for _, object in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if readableIsA(object, "LuaSourceContainer") then
			object:Destroy()
		elseif readableIsA(object, "BasePart") then
			object.Anchored = object == root
			object.CanCollide, object.CanTouch, object.CanQuery = false, false, false
			object.Massless = true
		elseif readableIsA(object, "AnimationConstraint") then
			object.IsKinematic = true
			object.Enabled = true
		end
	end
	humanoid.AutoRotate = false
	humanoid.EvaluateStateMachine = false
	humanoid.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
	humanoid.HealthDisplayType = Enum.HumanoidHealthDisplayType.AlwaysOff
	humanoid.WalkSpeed, humanoid.JumpPower = 0, 0
	local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
	if not animator then animator = Instance.new("Animator") animator.Parent = humanoid end
	for _, track in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do track:Stop(0) end
	local low, high = bodyBounds(model)
	local height = high - low
	assert(finite(height) and height > 0.05 and height < 1000, "Avatar body dimensions unavailable")
	model:ScaleTo(model:GetScale() * (5.5 * STATUE_SCALE) / height)
	model.PrimaryPart = root
	model:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)))
	low = bodyBounds(model)
	local result = { model = model, root = root, humanoid = humanoid, animator = animator, floorOffset = -low, joints = {} }
	for _, name in ipairs({ "Right Shoulder", "Left Shoulder", "RightShoulder", "LeftShoulder", "RightElbow", "LeftElbow", "RightWrist", "LeftWrist", "Waist", "Neck" }) do
		local joint = model:FindFirstChild(name, true)
		if joint and (joint:IsA("Motor6D") or joint:IsA("AnimationConstraint")) then
			result.joints[name] = { joint = joint, original = joint.Transform, rotation = joint.C0.Rotation }
		end
	end
	return result
end

local function poseJoint(avatar, name, x, y, z, fade)
	local entry = avatar.joints[name]
	if not entry or not entry.joint.Parent then return end
	local offset = entry.rotation:Inverse() * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(x), math.rad(y), math.rad(z)) * entry.rotation
	entry.joint.Transform = entry.original:Lerp(entry.original * offset, fade)
end

local function restorePose(avatar)
	for _, entry in pairs(avatar.joints) do if entry.joint.Parent then entry.joint.Transform = entry.original end end
end

local function animateModel(avatar, standingPoint, rank, elapsed, authored)
	local fade = math.clamp(elapsed / 0.35, 0, 1)
	local t = elapsed + rank * 0.7
	local bounce = authored and 0 or (1 - math.cos(elapsed * 3.6)) * 0.065 * fade
	local position = standingPoint.WorldPosition + Vector3.new(0, avatar.floorOffset + bounce, 0)
	avatar.model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(position) * standingPoint.WorldCFrame.Rotation * CFrame.Angles(0, math.sin(t * 1.3) * 0.045 * fade, 0))
	if authored then return end
	local wave = math.sin(t * 4.8)
	local right = avatar.joints["Right Shoulder"] and "Right Shoulder" or "RightShoulder"
	local left = avatar.joints["Left Shoulder"] and "Left Shoulder" or "LeftShoulder"
	if rank == 1 then
		poseJoint(avatar, right, 12, 0, 132 + wave * 10, fade)
		poseJoint(avatar, left, 12, 0, -132 + wave * 10, fade)
		poseJoint(avatar, "RightElbow", 35 + wave * 12, 0, 0, fade)
		poseJoint(avatar, "LeftElbow", 35 - wave * 12, 0, 0, fade)
	elseif rank == 2 then
		poseJoint(avatar, right, 10, 0, 140 + wave * 12, fade)
		poseJoint(avatar, left, 0, 0, -12 + math.sin(t * 2) * 5, fade)
		poseJoint(avatar, "RightElbow", 50, wave * 15, 0, fade)
	else
		poseJoint(avatar, right, 18 + wave * 8, 0, 48, fade)
		poseJoint(avatar, left, 18 - wave * 8, 0, -48, fade)
		poseJoint(avatar, "RightElbow", 55 + wave * 15, 0, 0, fade)
		poseJoint(avatar, "LeftElbow", 55 - wave * 15, 0, 0, fade)
	end
	poseJoint(avatar, "Waist", 0, 0, math.sin(t * 2.4) * 4, fade)
	poseJoint(avatar, "Neck", math.sin(t * 2.1) * 3, math.sin(t * 1.4) * 7, 0, fade)
	poseJoint(avatar, "RightWrist", 0, wave * 12, 0, fade)
	poseJoint(avatar, "LeftWrist", 0, -wave * 12, 0, fade)
end

local playerGui = gui.Parent
local header = gui:WaitForChild("Header")

local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
folder.Name = "PlaygroundPodiumAvatars"
folder.Parent = workspace
local alive, activeLoads = true, 0
local selectionGui
local selectedScope, selectedBoard = "global", "MostWins"
local scopes = { global = true, server = true, region = true }
local boardNames = { MostWins = "MOST WINS", HighestLevel = "HIGHEST LEVEL" }
local packetState, packetStatus, packetRegion = "loading", "Loading winners...", nil

local function disconnect(list)
	for _, connection in ipairs(list) do connection:Disconnect() end
	table.clear(list)
end

local function stopTrack(avatar)
	local token = avatar.animationToken
	if token then
		token.expired = true
		if token.worker and coroutine.status(token.worker) ~= "dead" and token.worker ~= coroutine.running() then pcall(task.cancel, token.worker) end
		avatar.animationToken = nil
	end
	if avatar.track then avatar.track:Stop(0) avatar.track:Destroy() avatar.track = nil end
	if avatar.animation then avatar.animation:Destroy() avatar.animation = nil end
	avatar.animationAsset = nil
	restorePose(avatar)
end

local function clearAvatar(slot)
	if slot.loadToken then slot.loadToken.expired = true slot.loadToken = nil end
	if slot.avatar then stopTrack(slot.avatar) slot.avatar.model:Destroy() slot.avatar = nil end
end

local function setEntry(slot, entry)
	local id = entry and entry.userId
	if slot.userId ~= id then
		clearAvatar(slot)
		slot.userId, slot.attempts, slot.retryAt = id, 0, 0
	end
	slot.entry = entry
	slot.display.NameLabel.Text = entry and entry.name or (packetState == "loading" and "Loading..." or "No winner yet")
	slot.display.ScoreLabel.Text = entry and (selectedBoard == "MostWins" and entry.value .. " WINS" or entry.value) or "—"
	if entry then
		slot.display.StatusLabel.Text = slot.avatar and (packetState == "stale" and "Saved ranking" or "") or (slot.attempts >= 3 and "Avatar unavailable" or "Loading avatar...")
	else
		slot.display.StatusLabel.Text = packetState == "loading" and "Waiting for rankings" or packetState == "unavailable" and "Rankings unavailable" or "Your next win could put you here"
	end
end

local function refreshHeading()
	header.Title.Text = boardNames[selectedBoard] .. " · TOP 3"
	local label = selectedScope == "region" and (packetRegion or "REGION") or selectedScope == "server" and "THIS SERVER" or "GLOBAL"
	header.Subtitle.Text = string.upper(label) .. (packetState == "loading" and " · LOADING" or packetState == "unavailable" and " · UNAVAILABLE" or packetState == "stale" and " · SAVED RANKINGS" or " · WINNERS")
end

local function readPacket()
	local encoded = selectionGui and selectionGui:GetAttribute("PodiumSnapshot")
	if typeof(encoded) ~= "string" or #encoded > 32768 then return end
	local ok, packet = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(encoded) end)
	if not ok or typeof(packet) ~= "table" or packet.scope ~= selectedScope or packet.board ~= selectedBoard or typeof(packet.entries) ~= "table" then return end
	packetState = packet.state == "loading" and "loading" or packet.state == "unavailable" and "unavailable" or packet.state == "stale" and "stale" or "ready"
	packetStatus = typeof(packet.status) == "string" and packet.status or ""
	packetRegion = typeof(packet.region) == "string" and packet.region or nil
	local seen = {}
	for index, slot in ipairs(slots) do
		local entry = packet.entries[index]
		if typeof(entry) ~= "table" or not finite(entry.userId) or entry.userId <= 0 or entry.userId % 1 ~= 0 or seen[entry.userId]
			or typeof(entry.name) ~= "string" or typeof(entry.value) ~= "string" then entry = nil end
		if entry then seen[entry.userId] = true end
		setEntry(slot, entry)
	end
	refreshHeading()
end

local function readSelection()
	local scope = selectionGui and selectionGui:GetAttribute("PodiumScope")
	local board = selectionGui and selectionGui:GetAttribute("PodiumBoard")
	scope = scopes[scope] and scope or "global"
	board = boardNames[board] and board or "MostWins"
	if scope ~= selectedScope or board ~= selectedBoard then
		selectedScope, selectedBoard = scope, board
		packetState, packetStatus, packetRegion = "loading", "Loading winners...", nil
		for _, slot in ipairs(slots) do setEntry(slot, nil) end
		refreshHeading()
	end
	readPacket()
end

local function bindSelection()
	local source = playerGui:FindFirstChild("PlaygroundLeaderboards")
	if source == selectionGui then return end
	disconnect(selectionConnections)
	selectionGui = source
	packetState, packetStatus, packetRegion = "loading", "Loading winners...", nil
	for _, slot in ipairs(slots) do setEntry(slot, nil) end
	refreshHeading()
	if source then
		for _, attribute in ipairs({ "PodiumScope", "PodiumBoard", "PodiumSnapshot" }) do
			table.insert(selectionConnections, source:GetAttributeChangedSignal(attribute):Connect(attribute == "PodiumSnapshot" and readPacket or readSelection))
		end
	end
	readSelection()
end

local function bindPedestals()
	local lobby = workspace:FindFirstChild("Playground Lobby")
	local podium = lobby and lobby:FindFirstChild("WinnerPodium")
	local headerFace = podium and podium:FindFirstChild("HeaderFace")
	if headerFace and headerFace:IsA("BasePart") then header.Adornee = headerFace end
	header.Enabled = gui.Enabled and headerFace ~= nil
	for index, slot in ipairs(slots) do
		local pedestal = podium and podium:FindFirstChild("Rank" .. index)
		local point = pedestal and pedestal:FindFirstChild("StandingPoint", true)
		local face = pedestal and pedestal:FindFirstChild("Face")
		slot.point = point and point:IsA("Attachment") and point or nil
		if face and face:IsA("BasePart") then slot.display.Adornee = face end
		slot.display.Enabled = gui.Enabled and slot.point ~= nil and face ~= nil
		if not slot.point and slot.avatar then clearAvatar(slot) end
	end
end

local function beginAvatar(slot)
	local token = { userId = slot.userId, startedAt = os.clock() }
	slot.loadToken = token
	slot.attempts += 1
	activeLoads += 1
	task.spawn(function()
		local ok, model = pcall(function()
			local description = Players:GetHumanoidDescriptionFromUserIdAsync(token.userId)
			local created, value = pcall(function() return Players:CreateHumanoidModelFromDescriptionAsync(description, Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15) end)
			description:Destroy()
			if not created then error(value) end
			return value
		end)
		activeLoads -= 1
		local current = alive and not token.expired and slot.loadToken == token and slot.userId == token.userId and slot.point and slot.point:IsDescendantOf(workspace)
		if slot.loadToken == token then slot.loadToken = nil end
		if not current then if ok and typeof(model) == "Instance" then model:Destroy() end return end
		local prepared, avatar = false, nil
		if ok and typeof(model) == "Instance" then prepared, avatar = pcall(prepareModel, model) end
		if not prepared then
			if ok and typeof(model) == "Instance" then model:Destroy() end
			slot.retryAt = os.clock() + math.min(60, slot.attempts * 15)
			slot.display.StatusLabel.Text = "Avatar unavailable"
			return
		end
		avatar.startedAt = os.clock()
		model.Name = "Rank" .. slot.rank .. "_" .. token.userId
		model:SetAttribute("PodiumUserId", token.userId)
		model.Parent = folder
		slot.avatar = avatar
		animateModel(avatar, slot.point, slot.rank, 0, false)
		slot.display.StatusLabel.Text = packetState == "stale" and "Saved ranking" or ""
	end)
end

local function requestedAnimation(slot)
	local winner = slot.userId and Players:GetPlayerByUserId(slot.userId)
	local equipped, asset, rig
	if winner and winner:GetAttribute("PCDataReady") == true then
		equipped = winner:GetAttribute("PCEmote")
		asset = winner:GetAttribute("PCEquippedEmoteAnimationId")
		rig = winner:GetAttribute("PCEquippedEmoteRigType")
	else
		local entry = slot.entry
		equipped = entry and entry.emoteId
		asset = entry and entry.emoteAnimationId
		rig = entry and entry.emoteRigType
	end
	if typeof(equipped) == "string" and equipped ~= "" then
		return rig == "R15" and animationId(asset) or nil
	end
	return animationId(gui:GetAttribute("PodiumAnimationId"))
end

local function failedAnimation(slot, avatar)
	stopTrack(avatar)
	avatar.animationRetryAt = os.clock() + 15
	slot.display.StatusLabel.Text = avatar.animationAttempts >= 3 and "Dance unavailable" or "Dance is loading slowly"
end

local function updateAnimation(slot)
	local avatar = slot.avatar
	local requested = requestedAnimation(slot)
	if avatar.requestedAnimation ~= requested then
		stopTrack(avatar)
		avatar.requestedAnimation = requested
		avatar.animationAttempts, avatar.animationRetryAt = 0, 0
	end
	if not requested then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	if avatar.track then
		if avatar.track.Length > 0 and avatar.track.IsPlaying then
			avatar.animationAttempts, avatar.animationRetryAt = 0, 0
			return
		end
		if now - avatar.animationLoadedAt > 8 then failedAnimation(slot, avatar) end
		return
	end
	if avatar.animationToken then
		if now - avatar.animationToken.startedAt > 8 then failedAnimation(slot, avatar) end
		return
	end
	if (avatar.animationAttempts or 0) >= 3 or now < (avatar.animationRetryAt or 0) then return end
	avatar.animationAttempts = (avatar.animationAttempts or 0) + 1
	local token = {startedAt=now}
	avatar.animationToken = token
	local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
	animation.Name = "EquippedPodiumEmote"
	animation.AnimationId = requested
	avatar.animation, avatar.animationAsset = animation, requested
	token.worker = task.spawn(function()
		local ok, track = pcall(function() return avatar.animator:LoadAnimation(animation) end)
		if not alive or token.expired or avatar.animationToken ~= token or slot.avatar ~= avatar or not avatar.model.Parent then
			if ok then track:Destroy() end
			return
		end
		avatar.animationToken = nil
		if not ok then failedAnimation(slot, avatar) return end
		avatar.track, avatar.animationLoadedAt = track, os.clock()
		local played = pcall(function()
			track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
			track.Looped = true
			track:Play(0.25)
		end)
		if not played then failedAnimation(slot, avatar)
		else slot.display.StatusLabel.Text = packetState == "stale" and "Saved ranking" or "" end
	end)
end

	if player:GetAttribute("PCDataReady") ~= true or player:GetAttribute("MDParticipating") == true
		or player:GetAttribute("BBRagdolled") == true or player:GetAttribute("TGRagdolled") == true
		or player:GetAttribute("PCPushed") == true or player:GetAttribute("HSParticipating") == true
		or player:GetAttribute("DGParticipating") == true or player:GetAttribute("DGEliminated") == true or player:GetAttribute("SKParticipating") == true or player:GetAttribute("SKEliminated") == true then return nil end
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or humanoid.Sit then return nil end
	local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	if player:GetAttribute("BBParticipating") == true then
		local state = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("BritishBulldogState")
		local role = player:GetAttribute("BBRole")

		if state and state:GetAttribute("Phase") == "Crossing"
			and (role == "Runner" and status == "Crossing" or role == "Bulldog" and status == "Bulldog") then return "Bulldog" end
	elseif player:GetAttribute("TGParticipating") == true then
		local state = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("TagState")
		local role = player:GetAttribute("TGRole")
		local protected = player:GetAttribute("TGProtectedEndsAt")
		if state and state:GetAttribute("Phase") == "Playing" and (role == "Runner" or role == "Tagger")
			and (typeof(protected) ~= "number" or protected <= now) then return "Tag" end
	end
	return nil
end

local function remainingCooldown()
	local readyAt = player:GetAttribute("PCPushReadyAt")
	local serverRemaining = typeof(readyAt) == "number" and readyAt == readyAt
		and readyAt < math.huge and readyAt - workspace:GetServerTimeNow() or 0
	return math.max(0, serverRemaining, nextTapAt - os.clock())
end

local function inputHint()
	local last = UserInputService:GetLastInputType()
	if string.find(last.Name, "Gamepad", 1, true) then
		local label = UserInputService:GetStringForKeyCode(Enum.KeyCode.ButtonX)
		return (label == "ButtonSquare" or label == "Square") and "[\u{25A1}]" or "[X]"
	end
	if last == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled then return "TAP" end
	return "[Q]"
end

local function inputReady()
	return alive and gui.Enabled and focused and not GuiService.MenuIsOpen and not UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox()
end

local function push()
	local gameId = activeGame()
	local entry = gameId and (UserInputService.TouchEnabled and buttons.Mobile or buttons[gameId])
	if not entry or not entry.gui.Enabled or not entry.button.Visible or not inputReady() or remainingCooldown() > 0 then return end
	local remote = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("PlaygroundPushRequest")
	if not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then return end
	nextTapAt = os.clock() + 0.35
	local ok = pcall(function() remote:FireServer() end)
	if not ok then nextTapAt = 0 end
	refresh()
end

local function action(_, inputState)
	if not activeGame() or not inputReady() then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass end
	if inputState == Enum.UserInputState.Begin then push() end
	return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
end

refresh = function()
	local gameId = activeGame()
	local displayId = gameId and (UserInputService.TouchEnabled and "Mobile" or gameId)
	local remaining = remainingCooldown()
	local ready = gameId ~= nil and inputReady() and remaining <= 0
	for id, entry in pairs(buttons) do

		button.Visible = gui.Enabled and id == displayId
		button.Active = id == displayId and ready
		button.Interactable = button.Active

		button.Hint.Text = remaining > 0 and string.format("%.1fs", remaining) or inputHint()
		button.ReusableSkin.ImageColor3 = ready and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or Color3.fromRGB(164, 170, 184)
		button.Fallback.Visible = not button.ReusableSkin.IsLoaded
	end
	if gameId and gui.Enabled and not bound then
		ContextActionService:BindActionAtPriority(actionName, action, false, 3000, Enum.KeyCode.Q, Enum.KeyCode.ButtonX)
		bound = true
	elseif (not gameId or not gui.Enabled) and bound then
		ContextActionService:UnbindAction(actionName)
		bound = false
	end
end

	if busy or not alive or not gui.Enabled or not dock.Visible then return end
	local code = input.Text:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or ""
	if #code == 0 then status.Text = "Enter your reward code first." return end

		if not alive or serial ~= requestSerial then return end

		if ok and typeof(response) == "table" then

		if not alive or not busy or serial ~= requestSerial then return end
		serial += 1
		busy = false

local function targetsFor(gameId)
	local result = {}
	local attribute = roundAttributes[gameId]
	if not attribute then return result end
	for _, candidate in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local character = candidate.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if candidate ~= player and candidate:GetAttribute(attribute) == true and (not humanoid or humanoid.Health > 0)
			and (gameId ~= "SkippingRope" or candidate:GetAttribute("SKEliminated") ~= true)
			and (gameId ~= "StuckInTheMud" or candidate:GetAttribute("MDEliminated") ~= true)
			and (rejectedUntil[candidate.UserId] or 0) <= os.clock() then
			table.insert(result, candidate)
		end
	end
	table.sort(result, function(a, b) return a.UserId < b.UserId end)
	return result
end

local function requestFocus(candidate)
	focusSerial += 1
	local serial = focusSerial
	if focusWorker then pcall(task.cancel, focusWorker) end
	local stamp = nextFocusStamp()
	lastFocusAt = os.clock()
	focusWorker = task.spawn(function()
		local ok, result = pcall(remote.InvokeServer, remote, "SetSpectate", candidate.UserId, stamp)
		if not alive or not watching or serial ~= focusSerial or target ~= candidate then return end
		focusWorker = nil
		if not ok or typeof(result) ~= "table" or not result.ok then
			rejectedUntil[candidate.UserId] = os.clock() + 3
			task.delay(0.25, function() if alive and watching and serial == focusSerial then stepTarget(1) end end)
		end
	end)
	task.delay(8, function()
		if alive and watching and serial == focusSerial and focusWorker then
			exitSpectate("Could not load the arena. Try again.")
			refresh()

stepTarget = function(direction)
	if not watching then return end
	if os.clock() - lastTargetChange < 0.25 then return end
	lastTargetChange = os.clock()
	local list = targetsFor(watchingGame)
	if #list == 0 then exitSpectate("No players left to watch.") return end
	local index = table.find(list, target)
	local nextIndex = index and ((index - 1 + direction) % #list + 1) or 1
	setTarget(list[nextIndex])

local function toggleAFK()
	if busy or not gui.Enabled then return end
	busy = true
	requestSerial += 1
	local serial = requestSerial
	refresh()
	requestWorker = task.spawn(function()
		local ok, response = pcall(remote.InvokeServer, remote, "SetAFK", player:GetAttribute("PCAFKRequested") ~= true)
		if not alive or serial ~= requestSerial then return end
		requestWorker = nil
		busy = false
		if ok and typeof(response) == "table" then tell(response.message or "AFK updated.") else tell("Could not update AFK. Try again.") end
		refresh()
	end)
	task.delay(8, function()
		if alive and busy and serial == requestSerial then
			requestSerial += 1
			busy = false
			if requestWorker then pcall(task.cancel, requestWorker) requestWorker = nil end
			tell("AFK request timed out. Try again.")
			refresh()
		end
	end)
end
